source: > The revision-id field defines what current "version" your item is. This is up to you to change at your will, and any items that players have that don't match the revision ID set in your editor will get updated to their most recent version upon interaction.

source: > **INFO**

Using MMOItems 5+ you may implement blocks with a custom texture. You can even make them spawn and define how rare they are using [world generation templates](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/archive/dead-link), configure with what tool it should be broken by players, decide what it loots using MMOItems drop tables and bind a random amount of exp to it.
zh: 使用MMOItems5+ 你可以实现具有自定义纹理的块。你甚至可以让它们生成并使用[世界生成模板](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/archive/dead-link)] 定义它们的稀有程度，使用玩家破坏它的工具进行配置，使用MMOItems掉落表决定它会掠夺什么，并将随机数量的 exp 绑定到它。

source: Creating and editing a custom block
zh: 创建和编辑自定义块

source: You can browse current custom blocks using `/mi browse blocks`. When using the item browser, you may use the small item indicator at the bottom right of the GUI to switch to the Block Browser. Just like with the item browser, you can right click your custom blocks to edit them.
zh: 你可以使用`/mi browse blocks`浏览当前的自定义块。当使用物品浏览器时，你可以使用GUI右下角的小物品指示器切换到块浏览器。就像使用物品浏览器一样，你可以右键单击自定义块来编辑它们。

zh: `required-power`定义了工具必须具有的镐功率才能打破该块。如果设置为3，则玩家必须使用`Pickaxe Power`高于3的 MMOItem 工具。

source: Block Break XP
zh: 方块破坏 XP

source: If `min-xp` and `max-xp` are added, breaking a custom block rolls a random amount of exp chosen between `min-xp` and `max-xp` and spawns an exp orb on the block just like regular ores.
zh: 如果添加了`min-xp`和`max-xp`，则破坏自定义块会滚动在`min-xp`和`max-xp`之间选择的随机数量的 exp，并在块上生成一个 exp 球，就像普通矿石一样。

source: Custom Texture
zh: 自定义纹理

source: If you know how resource packs and custom model data works, you can texturize your custom block by defining its `Custom Model Data` through `block-id`. ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/block_id_1.DKzWMBj7.png)
zh: 如果你知道资源包和自定义模型数据的工作原理，则可以通过定义`Custom Model Data`到`block-id`来对自定义块进行纹理化。 ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/block_id_1.DKzWMBj7.png)

source: A `block-id` doesn't absolutely mean the `CustomModelData` tag in the item. If an item has a `block-id` of `300`, its `CustomModelData` will become `1300`. This is because MMOItems will add `1000` to the assigned `block-id` as its `CustomModelData`. A useful command to use is `/mi debug checktag CustomModelData` to see the value of the tag from the block you are currently holding.
zh: `block-id`并不绝对意味着物品中的`CustomModelData`标签。如果物品的`block-id`为`300`，则其`CustomModelData`将变为`1300`。这是因为MMOItems会将`1000`添加到分配的`block-id`作为其`CustomModelData`。一个有用的命令是`/mi debug checktag CustomModelData`来查看你当前持有的块中的标签值。

zh: ![block_id_2.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/block_id_3.C89bFqK3.png)

source: A link to download the sample texture pack is also included in the block browser GUI ingame. ![block_id_2.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/block_id_2.apA7N6FI.png)
zh: 游戏中的块浏览器GUI中还包含下载示例纹理包的链接。 ![block_id_2.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/block_id_2.apA7N6FI.png)

source: World Generation
zh: 世界一代

source: A custom block can be included in the world generation given that it has a `block-id`. To include a custom block in the world generation, you need to add a `Gen Template` to your block so that it will be registered when new chunks are loaded in your world. You can check out the [world generation templates](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/archive/dead-link) guide for more info about setting up/customizing generation. ![world_gen_block.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/world_gen_block.C1Gs6_aA.png)
zh: 自定义块可以包含在世界生成中，因为它具有`block-id`。要在世界生成中包含自定义块，你需要将`Gen Template`添加到你的块中，以便在你的世界中加载新块时将注册它。你可以查看[世界生成模板](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/archive/dead-link)指南，以获取有关设置/自定义生成的更多信息。 ![world_gen_block.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/world_gen_block.C1Gs6_aA.png)

zh: 如果你需要有关MMOItemsAPI的更多信息，请加入Discord支持频道。提问请使用`#developers`频道！

source: Checking if an ItemStack is from MI
zh: 检查 ItemStack 是否来自 MI

source: First, get the NBTItem of your ItemStack using `NBTItem.get(ItemStack)`. This class lets you manipulate NBTTags from your item easily (1.14 has a new API which lets you do that using the ItemMeta, but for <1.14 support MI handles NBTs using NMS code). Use `nbtItem.hasType()` to see if the NBTItem can find the tag which corresponds to an MMOItems type. This method basically checks whether or not the plugin is from MI.
zh: 首先，使用`NBTItem.get(ItemStack)`获取 ItemStack 的 NBTItem 。此类可让你轻松地从物品操作 NBTTag（1.14有一个新的API，它允许你使用 ItemMeta 执行此操作，但对于 <1.14支持，MI 使用NMS代码处理 NBT）。使用`nbtItem.hasType()`来查看 NBTItem 是否可以找到与MMOItems类型对应的标签。该方法主要检查插件是否来自 MI。

source: You can get the item type using `nbtItem.getType()`. This method calls a map checkup through all the plugin item types, so save its result in a field to save calculations.
zh: 你可以使用`nbtItem.getType()`获取物品类型。此方法通过所有插件物品类型调用地图检查，因此将其结果保存在字段中以保存计算。

source: Checking if an MI item is a specific item
zh: 检查 MI物品是否为特定物品

source: Again, get the NBTItem of your ItemStack using `NBTItem.get(ItemStack)`. You can then easily run `nbtItem.hasType()` to check if it's an MMOItem and then `nbtItem.getType()` and `nbtItem.getString("MMOITEMS_ITEM_ID")` to get the ID of the said item. You can compare the type and ID with whatever you'll need to check if an item is a specific one.
zh: 再次，使用`NBTItem.get(ItemStack)`获取 ItemStack 的 NBTItem 。然后，你可以轻松运行`nbtItem.hasType()`来检查它是否是 MMOItem，然后运行 ​​`nbtItem.getType()`和`nbtItem.getString("MMOITEMS_ITEM_ID")`来获取所述物品的ID。你可以将类型和ID与你需要的任何内容进行比较，以检查物品是否是特定的。

source: Generating an item
zh: 生成物品

source: 💗 New Stats
zh: 💗 新属性

source: Using MMOItems API you may register custom stats as complex as abilities or item restrictions. The first thing you will need to do is define a class which extends `ItemStat` which is an abstract class with many functions, we will go over what each does, but first let's deal with the ItemStat constructor you need to call.
zh: 使用MMOItemsAPI，你可以注册与能力或物品限制一样复杂的自定义属性。你需要做的第一件事是定义一个扩展`ItemStat`的类，这是一个具有许多函数的抽象类，我们将介绍每个函数的作用，但首先让我们处理你需要调用的 ItemStat 构造函数。

source: ItemStat Constructor
zh: 项目统计构造函数

source: The `id` String corresponds to your internal stat ID. You may only use upper case letters and _ dashes. This stat is used to calculate player stats in MMOLib, used to saved stat data in MMOItems config files, literally anywhere in the plugin. Never change it once your stat is setup otherwise you might "lose" previously created item data.
zh: `id`字符串对应于你的内部属性ID。你只能使用大写字母和 _ 破折号。这个属性用于计算MMOLib中的玩家属性，用于将属性数据保存在MMOItems配置文件中，实际上在插件中的任何位置。设置属性后切勿更改它，否则你可能会“丢失”之前创建的物品数据。

source: The `material` parameter corresponds to the icon your stat has in the item edition GUI. `name` corresponds to your stat name, it's also used to display your stat in the edition GUI. This piece of string cannot be seen by normal players. `lore` is your stat description (edition GUI).
zh: `material`参数对应于属性在物品版本GUI中的图标。`name`对应你的属性名称，它也用于显示你的属性版本GUI。正常的玩家是看不到这段字符串的。`lore`是你的属性描述（版本GUI）。

source: `types` is the list of the item types which are supported by your item stat.
zh: `types`是物品属性支持的物品类型的列表。

source: `new String[] { "!armor", "!gem_stone", "all" }` would ban armors and gem stones from using your stat. Using `!<type_name>` you can ban a specific item type. Make sure you put type restrictions at the beginning of the string array. Using `all` you can make the stat compatible with any item type. Make sure you use `all` after type restrictions.
zh: `new String[] { "!armor", "!gem_stone", "all" }`将禁止盔甲和宝石使用你的属性。使用`!<type_name>`你可以禁止特定的物品类型。确保将类型限制放在字符串数组的开头。使用`all`，你可以使属性与任何物品类型兼容。确保在类型限制后使用`all`。

source: `materials` are the item materials supported. This is specific to some stats like `Dye Color` or `Shield Pattern` which depend on the ItemMeta instance and which are type-specific. If the given array is empty, the stat is obviously available for any type by default.
zh: `materials`是支持的物品材料。这是特定于某些属性的，例如`Dye Color`或`Shield Pattern`，它们依赖于 ItemMeta 实例，并且是type-specific。如果给定的数组为空，则默认情况下属性显然可用于任何类型。

source: Methods to override
zh: 重写的方法

source: This is the class for numeric stats.
zh: 这是数字属性的类。

source: `whenInitialized(Object)`
zh: `whenInitialized(Object)`

source: `whenInitialized(Object)` is called when MMOItems is requesting to read stat data from the config file. `obj` could be anything, it's the object obtained using `ConfigurationSection#get(yourStatPath)`. Here, users can either use a double to have a set stat value, or a config section and in that case MMOItems reads a numeric stat formula from that config section.
zh: 当MMOItems请求从配置文件读取属性数据时，调用`whenInitialized(Object)`。`obj`可以是任何东西，它是使用`ConfigurationSection#get(yourStatPath)`获得的对象。在这里，用户可以使用 double 来设置属性值，也可以使用配置部分，在这种情况下，MMOItems从该配置部分读取数字属性公式。

source: This method must return a class which extends the `StatData` interface. It's a **purely cosmetic** interface because it has no function to override but I might need to add some functions to it in a later update. **You can see a StatData class example under the Mergeable Stats section**.
zh: 此方法必须返回一个扩展`StatData`接口的类。它是一个**纯粹的装饰**界面，因为它没有可以覆盖的功能，但我可能需要在以后的更新中向它添加一些功能。 **你可以在可合并属性部分下看到 StatData 类示例**。

source: `whenInitializedGeneration(Object)`
zh: `whenInitializedGeneration(Object)`

source: `whenInitializedGeneration(Object)` is almost the same thing, except that it should return a `RandomStatData` instance. The `RandomStatData` interface is used to store data about stat data from an item generation template. For further info, see the RandomStatData paragraph below.
zh: `whenInitializedGeneration(Object)`几乎是同样的事情，只是它应该返回一个`RandomStatData`实例。`RandomStatData`接口用于存储来自物品生成模板的属性数据。有关更多信息，请参阅下面的 RandomStatData 段落。

source: `whenApplied(MMOItemBuilder, StatData)`
zh: `whenApplied(MMOItemBuilder, StatData)`

source: This function is used by MMOItems when generating an `ItemStack` instance based on a list of `StatData` instances. You can access the item meta, item lore using the `MMOItemBuilder` instance. You will need to cast the `StatData` instance given as input to whatever your stat is compatible with. MMOItems only gives you as input what you gave it as output in the `whenInitialized(Generation)` methods.
zh: MMOItems在根据`StatData`实例列表生成`ItemStack`实例时使用此函数。你可以使用`MMOItemBuilder`实例访问物品元、物品描述。你需要将作为输入给出的`StatData`实例转换为与属性兼容的任何实例。MMOItems只为你提供在`whenInitialized(Generation)`方法中作为输出提供的输入。

source: `whenClicked(EditionInventory, InventoryClickEvent)`
zh: `whenClicked(EditionInventory, InventoryClickEvent)`

source: This is the function used to do stuff when a player just clicked the stat icon in the item edition GUI.
zh: 这是当玩家只需单击物品版本GUI中的属性图标时用于执行操作的函数。

source: `whenInput(EditionInventory, ConfigFile config, String message, Object...)`
zh: `whenInput(EditionInventory, ConfigFile config, String message, Object...)`

source: Used to do stuff when a player just inputs some message in the chat. You can request for a player chat input using the following method: `new StatEdition(inv, this, objectArray).enable("Write in the chat the numeric value you want.", "Or write [MIN-VALUE]=[MAX-VALUE] to make the stat random.");` That function would typically be called when the player clicks the stat icon in the edition GUI. The `objectArray` parameter in the `StatEdition` class constructor can be replaced by **any object at all**, it's a way for more complex stats like elements or abilities what the player is editing (is it the ability casting mode, what ability, etc??). That array is kept intact and given as input in the `whenInput` method.
zh: 用于当玩家在聊天中输入一些消息时执行操作。你可以使用以下方法请求玩家聊天输入：`new StatEdition(inv, this, objectArray).enable("Write in the chat the numeric value you want.", "Or write [MIN-VALUE]=[MAX-VALUE] to make the stat random.");`当玩家单击版本GUI中的属性图标时，通常会调用该函数。`StatEdition`类构造函数中的`objectArray`参数可以替换为**任何对象**，这是一种更复杂的属性的方式，例如玩家正在编辑的元素或能力（是能力施放模式，什么能力等？？）。该数组保持完整并作为`whenInput`方法的输入给出。

source: `whenLoaded(MMOItem, NBTItem)`
zh: `whenLoaded(MMOItem, NBTItem)`

source: Used to load stat data from a random ItemStack.
zh: 用于从随机 ItemStack 加载属性数据。

source: `whenDisplayed(List<String>, ConfigurationSection, String)`
zh: `whenDisplayed(List<String>, ConfigurationSection, String)`

source: It's a really old method which will be updated soon. It's the function used to display the current item stat data in the edition GUI. It is still using config sections as input, it will be soon replaced by StatDatas for cleaner functionality.
zh: 这是一个非常古老的方法，很快就会更新。该函数用于显示GUI版本中当前物品属性数据。它仍然使用配置部分作为输入，它将很快被 StatDatas 取代以实现更清晰的功能。

source: `RandomStatData`'s
zh: `RandomStatData`的

source: They are the equivalent of `StatData`'s but with a random factor needed for random item generation. A good example is the `NumericStatFormula` class, which is used for any numeric stats.
zh: 它们与`StatData`等效，但具有随机物品生成所需的随机因子。一个很好的例子是`NumericStatFormula`类，它用于任何数字属性。

source: The `#randomize(..)` function is the key here. This takes as input a GeneratedItemBuilder which contains info about the item level, tier etc. and outputs a randomized `RandomStatData`, i.e a `StatData` instance which will be later used to build the item!
zh: `#randomize(..)`函数是这里的关键。这将包含有关物品等级、层等的信息的 generatedItemBuilder 作为输入，并输出随机的`RandomStatData`、i.e和`StatData`实例，该实例稍后将用于构建物品！

source: The `GeneratedItemBuilder` class can be seen as the equivalent of the `MMOItemBuilder` for random stat generation. When a random item is being generated from an item template, MMOItems first creates a `GeneratedItemBuilder`, rolls the item modifiers and gather the randomized `StatData` when generates the item using a `MMOItemBuilder`.
zh: `GeneratedItemBuilder`类可以看作是随机属性生成的`MMOItemBuilder`的等效项。当从物品模板生成随机物品时，MMOItems首先创建`GeneratedItemBuilder`，滚动物品修饰器并在使用`MMOItemBuilder`生成物品时收集随机`StatData`。

source: Mergeable Stats
zh: 可合并属性

source: Mergeable stats are stats which can be stacked with each others, for instance when a player tries to apply a gem stone onto another item, where MMOItems needs to "merge" the two stat datas together. A good example is the `DoubleData` class.
zh: 可合并的属性是可以相互堆叠的属性，例如，当玩家尝试将宝石应用到另一个物品上时，MMOItems需要将两个属性数据“合并”在一起。`DoubleData`类就是一个很好的例子。

source: Simple enough: MMOItems just adds the two values together. A little specification here: the `min` and `max` options are used to have a stat range but whenever that `StatData` is loaded from an NBTItem using `whenLoading(MMOItem mmoitem, NBTItem)`, only the `min` variable is used because a generated item does not have stat ranges anymore, they have already been rolled on item generation.
zh: 很简单：MMOItems只是将两个值相加。这里有一点规范：`min`和`max`选项用于具有属性范围，但每当使用`whenLoading(MMOItem mmoitem, NBTItem)`从 NBTItem 加载`StatData`时，仅使用`min`变量，因为生成的物品没有属性系列不再存在，它们已经推出到物品一代。

source: Registering a stat
zh: 注册属性

source: You now need to register your stat by running `MMOItems.plugin.getStats().register(ItemStat);` Make sure you register your stat before MMOItems enables, either right after MMOItems loads if it's a depend, or when your plugin enables if it's a loadbefore. MMOItems does handle `Listener` stats, no need to register them later on.
zh: 现在，你需要通过运行`MMOItems.plugin.getStats().register(ItemStat);`来注册你的属性确保在MMOItems启用之前注册你的属性，或者在MMOItems加载（如果它是依赖项）之后立即注册，或者在你的插件启用（如果它是加载之前）。MMOItems确实处理`Listener`属性，以后无需注册它们。

source: This registers the stat in MMOItems, so by default your stat will appear in the item edition GUI. The following two steps will make your stat display in the item lore on any generated item:
zh: 这会将属性注册到MMOItems中，因此默认情况下你的属性将出现在物品版本GUI中。以下两个步骤将使你的属性显示在任何生成的物品上的物品描述中：

source: Add your stat to your current lore format. You can do this by opening `language/lore-format.yml` and adding one line there; for example, `- '#attack-damage#'` is the line for the Attack Damage stat.
zh: 将你的属性添加到当前的描述格式。你可以通过打开`language/lore-format.yml`并在其中添加一行来完成此操作；例如，`- '#attack-damage#'`是攻击伤害属性的行。

source: Edit your `stats.yml` configuration section and add the required translations here; for instance you'd add `attack-damage: '&3 &7➸ Attack Damage: &f{value}'` for the Attack Damage stat.
zh: 编辑你的`stats.yml`配置部分并在此处添加所需的翻译；例如，你可以为攻击伤害属性添加`attack-damage: '&3 &7➸ Attack Damage: &f{value}'`。

source: Item Restrictions
zh: 物品限制

source: Simply let your class implement `ItemRestriction` and override the `canUse(RPGPlayer, NBTItem, boolean)` method.
zh: 只需让你的类实现`ItemRestriction`并重写`canUse(RPGPlayer, NBTItem, boolean)`方法即可。

source: Proper Stats
zh: 正品属性

source: "Proper" stats are a very specific type of stats. These are stats which are supported by gem stones but which **must not** be applied onto the target item when a gem stone is being attached onto another item.
zh: “正确的”属性是属性的一种非常特殊的类型。这些是属性，由宝石支撑，但当宝石被附加到另一个物品上时，**不得**应用于目标物品。

source: Examples: custom model data, shield patterns, custom sounds...
zh: 示例：自定义模型数据、屏蔽图案、自定义声音...

source: Let your stat class implement the `ProperStat` interface if you don't want gems to apply the potential gem stone stat data onto the target item.
zh: 如果你不希望 gem 将潜在宝石属性数据应用到目标物品上，请让你的属性类实现`ProperStat`接口。

source: Upgradable
zh: 可升级

source: More on this later during the MI7 update.
zh: 稍后在 MI7 更新期间将详细介绍这一点。

source: 📝 Denizen
zh: 📝 居民

source: > This feature was experimental and is no longer available.
zh: > 此功能是实验性的，不再可用。

source: Getting a MI item
zh: 获取 MI物品

source: First you will have to retrieve the item template using `<mmoitem_template[type=SWORD>;id=KATANA]>`, which returns an MMOItemTemplateTag. Then you will have to generate the item using the `<templateTag.generate[]>` subtag.
zh: 首先，你必须使用`<mmoitem_template[type=SWORD>;id=KATANA]>`检索物品模板，该模板返回 MMOItemTemplateTag。然后，你必须使用`<templateTag.generate[]>`子标签生成物品。

source: The following example will generate an item with a random level and tier. If you don't specify any tier, it will be chosen randomly, based on the chances you chose when setting up the tier [item generator options](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/tiers#modifier-capacity-item-generation).
zh: 以下示例将生成具有随机等级和层的物品。如果你没有指定任何层，它将根据你在设置层时选择的机会随机选择[物品生成器选项](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/tiers#modifier-capacity-item-generation)。

source: `<mmoitemTemplateTag.generate[]>`
zh: `<mmoitemTemplateTag.generate[]>`

source: The following example will generate an item with a specific level, and tier.
zh: 以下示例将生成具有特定等级和层的物品。

source: `<mmoitemTemplateTag.generate[level=10;tier=RARE]>`
zh: `<mmoitemTemplateTag.generate[level=10;tier=RARE]>`

source: The following example will generate an item, which level will scale with the target player's level. The target player is a PlayerTag and must be passed in the tag context. If you don't specify an item level, MMOItems will take a completely random level unless you enable the `match-level` option.
zh: 以下示例将生成物品，其等级将随目标玩家的等级缩放。目标玩家是一个 PlayerTag，必须在标签上下文中传递。如果你不指定物品等级，则MMOItems将采用完全随机的等级，除非你启用`match-level`选项。

source: `<mmoitemTemplateTag.generate[player=SomePlayerTag;match-level=TRUE]>`
zh: `<mmoitemTemplateTag.generate[player=SomePlayerTag;match-level=TRUE]>`

source: New properties for ItemTags
zh: ItemTags 的新属性

source: Using the following tag you can check if an item is an MMOItem or not
zh: 使用以下标签，你可以检查物品是否是 MMOItem

source: `<itemTag.is_mmoitem>`
zh: `<itemTag.is_mmoitem>`

source: Using the following tag, you can check if an item is unidentified
zh: 使用以下标签，你可以检查物品是否未识别

source: `<itemTag.is_unidentified>`
zh: `<itemTag.is_unidentified>`

source: Using the following tag, you can generate the identified version of an item, after making sure it is unidentified
zh: 使用以下标签，你可以在确保其未识别后生成物品的已识别版本

source: `<itemTag.identify>`
zh: `<itemTag.identify>`

source: In the following example, we are checking if a basic iron sword is an MMOItem, so this will always return false.
zh: 在下面的示例中，我们检查基本铁剑是否是 MMOItem，因此将始终返回false。

source: `<item[DIAMOND_SWORD].is_mmoitem>`
zh: `<item[DIAMOND_SWORD].is_mmoitem>`

source: 🔮 Enchant Plugins
zh: 🔮 附魔插件

source: MMOItems features native compatibility for [EcoEnchants](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/ecoenchants-%E2%AD%95-250-enchantments-%E2%9C%85-create-custom-enchants-%E2%9C%A8-essentials-cmi-support.79573), [MythicEnchants](https://mythiccraft.io/index.php?resources/mythicenchantments-early-access.397) and [AdvancedEnchants](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/43058) partially. Most modern enchant plugins that feature a reasonable implementation of enchants (aka that use the Bukkit enchantment registry) should work fine with MMOItems.
zh: MMOItems部分具有对 [EcoEnchants](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/ecoenchants-%E2%AD%95-250-enchantments-%E2%9C%85-create-custom-enchants-%E2%9C%A8-essentials-cmi-support.79573)、 [MythicEnchants](https://mythiccraft.io/index.php?resources/mythicenchantments-early-access.397)和 [AdvancedEnchants](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/43058)] 的本机兼容性。大多数现代附魔插件都具有合理的附魔实现（也称为使用Bukkit附魔注册表），应该可以与MMOItems一起正常工作。

source: Implementing compatibility with your custom enchant plugin
zh: 实现与你的自定义附魔插件的兼容性

source: Here is, for instance, the implementation for the MythicEnchants plugin. The `MythicEnchant` class is a class that extends the default `Enchantment` Bukkit class. `getNamespacedKey(String)` should return a namespaced key with your plugin as namespace. `handleEnchant(...)` is run every time an item is (re)generated and basically adds one line to the lore to indicate that an enchant is applied onto the item. The `ItemStackBuilder` class can be used to access the `LoreBuilder` class which contains all the methods required to edit the item lore. `LoreBuilder#insert(int, String)` can be used to insert at 1st position any string.
zh: 以下是 MythicEnchants 插件的实现示例。`MythicEnchant` 类继承 Bukkit 的 `Enchantment` 类。`getNamespacedKey(String)` 应返回以插件名为命名空间的键。每次生成或重新生成物品时，都会运行 `handleEnchant(...)`，在物品描述中添加一行文字，表示已应用该附魔。可以通过 `ItemStackBuilder` 类访问 `LoreBuilder` 类，后者提供修改物品描述所需的方法。`LoreBuilder#insert(int, String)` 可以将任意字符串插入第 1 个位置。

source: Enchant plugins like EcoEnchants do NOT need you to register that `EnchantPlugin` implementation because the lore display is handled using packets which is another possibility.
zh: 像 EcoEnchants 这样的附魔插件不需要你注册`EnchantPlugin`实现，因为描述显示是使用数据包处理的，这是另一种可能性。

source: Arrow Volley Mechanic
zh: 箭齐射机械师

source: Similar to the mythicmobs' arrow volley mechanic, this mechanic fires forth a bunch of arrows at desired spread, from the desired offset. However, **this scales the arrows with stats of the player** such that the arrows fired have the same effect of firing it manually with a bow.
zh: 与神话怪物的箭齐射机制类似，该机制以所需的散布和所需的偏移量发射一束箭。然而，**这会使用玩家的属性来缩放箭头**，这样发射的箭具有与用弓手动发射相同的效果。

source: Note that the arrows will get stat bonuses from all player equipment, including any weapon the player is currently wielding, even if it's not a bow.
zh: 请注意，箭头将从所有玩家装备中获得属性奖励，包括玩家当前使用的任何武器，即使它不是弓。

source: | Attribute | Aliases | Description | Default Value |
zh: |基础属性|别名 |描述 |默认值 |

source: | amount | arrows, a | Number of arrows that will be fired. | 20 |
zh: |金额 |箭头，一个|将发射的箭的数量。 |20|

source: | spread | s | Spread of the arrows, use large values to notice. | 45 |
zh: |传播| s |箭头的分布，使用较大的值来注意。 |45|

source: | fireticks | ft, f | Ticks the arrows will remain on fire. | 0 |
zh: |火刻 |英尺，f |勾选箭头将继续着火。 |0|

source: | removeDelay | rd, r | Arrows will be removed after this many ticks. | 200 |
zh: |删除延迟 | rd, r |经过这么多次刻后，箭头将被删除。 |200|

source: | velocity | v | Speed of the arrows. | 20 |
zh: |速度| v |箭头的速度。 |20|

source: | statsScale | ss | Multiply the damage dealt by each arrow by this factor. | 1 |
zh: |统计规模 | SS |将每支箭造成的伤害乘以该系数。 |1|

source: | scalePerArrow | spa | Stats Scale attribute supports placeholders, setting this to true will parse those placeholders again for every arrow. | false |
zh: |按箭头缩放 |水疗 |属性比例基础属性支持占位符，将其设置为true将为每个箭头再次解析这些占位符。 |false|

source: | arrowItem | item. ai | Filter of the item to fire, preferably an arrow. Important for some plugins. | v ARROW ~ |
zh: |箭头项目 |物品。艾|物品的过滤器要发射，最好是箭头。对于某些插件很重要。 | v 箭头 ~ |

source: | fullEvent | fe | Setting this to true will cause the arrows to call the EntityShootBowEvent event for every arrow, which makes ALL plugins detect it and perform operations as if the player had actually fired a bow like this. With the default value of 'false', only MMOItems runs these calculations, which means that if you have other plugins like mcMMO they will not apply their effects to arrows, which might be desirable or not per your situation. | false |
zh: |完整活动 |铁|将其设置为true将导致箭头为每个箭头调用 EntityShootBowEvent 事件，这使得所有插件都检测到它并执行操作，就像玩家实际上发射了这样的弓一样。使用默认值“false”，只有MMOItems运行这些计算，这意味着如果你有其他插件（例如 mcMMO），它们不会将其效果应用于箭头，这可能是你需要的，也可能不是你的情况。 |false|

source: These options affect the location the arrows are fired from, though they will always be directed at the target of the skill.
zh: 这些选项会影响箭的发射位置，但它们始终会指向技能的目标。

source: | fromOrigin | fo | Arrows are fired from the origin of the skill. | false |
zh: |来源 |佛 |箭从技能的原点发射。 |false|

source: | startXOffset | sxo | Shifts arrow spawn in the X coordinate. | 0 |
zh: |开始X偏移| SXO |在 X 坐标中移动箭头生成。 |0|

source: | startYOffset | syo | Shifts arrow spawn in the Y coordinate. | 3 |
zh: |起始Y偏移| syo |在 Y 坐标中移动箭头生成。 |3|

source: | startZOffset | szo | Shifts arrow spawn in the Z coordinate. | 0 |
zh: |开始Z偏移| szo |在 Z 坐标中移动箭头生成。 |0|

source: | startFOffset | sfo | Shifts arrow spawn forward relative to the caster. | 0 |
zh: |起始偏移量 |旧金山国际机场 |相对于施法者向前移动箭头的生成位置。 |0|

source: | startSOffset | sso | Shifts arrow spawn rightward relative to the caster. | 0 |
zh: |开始偏移|单点登录 |相对于施法者向右移动箭头生成点。 |0|

source: *Note that this mechanic only works for players, and will reduce to the MythicMobs' usual ArrowVolley if fired by a NPC or monster, and will only support the parameters from that mechanic (most notably, the offsets for the spawn location of arrows won't work).*
zh: *请注意，此机制仅适用于玩家，如果由 NPC 或怪物发射，则会减少到MythicMobs的通常 ArrowVolley，并且仅支持该机制的参数（最值得注意的是，箭头的生成位置的偏移将不起作用）。*

zh: 请注意，这永远不会对怪物触发，因为怪物无法使用特殊攻击。

source: 🦾 Built-in Compatibility
zh: 🦾Built-in兼容性

source: This section lists all built-in compatibilities implemented into MMOItems.
zh: 本节列出了MMOItems中实现的所有built-in兼容性。

source: WorldGuard Flags
zh: WorldGuard标志

source: MythicLib implements new flags that work for both MMOCore and MMOItems. See the [full list here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/compatibility#flag-plugins).
zh: MythicLib实现了适用于MMOCore和MMOItems的新标志。请参阅[此处的完整列表](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/compatibility#flag-plugins)。

source: Like any other plugin, [WorldGuard](http://www.enginehub.org/worldguard) should be detected automatically by MMOItems when the server is booting. You can check the console when the plugin is loading to make sure it was detected.
zh: 与任何其他插件一样，[WorldGuard](http://www.enginehub.org/worldguard)应在服务器启动时由MMOItems自动检测到。你可以在加载插件时检查控制台，以确保检测到它。

source: Custom Enchantments plugins
zh: 自定义附魔插件

source: MMOItems is compatible with EcoEnchants, MythicEnchants and AdvancedEnchants (not recommended). It is most likely not natively compatible with other enchantment plugins, though well designed enchantment plugins should have no issues (for instance, EcoEnchants). More information over [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/compatibility/enchant-plugins).
zh: MMOItems与 EcoEnchants、MythicEnchants 和 AdvancedEnchants 兼容（不推荐）。它很可能与其他附魔插件本身不兼容，尽管设计良好的附魔插件应该没有问题（例如，EcoEnchants）。更多信息请参见[此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/compatibility/enchant-plugins)。

source: RPG Plugins
zh: RPG插件

source: > We recommend using [MMOCore](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/70575/) for full native plugin compatibility.
zh: > 我们建议使用 [MMOCore](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/70575/)以获得完整的本机插件兼容性。

source: MMOItems supports levels, classes and mana/stamina from the [following plugins](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/compatibility#rpg-plugins). Levels and classes from these plugins are forwarded to MMOItems in order to apply class and level requirements for items.
zh: MMOItems支持来自[以下插件](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/features/compatibility#rpg-plugins)的等级、职业和魔力/耐力。  这些插件中的等级和职业被转发到MMOItems，以便将职业和等级要求应用于物品。

source: While most RPG core plugins feature Mana, the *Max Mana* stat ONLY works with MMOCore, Heroes and the built-in MythicLib Mana/Stamina module. Other plugins do not allow providing temporary stats to players, so it is impossible for MythicLib to provide Max Mana/Stamina to players.
zh: 虽然大多数RPG核心插件具有魔力功能，但 *Max魔力*属性仅适用于MMOCore、Heroes和built-inMythicLib魔力/耐力模块。其他插件不允许向玩家提供临时属性，因此MythicLib不可能向玩家提供最大魔力/耐力。

source: RPGInventory
zh: 角色扮演游戏物品栏

source: MMOItems supports [RPGInventory](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/12498/): players can equip items from MMOItems in their custom inventory and benefit from their stats. However since RPGInventory does not support item attribute modifiers, stats based on vanilla attribute modifiers like attack speed, max health & movement speed won't apply on non-armor/hand item slots (i.e extra slots like accessory slots). Any other item effect will work fine.
zh: MMOItems支持 [RPGInventory](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/12498/)：玩家可以在其自定义物品栏中装备MMOItems中的物品，并从其属性中受益。然而，由于 RPGInventory 不支持物品基础属性修饰符，因此基于原版基础属性修饰符（如攻击速度、最大生命值和移动速度）的属性不适用于non-armor/手物品插槽（i.e额外插槽，如配件插槽）。任何其他物品效果都可以正常工作。

source: MMOInventory however works flawlessly with MMOItems.
zh: 然而，MMOInventory可以与MMOItems完美配合。

source: 📦 Custom Blocks
zh: 📦 自定义块

source: Using MMOItems 5+ you may implement blocks with a custom texture. You can even make them spawn and define how rare they are using [world generation templates](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/world-gen-templates), configure with what tool it should be broken by players, decide what it loots using MMOItems drop tables and bind a random amount of exp to it.
zh: 使用MMOItems5+ 你可以实现具有自定义纹理的块。你甚至可以让它们生成并使用[世界生成模板](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/world-gen-templates)] 定义它们的稀有程度，使用玩家破坏它的工具进行配置，使用MMOItems掉落表决定它会掠夺什么，并将随机数量的 exp 绑定到它。

source: **[DOWNLOAD REQUIRED RESOURCE PACK HERE](https://www.dropbox.com/s/90w9pvdbfeyxu94/MICustomBlockPack.zip?dl=1)**
zh: **[在此下载所需的资源包](https://www.dropbox.com/s/90w9pvdbfeyxu94/MICustomBlockPack.zip?dl=1)**

source: `required-power` defines the pickaxe power your tool must have in order to break that block. If it is set to 3, players must use a tool with a `Pickaxe Power` higher than 3. When breaking a custom block, MMOItems rolls a random amount of exp chosen between `min-xp` and `max-xp` and spawns an exp orb on the block just like regular ores.
zh: `required-power`定义了工具必须具有的镐功率才能打破该块。如果设置为3，则玩家必须使用`Pickaxe Power`高于3的工具。当破坏自定义块时，MMOItems会滚动在`min-xp`和`max-xp`之间选择的随机数量的 exp，并像普通矿石一样在块上生成一个 exp 球。

source: `gen-template` is the custom block [generation template](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/world-gen-templates). It defines where this block may spawn and how rare it is.
zh: `gen-template`是自定义块[生成模板](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/world-gen-templates)。它定义了该块可能产生的位置以及它的稀有程度。

source: Post Install Notes
zh: 安装后注意事项

source: **Custom blocks will now behave like regular mmoitems.** This means they will be editable through /mi browse. The blocks should also now be safe to give to players for them to use. This is because they are placed like regular blocks now. If you do allow players to use custom blocks make sure `replace-mushroom-drops` is set to true in the config.yml or else things will be exploitable.
zh: **自定义方块现在与普通 MMOItems 物品的行为相同。**可以通过 /mi browse 编辑，也可以交给玩家正常使用，因为它们现在按普通方块的方式放置。如果允许玩家使用自定义方块，务必在 config.yml 中将 `replace-mushroom-drops` 设为 true，否则可能被利用。

source: Whenever you make a change with the blocks via the gui the plugin must be reloaded. Either a restart or use of /mi reload.
zh: 每次通过界面修改方块后，都必须重载插件：重启服务器或执行 /mi reload。

source: 🔨 Custom Durability
zh: 🔨自定义耐久度

source: > Since 1.20.6 Minecraft has introduced a tag to edit the maximum vanilla durability of items. We recommend users to use this over custom durability!
zh: > Minecraft 从 1.20.6 开始提供了修改物品最大原版耐久度的标签。建议使用它，替代自定义耐久度！

source: Custom durability is a really powerful system that allows you to create items with a set amount of uses, unlike the <1.20.5 vanilla durability system which forces you to always have the same max amount of uses for a type of item.
zh: 自定义耐久度可以让物品拥有指定的使用次数。相比之下，1.20.5 以前的原版耐久度系统，同一类物品的最大使用次数始终相同。

source: All items feature the *Max Custom Durability* stat, which defines how many times an item can be used before either **breaking** or **becoming unusable**. The *Lost when Broken* item option defines whether or not the item should be lost when reaching 0 durability.
zh: 所有物品都有*最大自定义耐久度（Max Custom Durability）*属性，决定物品在**损坏**或**变为无法使用**前可使用的次数。*损坏时消失（Lost when Broken）*选项决定耐久度降到 0 时，物品是否消失。

source: Durability is displayed on the item vanilla durability bar, however you may also display the player's held item durability using PAPI placeholders. Items can be repaired only using repairing consumables.
zh: 耐久度显示在原版物品耐久条上，也可以通过 PAPI 占位符显示玩家手持物品的耐久度。物品只能使用带修复功能的消耗品进行修复。

source: 1.20.5+ Durability

Minecraft 1.20.5 introduced a new item tag which allows you to modify an item's maximum vanilla durability. This tag is fully supported by recent MMOItems builds. We encourage users to switch to this system as the primary reason why MMOItems introduced custom durability was the impossibility to change an item's maximum durability. Now that this has been changed, you no longer need MMOItems custom durability.
zh: Minecraft 1.20.5 加入了修改物品最大原版耐久度的标签，近期的 MMOItems 构建已完整支持。建议改用此系统：MMOItems 最初加入自定义耐久度，主要是因为原版无法修改物品最大耐久度；既然这一限制已经解除，就不再需要依赖 MMOItems 的自定义耐久度。

source: This does not fix the issue of having items which cannot have a durability bar at all, like apples, blocks and most items. An easy workaround is to use a breakable tool like a pickaxe or a shovel and change its texture using a resource pack if you really need a durability bar.
zh: 这仍无法让苹果、方块等原本没有耐久条的物品显示耐久条。如果确实需要耐久条，可以改用镐、锹等带耐久度的工具，再通过资源包更换其贴图。

source: **We encourage users moving to vanilla durability as it is generally better for compatibility with external plugin features, and because MMOItems fully supports it.**
zh: **建议改用原版耐久度，因为它通常与其他插件的功能兼容得更好，而且 MMOItems 已完整支持。**

source: 🥘 Crafting Recipes
zh: 🥘合成配方

source: MMOItems allows you to register custom recipes where you can use blocks such as crafting tables, furnaces and even campfires to craft MMOItems. Items can have multiple recipes both in the same crafting type or in different crafting types entirely. For example, if you wanted the player to be able to cook a Gourmet Steak you can register that item's recipe under either a furnace, a smoker, a campfire or all three. You would simply have to create a recipe for all three crafting types. Recipes support both vanilla items and MMOItems. In addition, any recipe you create that would have a vanilla equivalent such as crafting a stone block into a stone button will be overridden by the custom recipe. Remember that every time you create a new recipe or edit an existing one, you must do /mi reload recipes
zh: MMOItems 支持注册自定义配方，通过工作台、熔炉甚至营火合成 MMOItems 物品。同一物品可以在相同或不同的合成类型下拥有多个配方。例如，希望玩家通过熔炉、烟熏炉和营火中的任意一种方式烹饪 Gourmet Steak，就分别为这三种合成类型创建配方。配方支持原版物品和 MMOItems 物品。如果自定义配方与原版配方相同，例如用石头合成石质按钮，会覆盖对应的原版配方。每次新建或修改配方后，都必须执行 /mi reload recipes。

source: There are 9 different crafting types that you can assign to an item and each type corresponds to the crafting block or command.
zh: 你可以将9不同的制作类型分配给物品，每种类型对应于制作块或命令。

source: The initial set-up for creating a craftable item is the same as any other MMOItem, where you define its stats, name, lore, etc. However, under the base level, you add a crafting option and beneath that option, you add the crafting type. The 9 crafting types currently available are: smithing, supershaped, smoker, furnace, shaped, megashaped, campfire, shapeless, blast. The names are fairly self-explanatory.
zh: 创建可合成物品的初始步骤与其他 MMOItem 相同，先定义属性、名称和描述等内容。随后在 base 下添加 crafting，再在其中添加合成类型。目前有 9 种类型：smithing、supershaped、smoker、furnace、shaped、megashaped、campfire、shapeless、blast。名称对应各自的合成方式。

source: **The use of the GUI Item Editor is HIGHLY RECOMMENDED as it makes visualizing these recipes a lot easier.**
zh: **强烈建议使用GUI物品编辑器，因为它使这些配方的可视化变得更加容易。**

source: If you want to assign multiple recipes to different crafting types, you just add another crafting type on the level beneath crafting.
zh: 如果要为不同的合成类型分别设置多个配方，只需在 crafting 下再添加一个合成类型。

source: Smithing Table Recipes
zh: 锻造台配方

source: Smithing table recipes are the way you would want to upgrade your items. To set an item's recipe under a smithing table, set the crafting type as smithing. Smithing table recipes have several options.
zh: Smithing table recipes are the way you would want to upgrade your物品. To set an物品's recipe under a smithing table, set the crafting type as smithing.锻造台配方有多种选​​择。

source: input are what items the player must **"input"** or insert into the slots. You can define these items as either MMOItems or Vanilla items. At its base, it looks like this.
zh: input are what物品the玩家must **"input"** or insert into the slots. You can define these物品as eitherMMOItemsor原版物品.在它的底部，它看起来像这样。

source: input also determines which slot the items go into. The slot on the left corresponds to the first input and the slot on the right corresponds to the second input. The GUI is highly recommended for this as it makes viewing the recipe much easier.
zh: input also determines which slot the物品go into. The slot on the left corresponds to the first input and the slot on the right corresponds to the second input. TheGUIis highly recommended for this as it makes viewing the recipe much easier.

source: **drop-gems:** makes any gems that are slotted into an MMOItem to be dropped and thus recoverable when the player crafts the item. Can be true or false.
zh: **drop-gems：** 使任何插入 MMOItem 的宝石都会被丢弃，从而在玩家制作物品时可恢复。可以是true或false。

source: **upgrades:** dictates what happens to any upgrades (the +X you see when an item gets upgraded) that may have been present on the MMOItems used as ingredients. You have several options: ADDITIVE, MAXIMUM, EVEN, MINIMUM and NONE. ADDITIVE adds the upgrade levels up, so a +1 item and a +3 item will return a +4 item. MAXIMUM will give the higher upgrade level. So a +1 item and a +3 item will return a +3 item. EVEN will average the upgrade levels. So a +1 item and a +3 item will return a +2 item. Minimum will give the lower upgrade level. So a +1 item and a +3 item will return a +1 item. NONE does not retain any upgrade levels.
zh: **升级：** 指示用作成分的MMOItems上可能存在的任何升级（物品升级时看到的 +X）会发生什么情况。 You have several options: ADDITIVE, MAXIMUM, EVEN, MINIMUM and NONE. ADDITIVE adds the upgrade levels up, so a +1物品and a +3物品will return a +4物品. MAXIMUM将给予更高的升级等级。 So a +1物品and a +3物品will return a +3物品. EVEN 将平均升级等级。 So a +1物品and a +3物品will return a +2物品.最低将给出较低的升级等级。 So a +1物品and a +3物品will return a +1物品. NONE 不保留任何升级等级。

source: **enchantments:** dictates what happens to any enchantment on the ingredients when you craft the item. It has the same options as upgrades and they do the exact same thing.
zh: **附魔：** 指示当你制作物品时，成分上的任何附魔会发生什么。它具有与升级相同的选项，并且执行完全相同的操作。

source: **output:** dictates what ingredients will not be consumed upon crafting the item (Like a bucket of milk becoming an empty bucket in a cake recipe). It's defined the same way as input. The items here do not have to be the same as in input however and can be something entirely different.
zh: **输出：**决定了制作物品时不会消耗哪些成分（就像蛋糕配方中的一桶牛奶变成了空桶）。它的定义方式与输入相同。不过，此处的物品不必与输入中的相同，也可以完全不同。

source: **amount** defines how many items this recipe will create.
zh: **数量** 定义此配方将创建多少个物品。

source: Shaped, Super Shaped and Mega Shaped recipes all share the same options. However, Shaped recipes can be hidden from the recipe book. Shaped simply means that the ingredients must be in a specific layout in order for the item to be craftable, a bit like how you can only craft a stone pickaxe one way. Super Shaped and Mega Shaped are the same thing but bigger. You access these crafting tables by doing /superworkbench or /swb and /megaworkbench or /mwb respectively. Super Shaped is a 5x5 grid and Mega Shaped is a 6x6 grid.
zh: 形状、超级形状和巨型形状配方都共享相同的选项。但是，形状配方可以从配方书中隐藏。形状仅仅意味着成分必须处于特定的布局中才能使物品能够制作，有点像只能以一种方式制作石镐。超级形状和巨型形状是相同的东西，但更大。你可以通过分别执行 /superworkbench 或 /swb 和 /megaworkbench 或 /mwb 来访问这些工作表。 Super Shaped 是 5x5 网格，Mega Shaped 是 6x6 网格。

source: 💎 Gem Stones
zh: 💎 宝石

source: You can create gem stones using the `GEM_STONE` item type. Gem stones are special items that you can drag & drop onto other items to give them extra stats. The item you're applying the gem on has to have at least one empty gem socket. Item restrictions (perms/class/level) apply on gem stone application just like a regular item.
zh: 你可以使用`GEM_STONE`物品类型创建宝石。宝石是特殊的物品，你可以将其拖放到其他物品上，为它们提供额外的属性。你要应用宝石的物品必须至少有一个空的宝石插槽。物品限制（权限/职业/等级）适用于宝石应用，就像常规物品一样。

source: Moreover, you can give **item type restrictions** to a gem so it can only be applied on a set number of items. This way, if you have, let's say, a gem that is supposed to give extra damage to weapons by sharpening the blade edge, you can make it so it can't be applied onto armors which would not make much sense because why the heck would you try to sharpen an armor.
zh: 此外，你可以给 gem 赋予**物品类型限制**，这样它只能应用于一定数量的物品。这样，如果你有一颗宝石，它应该通过锐化刀刃对武器造成额外伤害，那么你可以将其制作成不能应用于盔甲上，这没有多大意义，因为你到底为什么要尝试锐化护甲。

source: Gem stones may also apply abilities onto your weapons. *Coming soon: potion & particle effects.*
zh: 宝石也可以将能力应用到你的武器上。 *即将推出：药水和粒子效果。*

source: Applying a gem onto another item sometimes fails. If the gem isn't successfully applied, the gem stone will be lost and the item will receive no extra stat. The gem socket will not be used nevertheless.
zh: 将宝石应用到另一个物品上有时会失败。如果宝石没有成功应用，宝石将会丢失，并且物品将不会获得额外的属性。不过宝石插槽不会被使用。

source: Socket Colors
zh: 插座颜色

source: Every gem stone and gem socket has a color. You can only apply a colored gem stone onto a gem socket of the same color. The gem color can be edited using the edition GUI and is NOT displayed on the lore tag *yet*.
zh: 每颗宝石和宝石插槽都有一种颜色。你只能将彩色宝石镶嵌到相同颜色的宝石插槽上。宝石颜色可以使用版本GUI进行编辑，并且*尚未*显示在描述标签上。

source: You can display the gem color on an item using the `Displayed Type` option. For example, if your gem is a blue gem stone, set the displayed type option to `Blue Gem Stone`. By default, the item type is a red lore tag which is displayed right under the item name. You may also display the gem color using a different material, like a blue diamond for blue gem stones. Last but not least you may also use the item lore (`Can be applied onto blue sockets.`).
zh: 你可以使用`Displayed Type`选项在物品上显示宝石颜色。例如，如果你的宝石是蓝色宝石，请将显示的类型选项设置为`Blue Gem Stone`。默认情况下，物品类型是红色描述标签，显示在物品名称的正下方。你还可以使用不同的材料来显示宝石颜色，例如蓝色宝石使用蓝色钻石。最后但并非最不重要的一点是，你还可以使用物品描述(`Can be applied onto blue sockets.`)。

source: The socket names are case sensitive. If your item has a `Blue` gem socket, make sure your gem stone color is `Blue`.
zh: 套接字名称区分大小写。如果你的物品有`Blue`宝石插槽，请确保你的宝石颜色为`Blue`。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/gem_stone_color.mDxowzo-.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/gem_stone_color.mDxowzo-.png)

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_socket_color.EcLxv1jv.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_socket_color.EcLxv1jv.png)

source: Uncoloured Sockets
zh: 未着色插座

source: Gems with no gem color can be applied onto any gem socket. Similarly, uncolored gem sockets can receive any gem stone. Gem stones which gem colors are not specified (in the item edition menu) are considered uncolored. To setup an uncolored gem socket, make sure the input socket color is the exact same as the string setup in the main plugin config:
zh: 没有宝石颜色的宝石可以应用到任何宝石插槽上。同样，无色宝石插槽可以容纳任何宝石。未指定宝石颜色的宝石（在物品版本菜单中）被视为无色。要设置未着色的 gem 套接字，请确保输入套接字颜色与主插件配置中的字符串设置完全相同：

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/uncolored_socket.CVKR3dp6.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/uncolored_socket.CVKR3dp6.png)

source: If you don't want to utilize the gem color system, simply create items with uncoloured sockets and don't specify a gem color when creating gem stones. Additionally, you may also change the `gem-socket` display in *stats.yml* so it does not display the gem color whatsoever.
zh: 如果你不想使用宝石颜色系统，只需创建带有未着色插槽的物品，并且在创建宝石时不要指定宝石颜色。此外，你还可以更改 *stats.yml* 中的`gem-socket`显示，这样它就不会显示任何宝石颜色。

source: Removing Gemstones
zh: 移除宝石

source: To remove a gemstone from an item, a consumable would have to be created featuring the *Random Unsocket* option. Setting this option to `1` will remove 1 random gemstone from the item. To remove all of the gems off the item, simply set the value to something higher.
zh: 要从物品中移除宝石，必须创建具有 *Random Unsocket* 选项的消耗品。将此选项设置为`1`将从物品中删除1随机宝石。要删除物品上的所有宝石，只需将该值设置为更高的值即可。

source: To prevent the consumable from accidentally being eaten instead of applied to the item, you may enable the `inedible` option. This way, the consumable will only work when drag & dropped onto an item inside the player inventory.
zh: 为了防止消耗品意外被吃掉而不是应用于物品，你可以启用`inedible`选项。这样，消耗品仅在拖放到玩家物品栏内的物品上时才起作用。

source: 🔮 Identification
zh: 🔮 身份识别

source: Blocks or monsters (or any loot table) may sometimes drop **unidentified items**. These items have their data completely hidden and will require the player to identify it in order to be used. The only actual info players have on unidentified items is the item material, type, item level range (more or less 3 levels) and tier.
zh: 方块或怪物（或任何战利品表）有时可能会掉落**身份不明的物品**。这些物品的数据完全隐藏，需要玩家识别才能使用。玩家对未识别的物品的唯一实际信息是物品材料、类型、物品等级范围（或多或少的3等级）和层。

source: A special property is available to consumables to have them able to identify items. If a consumable has the *Can Identify* option toggled on, they can be drag and dropped onto an item to identify them. Item identification is confirmed by a chat message & sound effect.
zh: 消耗品可以使用特殊属性来识别物品。如果消耗品的“可以识别”选项已打开，则可以将它们拖放到物品上以识别它们。物品身份通过聊天消息和音效确认。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/identify_item.CLyz8sHP.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/identify_item.CLyz8sHP.gif)

source: Commands
zh: 命令

source: The following commands identify/unidentify the item that you are holding in hand.
zh: 以下命令可识别/取消识别你手中持有的物品。

source: Translation
zh: 翻译

source: You can change the way unidentified items look inside the `item-types.yml` config file. Every item type has a different template for unidentified items:
zh: 你可以更改未识别的物品在`item-types.yml`配置文件中的查看方式。每个物品类型对于未识别的物品都有不同的模板：

source: 📜 Item Lore
zh: 📜物品描述

source: 📜 Lore Format
zh: 📜描述格式

source: Lore Formats determine how the lore of your items look. You can find the default lore-format.yml file in the languages folder. Additional formats can be added to the lore-formats folder inside languages. Your formats will load whenever you start the server or when you reload the plugin.
zh: 描述格式决定了物品的描述的外观。你可以在 languages 文件夹中找到默认的lore-format.yml文件。可以将其他格式添加到语言内的lore-formats文件夹中。每当你启动服务器或重新加载插件时，你的格式都会加载。

source: Besides, MMOItems supports [MiniMessage](https://docs.adventure.kyori.net/minimessage/format.html)! You can now use MiniMessage color codes and text decorations inside of your item lore!
zh: 另外，MMOItems支持【微信](https://docs.adventure.kyori.net/minimessage/format.html)！你现在可以在物品描述内使用 MiniMessage 颜色代码和文本装饰！

source: Creating and Using a Lore Format
zh: 创建和使用描述格式

source: To create a new lore format, simply copy-paste the default lore-format.yml file into the folder and start editing. Your new lore format will be assigned an id which is equal to the filename inside the folder. Use this ID to assign your new lore-format to an item.
zh: 要创建新的描述格式，只需将默认的copy-paste文件放入lore-format.yml文件夹中并开始编辑即可。你的新描述格式将被分配一个 ID，该 ID 等于文件夹内的文件名。使用此ID将新的lore-format分配给物品。

source: Default Lore Format
zh: 默认描述格式

source: 🏷️ Name Placeholders
zh: 🏷️名字占位符

source: > In the future these will be extended to the full item lore, and not only its item name
zh: > 将来这些将扩展为完整的物品描述，而不仅仅是其物品名称

source: Display name placeholders are designed to make item creation consistent by making item names uniform and dynamic. Whenever defining the item's display name simply put the usage placeholder somewhere and it will auto replace.
zh: 显示名称占位符旨在通过使物品名称统一和动态来使物品创建一致。每当定义物品的显示名称时，只需将用法占位符放在某处，它就会自动替换。

source: | Placeholder | Usage | Description |
zh: |占位符|用途 |描述 |

source: | Tier Name | `<tier-name>` | Displays the unformatted name of the item's tier. |

source: | Tier Color | `<tier-color>` | Acts as the color code of the item's tier's name. |
zh: |层颜色 |`<tier-color>`|充当物品层名称的颜色代码。 |

source: | Tier Color Cleaned | `<tier-color-cleaned>` | Does the same as Tier Color, but removes the Bold, Italic, Underline, Strike, and Magic. |
zh: |层颜色清洁 |`<tier-color-cleaned>`|与层颜色相同，但删除粗体、斜体、下划线、删除线和魔术。 |

source: 🖼️ Item Tooltips
zh: 🖼️物品工具提示

source: Tooltips are what players see when hovering an item inside any inventory. While vanilla Minecraft does feature an option to modify the tooltip texture of any item, this functionality is very limited (color only). Although it is also possible to manually setup custom tooltips without using the dedicated MMOItems feature, MMOItems makes it more systematic and very much easier.
zh: 当将物品悬停在任何物品栏内时，玩家会看到工具提示。虽然原版Minecraft确实具有修改任何物品的工具提示纹理的选项，但此功能非常有限（仅限颜色）。尽管也可以在不使用专用MMOItems功能的情况下手动设置自定义工具提示，但MMOItems使其更加系统化且更加容易。

source: Specific tooltips can be bound to items, tiers, item types or even item modifiers. Specific tooltips bound directly to items and modifiers have precedence over tooltips granted by item tiers, and item tiers also have tooltip precedence over item type tooltips.
zh: 特定的工具提示可以绑定到物品、层、物品类型甚至物品修饰器。直接绑定到物品和修饰符的特定工具提示优先于物品品质授予的工具提示，并且物品品质的工具提示也优先于物品类型的工具提示。

source: General Principle & Examples
zh: 一般原则和示例

source: Tooltips are entirely based on custom fonts as well as the [negative space font pack](https://github.com/AmberWat/NegativeSpaceFont). MMOItems injects custom fonts inside the item display name and lore to give the impression of a tooltip background texture.
zh: 工具提示完全基于自定义字体以及[负空格字体包](https://github.com/AmberWat/NegativeSpaceFont)。MMOItems在物品显示名称和描述中注入自定义字体，以给人工具提示背景纹理的印象。

source: ![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_ex_1.nBTXNtJu.png)![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_ex_2.DGpmT2QG.png)![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_ex_3.vtnaJwDX.png)
zh: ![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_ex_1.nBTXNtJu.png)![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_ex_2.DGpmT2QG.png)![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_ex_3.vtnaJwDX.png)

source: MMOItems provides three example tooltip configs (see above). These tooltips utilize textures from the [MMOItems Default Resource Pack](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmoitems-default-resource-pack), so make sure you download it and install it on your server beforehand. After installing this resource pack, give yourself the following items (these are all swords): `TOOLTIP_COPPER_SWORD`, `TOOLTIP_SILVER_SWORD` and `TOOLTIP_GOLD_SWORD`.
zh: MMOItems提供了三个示例工具提示配置（见上文）。这些工具提示使用 [MMOItems默认资源包](https://gitlab.com/phoenix-dvpmt/mmoitems-default-resource-pack)中的纹理，因此请确保事先下载它并将其安装在服务器上。安装此资源包后，给自己以下物品（这些都是剑）：`TOOLTIP_COPPER_SWORD`、`TOOLTIP_SILVER_SWORD`和`TOOLTIP_GOLD_SWORD`。

source: How to create custom tooltips
zh: 如何创建自定义工具提示

source: Head to the `/tooltips` folder in your main MMOItems folder. All tooltip configs should be placed inside this folder. One YAML file may contain multiple tooltip configs, and you can group configs inside subfolders to have an organized folder hierarchy.
zh: 转到主MMOItems文件夹中的`/tooltips`文件夹。所有工具提示配置都应放置在此文件夹中。一个YAML文件可能包含多个工具提示配置，你可以将子文件夹内的配置分组以形成有组织的文件夹层次结构。

source: There are three steps when creating custom tooltips for MMOItems:
zh: 为MMOItems创建自定义工具提示分为三个步骤：

source: drawing the actual tooltip textures following the few constraints associated with using custom fonts,
zh: 遵循与使用自定义字体相关的一些限制来绘制实际的工具提示纹理，

source: binding these textures to random unicode characters
zh: 将这些纹理绑定到随机 unicode 字符

source: setting up the MMOItems config files.
zh: 设置MMOItems配置文件。

source: For our tutorial, we will be using the following item (located inside the `item/sword.yml` config file).
zh: 在我们的教程中，我们将使用以下物品（位于`item/sword.yml`配置文件内）。

source: 1/ Textures
zh: 1/ 纹理

source: The first step to creating custom tooltips is drawing the tooltip textures. Tooltip textures are split into three different textures:
zh: 创建自定义工具提示的第一步是绘制工具提示纹理。工具提示纹理分为三种不同的纹理：

source: The `top` texture, which generally includes the item display name and optionally item type and tier,
zh: `top`纹理，通常包括物品显示名称以及可选的物品类型和层，

source: The `middle` texture, a very simple pattern that gets copy-n-pasted once for every extra line in the item lore,
zh: `middle`纹理，一个非常简单的图案，对于物品描述中的每一条额外线，都会获得一次copy-n-pasted，

source: The `bottom` texture, which is the bottom of the tooltip texture.
zh: `bottom`纹理，它是工具提示纹理的底部。

source: You can find below the tooltip textures of the default `gold` tooltip. **Make sure that your textures are at most 255 pixels wide!** This is the only major constraint when working with custom fonts.
zh: 你可以在下面找到默认`gold`工具提示的工具提示纹理。 **确保你的纹理最多为255像素宽！​​* 这是使用自定义字体时唯一的主要限制。

source: ![](data:image/png;base64,)
zh: ![](data:image/png;base64,)

zh: ![](data:image/png;base64,)

source: When an item is being generated, MMOItems injects the `top` texture at the beginning of the item display name. It then injects the `middle` texture at the beginning of every lore line (except the last one). The last lore line instead receives the `bottom` texture. Negative space fonts are crucial here, as MMOItems use them to align text and textures.
zh: 生成物品时，MMOItems会在物品显示名称的开头注入`top`纹理。然后，它在每个描述行的开头注入`middle`纹理（最后一行除外）。最后描述行改为接收`bottom`纹理。负空间字体在这里至关重要，因为MMOItems使用它们来对齐文本和纹理。

source: As you might have realized, the width of these textures is static. Unlike vanilla tooltips which expand to the longest lore line of the item, custom tooltip textures do not expand. You need to hard-pick a width for your tooltips and make sure your lore lines do not clip out. This is a known limitation of the current tooltip system (which might be expanded later on to support multiple tooltip widths).
zh: 你可能已经意识到，这些纹理的宽度是静态的。与扩展到物品最长的描述行的原版工具提示不同，自定义工具提示纹理不会扩展。你需要为工具提示设置hard-pick的宽度，并确保描述线条不会被剪掉。这是当前工具提示系统的已知限制（稍后可能会扩展以支持多种工具提示宽度）。

source: 2/ Resource Pack Configs
zh: 2/ 资源包配置

source: Install your tooltip textures inside your resource pack. For this tutorial, let's pretend they are located inside the folder `assets/tooltip_tutorial/textures/gold/`.
zh: 在资源包中安装工具提示纹理。对于本教程，我们假设它们位于文件夹`assets/tooltip_tutorial/textures/gold/`内。

source: First make sure your server resource pack includes the [negative space font pack](https://github.com/AmberWat/NegativeSpaceFont). Then, head to your `assets/minecraft/font/default.json` config and add the following entries to your font map.
zh: 首先确保你的服务器资源包包含[负空格字体包](https://github.com/AmberWat/NegativeSpaceFont)。然后，前往`assets/minecraft/font/default.json`配置并将以下条目添加到字体映射中。

source: As usual with custom fonts, there is one entry per texture.
zh: 与自定义字体一样，每个纹理有一个条目。

source: The `file` parameter corresponds to the path of your texture. Here, the namespace we chose for our textures/assets is `tooltip_tutorial`, but it can be anything you want.
zh: `file`参数对应于纹理的路径。在这里，我们为纹理/资源选择的命名空间是`tooltip_tutorial`，但它可以是你想要的任何名称。

source: Make sure the `height` parameter exactly matches the height (in pixels) of your texture file, otherwise your in-game tooltip texture will look very weird.
zh: 确保`height`参数与纹理文件的高度（以像素为单位）完全匹配，否则in-game工具提示纹理将看起来非常奇怪。

source: The `ascent` parameter must be fine-tuned in-game to make sure there are no gaps in your tooltip. First set it to something like half the height, reload your resource pack in-game and correct it.
zh: `ascent`参数必须是fine-tunedin-game以确保工具提示中没有间隙。首先将其设置为高度的一半，重新加载资源包in-game并更正它。

source: The `chars` field is where you select the unicode char. Take some unicode char that you are not using yet and store it somewhere, as we will need it later when setting up MMOItems configs.
zh: `chars`字段是你选择 unicode 字符的位置。获取一些你尚未使用的 unicode 字符并将其存储在某处，因为我们稍后在设置MMOItems配置时将需要它。

source: 3/ MMOItems Configs
zh: 3/MMOItems配置

source: You will find below one of the three tooltip config included in the default MMOItems config files. These can be found in the `tooltips/example_tooltips.yml` config file.
zh: 你将在下面找到默认MMOItems配置文件中包含的三个工具提示配置之一。这些可以在`tooltips/example_tooltips.yml`配置文件中找到。

source: Textures
zh: 纹理

source: `top`, `middle` and `bottom` is where you specify the unicode char used for your three textures. These options are the actual strings that will be injected into your item. These strings support custom colors, non-player based PAPI placeholders and built-in `{<value>sp}` positive/negative space placeholders, that you can use to align your three textures.
zh: `top`、`middle`和`bottom`是你指定用于三个纹理的 unicode 字符的位置。这些选项是将注入到物品中的实际字符串。这些字符串支持自定义颜色、基于non-player的 PAPI占位符和built-in`{<value>sp}`正/负空间占位符，你可以使用它们来对齐三个纹理。

source: Align Texture and Text
zh: 对齐纹理和文本

source: <summary>Step-by-step tutorial for aligning tooltip textures</summary>
zh: <summary>Step-by-step对齐工具提示纹理的教程</summary>

source: First, fill in your texture unicode characters. Add `debug: true` to your tooltip config, which will help visualizing where text would naturally align in the item lore (see screenshot below).
zh: 首先，填写纹理 unicode 字符。将`debug: true`添加到工具提示配置中，这将有助于可视化文本在物品描述中自然对齐的位置（请参见下面的屏幕截图）。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_align_1.C9I6lAkh.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_align_1.C9I6lAkh.png)

source: The first step is to align the leftsides of your tooltip to the left of the vanilla tooltip. I measured that there are 41px in between the two tooltip leftsides. This can be corrected by adding negative space fonts of value -41 **BEFORE** the tooltip texture unicode. In my case, the three textures happen to naturally align, but you might need to use different alignment values for your three textures.
zh: 第一步是将工具提示的左侧与原版工具提示的左侧对齐。我测量到两个工具提示左侧之间有41px。这可以通过在工具提示纹理 unicode **之前**添加值-41的负空格字体来纠正。就我而言，三个纹理恰好自然对齐，但你可能需要为三个纹理使用不同的对齐值。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_align_2.CXSL4J8O.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_align_2.CXSL4J8O.png)

source: Now the vanilla and custom tooltip leftsides are perfectly aligned. We now need to align the lore text with the leftmost pixel of the debug bar `| <= Vanilla Text Aligns Here`. You can do that by measuring the number of pixels in between the debug bar and the leftmost pixel of the lore text. Again, alignment values might differ for the 3 tooltip textures, but mine happen to coincide. I measured 166 pixels. Again, this can be corrected by adding negative fonts **AFTER** the tooltip texture unicode.
zh: 现在，原版和自定义工具提示左侧完美对齐。我们现在需要将描述文本与调试栏`| <= Vanilla Text Aligns Here`最左边的像素对齐。你可以通过测量调试栏和描述文本最左侧像素之间的像素数来做到这一点。同样，3工具提示纹理的对齐值可能有所不同，但我的恰好一致。我测量了166像素。同样，可以通过在工具提示纹理 unicode **之后**添加负字体来纠正此问题。

source: Boom! Here's how your item looks in-game, after toggling off the `debug` option.
zh: 繁荣！这是关闭`debug`选项后物品的外观in-game。

source: ![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_align_3.BQbHCz3N.png)
zh: ![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_align_3.BQbHCz3N.png)

source: `align_texture` is an integer; it can be used to horizontal-shift all tooltip textures at once. Usually, you want to leave it to 0 first, align all three textures using negative space, and only then shift them all at once to the left (negative value) or the right (positive value).
zh: `align_texture`为整数；它可以同时用于horizontal-shift所有工具提示纹理。通常，你希望首先将其留给0，使用负空间对齐所有三个纹理，然后才将它们一次性全部向左（负值）或向右（正值）移动。

source: `align_text` is an integer; it can be used to horizontal-shift all lore lines and item name at once. This is usually used to account for tooltip textures which are "thicker" than others. Just like the option above, you usually want to leave it to 0, align all lore lines using negative space, and only then shift them all at once using this option. In our case, our tooltip textures are as "thick" as the vanilla tooltip so there's no need to use a non-zero value.
zh: `align_text`为整数；它可以同时用于horizontal-shift所有描述行和物品名称。这通常用于解释比其他纹理“更厚”的工具提示纹理。就像上面的选项一样，你通常希望将其保留为0，使用负空间对齐所有描述行，然后才使用此选项一次将它们全部移动。在我们的例子中，我们的工具提示纹理与原版工具提示一样“厚”，因此无需使用non-zero值。

source: Displaying item type and tier
zh: 显示物品类型和等级

source: Let's now say you want to display the item type and tier right under the item name. Copy and paste the following syntax block to your tooltip config:
zh: 现在假设你要在物品名称下方显示物品类型和层。将以下语法块复制并粘贴到工具提示配置中：

source: This has the effect of inserting a set amount of lines at the very beginning of the item lore, during item generation. `{tier}` returns the item tier, and `{type}` returns the item type. `{tier}` will always return a non-empty value: if the item has no tier, this placeholder will return the value specified in the `default-tier-name` option, in the main MMOItems config file. By default, this value is set to `Common`, which explains what you see on the following screenshot.
zh: 这具有在物品生成期间在物品描述的开头插入一定数量的行的效果。`{tier}`返回物品品质，`{type}`返回物品类型。`{tier}`将始终返回non-empty值：如果物品没有层，则此占位符将返回主MMOItems配置文件中`default-tier-name`选项中指定的值。默认情况下，该值设置为`Common`，这解释了你在以下屏幕截图中看到的内容。

source: ![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_display_tier_type.BJ3tjGVj.png)
zh: ![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_display_tier_type.BJ3tjGVj.png)

source: Centering the tooltip header
zh: 使工具提示标题居中

source: The item name, tier and type look really nice, but let's say you want the item name and first lore line to be centered horizontally. This can be achieved using a few strings and proper configuration.
zh: 物品名称、层和类型看起来非常好，但假设你希望物品名称和第一行描述水平居中。这可以使用一些字符串和正确的配置来实现。

source: Set `display_name` to true if you want to center the item display name. Otherwise, MMOItems will only format the N first lore lines.
zh: 如果要将物品显示名称居中，请将`display_name`设置为true。否则，MMOItems将仅格式化前 N 行描述。

source: `lore_lines` corresponds to the amount of lines that you want centered. Here, we want to set this value to 1, because we need our lore header (that we added in the previous section) centered. By default, it is set to 0, in which case MMOItems will only center the item name (if `display_name` is toggled on).
zh: `lore_lines`对应于你想要居中的行数。在这里，我们希望将此值设置为1，因为我们需要将描述标头（我们在上一节中添加的）居中。默认情况下，它设置为0，在这种情况下，MMOItems将仅将物品名称居中（如果`display_name`已打开）。

source: The technical part...
zh: 技术部分...

source: Before moving to the other options, you need to understand how MMOItems manages to have centered texts. This is not possible in vanilla Minecraft, however it can be achieved by offseting any text by the right amount of pixels, using positive-space fonts. Let's say your tooltip is `tooltip_width` pixels wide, and that you want to center a text of length `text_length`. You can do that by offseting your text to the right by the following amount:
zh: 在转向其他选项之前，你需要了解MMOItems如何设法使文本居中。这在原版Minecraft中是不可能的，但是可以通过使用positive-space字体将任何文本偏移适量的像素来实现。假设你的工具提示宽度为`tooltip_width`像素，并且你希望将长度为`text_length`的文本居中。你可以通过将文本向右偏移以下量来做到这一点：

source: This is exactly the computation that MMOItems does. In order to do that, it needs two values: the **length of text**, and **width of tooltip**. You have to provide the tooltip width, in pixels. You can measure it in Photoshop or any other image edition software. It is the number of pixels between the leftmost pixel of the leftmost character in your in-game string, and the rightmost pixel where you want text displayed.
zh: 这正是MMOItems所做的计算。为此，它需要两个值：**文本长度**和**工具提示宽度**。你必须提供工具提示宽度（以像素为单位）。你可以在 Photoshop 或任何其他图像编辑软件中测量它。它是in-game字符串中最左边字符的最左边像素与要显示文本的最右边像素之间的像素数。

source: The length of text is harder to compute. One could wish it is as easy as multiplying the number of characters per the number of pixels per character. Unfortunately, not all characters are born equal - some are wider and some use less pixels. Actually, the width of a character is a client-side property, and depends also on the font (resource pack used). Therefore, if you plan on using centered tooltip headers, **make sure the font used in your item names are included in your server resource pack**, to make sure all players use the same font pack.
zh: 文本的长度更难计算。人们可能希望它就像将字符数乘以每个字符的像素数一样简单。不幸的是，并非所有字符都是生而平等的 - 有些字符更宽，有些字符使用的像素更少。实际上，字符的宽度是client-side属性，并且还取决于字体（使用的资源包）。因此，如果你计划使用居中的工具提示标题，**请确保物品名称中使用的字体包含在服务器资源包中**，以确保所有玩家使用相同的字体包。

source: MMOItems need to evaluate the length, in pixels, of any string. For that, it needs to know the font size, which is the width of any character. It turns out that, using the default resource pack, the width of most characters is 5, which is why `default_char_size` is set to 5. However, there are a few exceptions, which are indicated in the `char_size` array. Here are a few examples:
zh: MMOItems需要计算任何字符串的长度（以像素为单位）。为此，它需要知道字体大小，即任何字符的宽度。事实证明，使用默认资源包时，大多数字符的宽度为5，这就是为什么`default_char_size`设置为5。但是，也有一些例外情况，如`char_size`数组中所示。以下是一些示例：

source: lowercase `f` is only 4px wide
zh: 小写`f`仅4px宽

source: lowercase `i` is 1px wide, whereas uppercase `I` is 3px
zh: 小写`i`为1px宽，而大写`I`为3px

source: space character ``happens to be 3px
zh: 空格字符``恰好是3px

source: If you plan on using the default Minecraft font, you don't need to bother about these as we have already measured most of them for you. If you plan on using a different font for your server resource pack, you will have to open an image editing software, and count the pixels of any character that you plan on using inside your item names.
zh: 如果你打算使用默认的Minecraft字体，则无需担心这些，因为我们已经为你测量了其中的大部分字体。如果你计划为服务器资源包使用不同的字体，则必须打开图像编辑软件，并计算你计划在物品名称中使用的任何字符的像素。

source: Finally, the `regex` is the regex expression for characters that should be taken into account when counting the width of a given line. If a character is found inside a lore line and does not match this regex, it will simply be ignored. **This is typically used to avoid counting unicode characters used in custom fonts and color codes.** Doing a regex tutorial here would be very much out-of-scope, so please look it up online if you don't know about it. The default value is set to include *lowercase and uppercase roman litterals, commas, +'s and brackets (used when upgrading items) and spaces*.
zh: 最后，`regex`是计算给定行宽度时应考虑的字符的正则表达式。如果在描述行中找到一个字符并且与该正则表达式不匹配，它将被忽略。 **这通常用于避免计算自定义字体和颜色代码中使用的 unicode 字符。** 在这里做一个正则表达式教程将非常out-of-scope，所以如果你不知道的话请在线查找。默认值设置为包括*小写和大写罗马文字、逗号、+ 和括号（升级物品时使用）和空格*。

source: > This option is subject to change in the future if we find a better way/less confusing way to implement this
zh: > 如果我们找到更好的方法/不那么混乱的方法来实现此选项，将来可能会更改此选项

source: Here's what our item looks like so far! We have successfully centered our display name and first lore line.
zh: 这是我们的物品目前的样子！我们已成功将显示名称和第一行描述居中。

source: ![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_center_top.FIUUbkbL.png)
zh: ![image.png](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_center_top.FIUUbkbL.png)

source: Making the tooltip top larger
zh: 使工具提示顶部更大

source: Our tooltip looks pretty good so far, but there might one thing you still want to do. As of right now, you might want to increase the size of the tooltip header. The first thing that you want to do is draw a new texture for your tooltip. Here's the new texture, that will occupy the item name level, as well as the first lore line. Our new texture is now 42px high.
zh: 到目前为止，我们的工具提示看起来相当不错，但你可能仍然想做一件事。截至目前，你可能想要增加工具提示标题的大小。你要做的第一件事是为工具提示绘制新纹理。这是新纹理，它将占据物品名称等级以及第一条描述行。我们的新纹理现在为42px高。

source: ![top.large.png](data:image/png;base64,)
zh: ![top.large.png](data:image/png;base64,)

source: Make sure you update the resource pack config to account for the height of your new tooltip `top` texture. I had to increase `height` from 21 to 42, and `ascent` from 17 to 18 for a very minor 1px adjustment.
zh: 确保更新资源包配置以考虑新工具提示`top`纹理的高度。我必须将`height`从21增加到42，并将`ascent`从17增加到18，以进行非常小的1px调整。

source: Now use the following syntax for your tooltip config. The `ignore_first` option tells MMOItems to skip the rendering of the `middle` texture for the two first lore lines, which are now *covered* by your larger tooltip `top` texture!
zh: 现在，对工具提示配置使用以下语法。`ignore_first`选项告诉MMOItems跳过前两条描述线的`middle`纹理的渲染，这些线现在被更大的工具提示`top`纹理“覆盖”！

source: Here's the final look of our item. Pretty nice!
zh: 这是我们物品的最终外观。相当不错！

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_use_big_top.B-iPN54U.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/tt_use_big_top.B-iPN54U.png)

source: Binding tooltips to items, modifiers, tiers, types
zh: 将工具提示绑定到物品、修饰符、层、类型

source: Binding a specific tooltip to a specific item is super easy. Either directly input the tooltip ID after clicking the *Tooltip* option in the item edition UI, or use the following syntax. This option has precedence over type- and tier-level tooltips.
zh: 将特定的工具提示绑定到特定的物品非常简单。单击物品版本 UI 中的 *Tooltip* 选项后直接输入工具提示ID，或者使用以下语法。此选项优先于类型和tier-level工具提示。

source: Similarly, you can have modifiers that apply a tooltip (just like they would give any other stat/item option) using the following syntax. This option has the highest precedence, since modifiers are taken into account after the base item data on item generation. Here's an example of a modifier that adds the prefix *Golden* to items while applying tooltip with ID `GOLD`.
zh: 同样，你可以使用以下语法让修饰符应用工具提示（就像它们提供任何其他属性/物品选项一样）。此选项具有最高优先级，因为在生成物品时的基本物品数据之后会考虑修饰符。下面是一个修改器示例，它在使用ID`GOLD`应用工具提示时将前缀 *Golden* 添加到物品。
