zh: 使用以下语法将工具提示绑定到物品类型也非常简单。这是`Sword`物品类型的默认配置文件。该选项的优先级最低。

source: 🎨 Item Textures
zh: 🎨物品纹理

source: > Under construction
zh: > 建设中

source: In Minecraft 1.14, texture by durability still works but it is outdated. MC 1.14 introduces a new item NBTTag called *CustomModelData* which lets an item have a custom texture without using its durability. This tag is much better than the 1.9 system since it allows you to have custom textured items while keeping their durability bar.
zh: 在Minecraft1.14中，耐久度的纹理仍然有效，但已经过时了。 MC1.14引入了一个名为 *CustomModelData* 的新物品NBTTag，它允许物品拥有自定义纹理，而无需使用其耐久度。该标签比1.9系统好得多，因为它允许你拥有自定义纹理物品，同时保留其耐久度条。

source: Once again MI does not provide anything to setup the required resource pack, moreover you can find tutorials online on how to setup it. Once your resource pack is setup, head to MC and open the edition GUI for the item which you want to give a texture to. If you're running a 1.14 server, a new item option called *Custom Model Data* should display in the menu. Simply input the desired integer which corresponds to the texture you setup in your resource pack. Your item should then load the texture.
zh: MI 再次不提供任何设置所需资源包的内容，而且你可以在线找到有关如何设置它的教程。设置好资源包后，前往 MC 并打开你想要为其添加纹理的物品的版本GUI。如果你运行的是1.14服务器，则菜单中应显示名为“自定义模型数据”的新物品选项。只需输入与你在资源包中设置的纹理相对应的所需整数。然后你的物品应该加载纹理。

source: From 1.9 to 1.13 (outdated)

Since 1.9 items can have **different textures or models** depending on their durability. MMOItems supports these custom textures however it does not help you setting up the resource pack you need for these custom textures. Using the 1.9 *texture by durability* feature, two items with the same item material can have different textures based on the item durability values.
zh: 由于1.9物品可以具有**不同的纹理或模型**，具体取决于其耐久度。MMOItems支持这些自定义纹理，但它不能帮助你设置这些自定义纹理所需的资源包。使用1.9*耐久度的纹理 * 功能，具有相同物品材质的两个物品可以根据物品耐久度值具有不同的纹理。

source: It is almost necessary to read [**that guide**](https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/custom-item-models-in-1-9-and-up/) on custom textures first (you don't have to read the **CODE** part).
zh: 几乎有必要首先阅读 [**该指南**](https://www.spigotmc.org/wiki/custom-item-models-in-1-9-and-up/)关于自定义纹理的内容（你不必阅读 **CODE** 部分）。

source: Once you read the tutorial, create an item in-game in MMOItems to get started. Make your item *unbreakable* (it is very important) using the corresponding item option and give your item the durability that corresponds to the one you set in your resource pack. Your item should now load the custom texture you created. If your item is not unbreakable, the texture will either not load or will be lost once you use one durability point from your item.
zh: 阅读完教程后，在MMOItems中创建一个物品in-game即可开始使用。使用相应的物品选项使你的物品*牢不可破*（这一点非常重要），并为你的物品提供与你在资源包中设置的对应的耐久度。你的物品现在应该加载你创建的自定义纹理。如果你的物品不是牢不可破的，那么一旦你使用物品中的一个耐久度点，纹理将无法加载或丢失。

source: 💥 Lootsplosion
zh: 💥 战利品爆炸

source: *Lootsplosion* is a nickname for an effect we mimicked from other games such as the Borderlands series. Instead of killing mobs, and getting very boring drops that go on the ground, now your drops can LOOTSPLODE!
zh: *Lootsplosion* 是我们模仿《无主之地》系列等其他游戏的效果的昵称。现在你的掉落物可以抢劫，而不是杀死小怪，并获得非常无聊的掉落物！

source: Configurable in your `config.yml`, you can change the X and Y variance at which items will fly out of mobs. Now you can kill bosses and have tons of glowing items go flying for your players to loot!
zh: 可在`config.yml`中进行配置，你可以更改物品飞出小怪的 X 和 Y 方差。现在，你可以杀死 Boss，并让大量发光的物品飞来让你的玩家进行掠夺！

source: In order to enable lootsplosion for a certain MythicMob, you need to give him a `Lootsplosion` variable. The value can be anything, for example 1. This skill applies the variable to the mob as soon as it spawns: `setvariable{var=Lootsplosion;scope=target;value=1} @self ~onSpawn`
zh: 为了启用某个 MythicMob 的 lootsplosion，你需要给他一个`Lootsplosion`变量。该值可以是任何值，例如1。这个技能在生物产生后立即将变量应用于它：`setvariable{var=Lootsplosion;scope=target;value=1} @self ~onSpawn`

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/lootsplosion.D_nh5FoG.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/lootsplosion.D_nh5FoG.gif)

source: Lootsplosion is fully compatible with MMOItems tiers. When **tiered** items are dropped using MythicMobs drop tables, the dropped items will leave behind them a trail of particles which color depend on their tier! Add to that MMOItems' hint and glowing system and you will have beautiful drops!
zh: Lootsplosion 与MMOItems等级完全兼容。当使用MythicMobs掉落表掉落 **分层**物品时，掉落的物品将留下一条粒子痕迹，其颜色取决于其等级！添加到MMOItems的提示和发光系统，你将获得美丽的水滴！

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/lootsplosion_trails.C7rFnSWy.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/lootsplosion_trails.C7rFnSWy.gif)

source: All you need to do in order to make an item have a lootsplosion particle is to setup the item tier color in the item tier MMOItems config file like so:
zh: 为了使物品具有 lootsplosion 粒子，你需要做的就是在物品品质MMOItems配置文件中设置物品品质颜色，如下所示：

source: In this example, rare items will display an orange particle effect when looted on MythicMobs.
zh: 在此示例中，稀有的物品在MythicMobs上被掠夺时将显示橙色粒子效果。

source: 🛡️ Item Sets
zh: 🛡️物品套装

source: Items sets allow you to link multiple items together to make them stronger when worn at the same time. Item sets give extra stats to the player if he wears enough items from the same item set. The config file is pretty self explanatory; here is a config snippet.
zh: 物品套装允许你将多个物品连接在一起，使它们在同时佩戴时更坚固。  如果物品套装佩戴了足够多的物品套装中的物品，则为玩家提供额外的属性。配置文件非常不言自明；这是一个配置片段。

source: Set Bonuses
zh: 设定奖金

source: Set bonuses can be displayed in the item lore using the *lore-tag* option. You can really put anything in that list, but I like to precisely give the amount of additional stats the item gives. The bonuses section defines what bonuses the item set gives. The subsections with numbers correspond to the stats the item set grants for each amount of items the player wears.
zh: 可以使用 *lore-tag* 选项在物品描述中显示设置的奖金。你确实可以在该列表中添加任何内容，但我喜欢精确给出物品提供的额外属性的数量。奖金部分定义了物品套装提供的奖金。带数字的小节对应于物品套装为玩家佩戴的每个物品授予的属性。

source: Full set can grant stats, abilities, permanent potion effects, permissions as well as particle effects to the player.
zh: 全套可以赋予属性、能力、永久药水效果、权限以及粒子效果给玩家。

source: Permanent potion effects
zh: 永久药水效果

source: Set bonuses can grant **permanent potion effects** to the player. You need to specify the potion effect name (names can be found [here](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/potion/PotionEffectType.html)) and the potion level which needs to be an integer. You need to use the following format: `potion-<potion-effect-name>: <permanent-level>`. Using the `potion-` prefix will indicate to MMOItems that you want to setup a permanent potion effect.
zh: 设置奖励可以为玩家授予**永久药水效果**。你需要指定药水效果名称（名称可以在[此处](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/potion/PotionEffectType.html)] 找到）和药水等级（必须是整数）。你需要使用以下格式：`potion-<potion-effect-name>: <permanent-level>`。使用`potion-`前缀将向MMOItems表明你想要设置永久药水效果。

source: Abilities
zh: 能力

source: Last but not least, you may also setup **abilities** as full set bonuses. Pretty easy to setup since it's the same format as with item abilities. In the following example, any player who holds at least 2 items from the Hatred Set will be temporarily granted a Life Ender ability which will trigger when hitting any entity. The ability has a 30sec cooldown. Just make sure you are using the `ability-` prefix which indicates to MMOItems that you'd like to setup a permanent ability.
zh: 最后但并非最不重要的一点是，你还可以将**能力**设置为全套奖励。设置非常简单，因为它的格式与物品功能相同。在以下示例中，任何持有仇恨套装中至少2物品的玩家将被临时授予生命终结能力，该能力在击中任何实体时会触发。能力有30sec冷却时间。只需确保你使用的是`ability-`前缀，它向MMOItems表明你想要设置永久能力。

source: Particle Effects
zh: 粒子效果

source: The prefix for particle effects is `particle-`. You can put whatever you want after that prefix.
zh: 粒子效果的前缀是`particle-`。你可以在该前缀后添加任何你想要的内容。

source: You can find more information on MMOItems particle effects [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/stats/stats#item-particles).
zh: 你可以找到有关MMOItems粒子效果的更多信息 [此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/stats/stats#item-particles)。

source: Permissions
zh: 权限

source: You can provide a list of permissions that will be granted to the player once he reaches a specific number of items in the set.
zh: 你可以提供权限的列表，一旦玩家达到集合中的物品的特定数量，该列表将被授予。

source: 💫 Skills & Abilities
zh: 💫技能& 能力

source: Abilities are unique skills which can be bound onto items to make them feel more unique. An important feature for configurability is the ability triggers/casting modes i.e the action you need to perform in order to cast the ability. Since MMOItems 6.6.2 these ability triggers are shared with MMOCore; the full list can be found [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers).
zh: 技能的能力是独特的，可以绑定到物品上，让他们感觉更独特。可配置性的一个重要功能是能力触发/施放模式i.e施放该能力所需执行的操作。自MMOItems6.6.2起，这些能力触发器与MMOCore共享；完整列表可以在[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers)找到。

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_abilities.DOHp8Z8q.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_abilities.DOHp8Z8q.png)

source: Using the right skill trigger, you can have an ability cast when the player kills an entity or when an arrow that you fired lands on the ground.
zh: 使用正确的技能触发器，你可以在玩家杀死实体或你发射的箭落在地面上时施放技能。

source: **Damaging** abilities can either deal **physical** or **magical** damage. Depending on their type, the ability damage can be increased by a specific item stat, either `Physical Damage` or `Magical Damage`. Physical abilities correspond to abilities which utilize items or weapons, like *Circular Slash* or *Item Throw*. Magical abilities correspond to elemental/magical abilities like *Firebolt*, *Fire Comet*...
zh: **破坏性**技能可以造成**物理**或**魔法**伤害。根据其类型，能力伤害可以通过特定的物品属性来增加，无论是`Physical Damage`还是`Magical Damage`。物理能力对应于使用物品或武器的能力，例如 *Circular Slash* 或 *物品Throw*。魔法能力对应于元素/魔法能力，如*火弩箭*、*火彗星*...

source: Adding abilities to MMOItems using MythicMobs
zh: 使用MythicMobs为MMOItems添加功能

source: Since MMOItems 6.7, custom skills are handled within MythicLib. Please refer to the [MythicLib wiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic).
zh: 自MMOItems6.7起，自定义技能在MythicLib内处理。请参阅[MythicLibwiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic)。

source: Ability Triggers
zh: 能力触发

source: Ability triggers define how an ability is cast. You will find them in the [MythicLib wiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers).
zh: 能力触发器定义了能力的施放方式。你可以在 [MythicLibwiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers)中找到它们。

source: Editing an ability
zh: 编辑能力

source: Go into the `MMOItems/skills` folder and locate the YML file corresponding to the ability you'd like to edit. For example, let's consider `arcane-rift.yml`
zh: 进入`MMOItems/skills`文件夹并找到与你要编辑的能力相对应的 YML 文件。例如，让我们考虑`arcane-rift.yml`

source: You can edit the ability name, which is the name displayed in the item lore when binding an ability to an item. You can also modify the name and default value for every ability modifier. It is the numeric value that MMOItems will consider if none is specified in the item editor GUI when adding an ability to an item.
zh: 你可以编辑技能名称，即绑定技能到物品时物品描述中显示的名称。你还可以修改每个能力修饰符的名称和默认值。当向物品添加能力时，如果物品编辑器GUI中没有指定，则MMOItems将考虑的数值。

source: 🔮 Soulbound
zh: 🔮灵魂绑定

source: Players can *soul-bind* items to themselves. Once bound, the item becomes unusable by any other player apart from the owner; any other player trying to use it will receive instant damage. Soulbounds are displayed inside the item lore, and can be achieved and destroyed using specific consumable items.
zh: 玩家可以 *soul-bind*物品为自己。一旦绑定，物品将无法被除所有者之外的任何其他玩家使用；任何其他尝试使用它的玩家都会受到即时伤害。 Soulbounds显示在物品描述内部，并且可以使用特定的消耗品物品来实现和破坏。

source: Additional toggleable options for Soulbound items include:
zh: 灵魂绑定物品的其他可切换选项包括：

source: Soulbound items are kept on death even when keepInventory is not toggled on.
zh: 即使未打开 keepInventory，灵魂绑定物品也会保持死亡状态。

source: Soulbound items cannot be taken off the owner's inventory (cannot place it in a chest, dispenser...)
zh: 灵魂绑定物品无法从所有者的物品栏上取下（无法将其放入箱子、分配器...）

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/soulbound_on_item.BjrOux5u.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/soulbound_on_item.BjrOux5u.png)

source: Soulbound Level
zh: 灵魂绑定等级

source: Soulbinds have levels. The level of a soulbind is determined by the consumable used to soulbind the item. If you use a Level III soulbinding consumable onto an item, the former will be granted a Level III Soulbind. The higher the level, the harder it is to break the soulbind. In order to break a Level N Soulbind, you will need a consumable with a soulbound breaking power of N.
zh: 灵魂绑定有等级。灵魂绑定的等级由用于灵魂绑定物品的消耗品决定。如果你将 III 级灵魂绑定消耗品用于物品，则前者将被授予 III 级灵魂绑定。等级越高，魂缚就越难打破。为了打破 N 级灵魂束缚，你需要一个灵魂绑定的打破能力为 N 的消耗品。

source: Additionally, a higher soulbound item will deal more damage to external players trying to interact with the soulbound item.
zh: 此外，较高的灵魂绑定物品将对尝试与灵魂绑定物品交互的外部玩家造成更多伤害。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/try_use_soulbound.uGHomkZm.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/try_use_soulbound.uGHomkZm.gif)

source: Breaking a soulbind
zh: 打破灵魂束缚

source: In order to break a soulbound, players must apply a specific consumable onto it. This consumable's soulbound level must be higher or equal to the soulbound weapon/armor level. Destroying a soulbound may sometimes fail, depending on the soulbound breaking chance. When failing to destroy a soulbound, the consumable is lost, just like with failed soulbound creations.
zh: 为了破解灵魂绑定，玩家必须在其上应用特定的消耗品。此消耗品的灵魂绑定等级必须高于或等于灵魂绑定武器/护甲等级。摧毁灵魂绑定有时可能会失败，具体取决于灵魂绑定的破坏几率。当未能销毁灵魂绑定时，消耗品就会丢失，就像失败的灵魂绑定创建一样。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/break_soulbound.Cm1fNktP.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/break_soulbound.Cm1fNktP.gif)

source: 📊 Stats
zh: 📊属性

source: Numerical Stats
zh: 数值属性

source: By *numerical stat* we refer to 80% of item stats:
zh: 通过 *数字属性* 我们指的是物品属性的80%：

source: Most numerical stats (Attack Damage/Crit Chance/PvE Damage/...) or even more specific item options (ability modifiers, potion effect duration/level, enchant level) all feature formulas for numerical inputs. These formulas are adapted to easily provide realistic stat values in a RPG server scenario, though you also have options to make numerical inputs much much easier to configure.
zh: 大多数数值属性（攻击伤害/暴击几率/PvE伤害/...）或更具体的物品选项（能力调节器、药水效果持续时间/等级、附魔等级）都具有数字输入的公式。这些公式经过调整，可以在RPG服务器场景中轻松提供实际的属性值，不过你也可以选择使数字输入更容易配置。

source: Numerical inputs (numerical stats, ability modifiers...) can scale with the item level. The item level is a constant picked "randomly" when generating an item. As a general rule, the higher the item level, the better the stats.
zh: 数字输入（数字属性、能力修饰符...）可以随物品等级缩放。物品等级是生成物品时“随机”选取的常数。一般来说，物品等级越高，属性越好。

source: The formula used is the following:
zh: 使用的公式如下：

source: `base` is the stat value that corresponds to a lvl 0 item. `scale` is the extra value the stat gets for every additional extra level. Using the formula given above, if the item level is 6, the stat value will be `10 + (2 * 6) = 22`. The general formula is therefore `stat_value = base + item_level * scale`*.*
zh: `base`是属性值，对应于等级0物品。`scale`是属性每增加一个额外等级所获得的额外值。使用上面给出的公式，如果物品等级为6，则属性值将为`10 + (2 * 6) = 22`。因此，一般公式为`stat_value = base + item_level * scale`*.*

source: Adding randomness & realism to numerical stats
zh: 为数值属性添加随机性和真实感

source: In RPG games, items you drop never have flat statistics that only depend on level: they have an extra randomness factor, which makes some items good, because of their overall slightly higher stats, and others bad because of their overall lower stats. MMOItems has a similar feature for numeric item stats.
zh: 在RPG游戏中，你掉落的物品永远不会有仅取决于等级的平坦属性：它们有一个额外的随机因素，这使得一些物品好，因为它们总体略高属性，而另一些则不好，因为它们总体较低属性。MMOItems与数字物品属性具有类似的功能。

source: Specify a range for numerical stats
zh: 指定数值范围属性

source: By using the following format, the stat value will be picked randomly within given lower and upper bounds.
zh: 通过使用以下格式，将在给定的下限和上限内随机选取属性值。

source: This is the easy way of doing random stat values. If you don't want to mess too much with your stat values, just go for that. If you wanna add a deeper RPG touch to your server though, you can go for an option that is more realistic (same formulas as those used in RPG games) yet a little more difficult to setup.
zh: 这是获取随机属性值的简单方法。如果你不想对属性值造成太多混乱，那就这么做吧。如果你想为服务器添加更深层次的RPG触摸，你可以选择更现实的选项（与RPG游戏中使用的公式相同），但设置起来有点困难。

source: Use a normal distribution
zh: 使用正态分布

source: A normal distribution is a distribution of variables that you can find literally everywhere in maths, physics, nature etc... This is the one we'll be using for the stat values. Let's check out the format first, then fully break it down.
zh: 正态分布是一种变量分布，在数学、物理、自然等领域中随处可见……这就是我们将用于属性值的分布。让我们先检查一下格式，然后再将其完全分解。

source: First, remember that we want the stat value to be on average `base + item_level * scale` because that would be the stat value if there were no randomness. When "applying" a normal distribution to the stat values, the `spread` parameter is the average difference between a randomly generated stat value and the average value. The higher the spread, the more spread out the stat values will be. A lower spread will result in stat values that are more packed up around the average value.
zh: 首先，请记住，我们希望属性值是`base + item_level * scale`的平均值，因为如果没有随机性，这将是属性值。当对属性值“应用”正态分布时，`spread`参数是随机生成的属性值与平均值之间的平均差。价差越高，属性值的分布就越大。较低的价差将导致属性值更加集中在平均值周围。

source: You should use a spread of about 0.1, resulting in 70% values ranging from -10% to +10%, and 95% values ranging from -20% to +20%.
zh: 你应该使用大约0.1的价差，导致70%值的范围从-10%到 +10%，而95%值的范围从-20%到 +20%。

source: The `max-spread` is the maximum difference to the average value. You should set this parameter to around 30% to 50%, this way the normal distribution doesn't generate stat values that are over-powered. With such distribution remains a small risk of generating a stat value that is 10x the average value, which we don't want to happen for gameplay fairness.
zh: `max-spread`是与平均值的最大差异。你应该将此参数设置为30%到50%左右，这样正态分布就不会生成属性值over-powered。通过这种分布，生成属性值（即10x平均值）的风险仍然很小，为了游戏公平性，我们不希望发生这种情况。

zh: 你还可以使用以下格式向此gaussian-distribution-based数值公式添加常数下/上界（尽管与属性缩放配合使用时实用性有限）：

source: Advanced Stats
zh: 高级属性

source: Randomly generated items can have **numeric stats**, like attack damage, attack speed, crit strike chance, but you can also add more **complex stats** to it, like abilities, or permanent potion effects, which power do also scale with the item level. These statistics are more complex and therefore a little harder to setup.
zh: 随机生成的物品可以具有 **数字属性**，如攻击伤害、攻击速度、暴击几率，但你也可以添加更多 **复杂的属性** ，如能力或永久药水效果，其威力也随着物品等级而缩放。这些属性更复杂，因此设置起来有点困难。

source: Remember any code snippet found in that page would go either in the `base` config section of an item gen template (which corresponds to the template base item data), or in the `stats` config section of an item gen modifier:
zh: 请记住，在该页面中找到的任何代码片段都将位于物品gen 模板的`base`配置部分（对应于模板基础物品数据），或者位于物品gen 修改器的`stats`配置部分：

source: Using the item generator, you can create items with special abilities which get stronger the higher the item level. Precisely, abilities have modifiers (how much damage it deals, how long a potion effect lasts..) which can scale on the item level. Use this format to add an ability to an item gen template/item gen modifier:
zh: 使用物品生成器，你可以创建具有特殊能力的物品，物品等级越高，其能力就越强。准确地说，能力具有可以在物品等级上缩放的修饰符（造成多少伤害，药水效果持续多长时间......）。使用此格式向物品gen 模板/物品gen 修改器添加能力：

source: You may notice that the format is the exact same as if you wanted to add an ability to a normal (not randomly generated) mmoitem. The only thing that changes is how you define the ability modifiers, because they are the only values which can really scale on the item level. The formulas used to define an ability modifier are the same as the formulas used with [numeric stats](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/stats/numerical-stats).
zh: 你可能会注意到，该格式与你想要向普通（不是随机生成的）mmoiite 添加能力的格式完全相同。唯一改变的是如何定义能力修饰符，因为它们是唯一可以在物品等级上真正缩放的值。用于定义能力修饰符的公式与 [numeric属性](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/stats/numerical-stats)所使用的公式相同。

source: In this example, the on-hit burn ability has a 6s cooldown however that values fluctuates +/-10% in average with a maximum relative offset of 10%. The burn lasts for 6 seconds but that duration is increased by 0.2 second for every item level.
zh: 在此示例中，on-hit刻录能力具有6s冷却时间，但该值平均波动 +/-10%，最大相对偏移为10%。燃烧持续6秒，但每物品等级持续时间就会增加0.2秒。

source: Note that if you want to specify an ability modifier but do not want it to scale, you must still specify a base, and set the scale and/or max-spread to 0 or remove them completely. See the above example titled `third-ability`. In this example, damage will be 5 on every item generated using the blizzard ability. However, cooldown will still scale as specified.
zh: 请注意，如果你想指定能力修饰符但不希望其缩放，则仍必须指定基础，并将缩放和/或max-spread设置为0或完全删除它们。请参阅上面标题为`third-ability`的示例。在此示例中，使用暴风雪能力生成的每个物品的伤害将为5。但是，冷却时间仍将按指定进行缩放。

source: Potion effects obtained when eating a consumable
zh: 食用消耗品时获得的药水效果

source: Remember a potion effect is defined by three parameter: the potion effect type, a duration and a potion level.
zh: 请记住，药水效果由三个参数定义：药水效果类型、持续时间和药水等级。

source: Notice how you start to see a repeating pattern with the `base/scale/spread/maxspread` based config sections which seem to be literally everywhere when dealing with randomly generated items. Like any other numeric values, the potion duration and level can scale on the item level.
zh: 请注意，你如何开始看到基于`base/scale/spread/maxspread`的配置部分的重复模式，在处理随机生成的物品时，这些配置部分似乎无处不在。与任何其他数值一样，药水持续时间和等级可以按物品等级缩放。

zh: 你可以在 [Spigotjavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/potion/PotionEffectType.html)] 中查看Minecraft效果列表。

source: Permanent Potion Effects
zh: 永久药水效果

source: It's literally the same as with consumable potion effects (see above), but since these potion effects are supposed to be permanently given to the player when a specific item is held, you **do not have to specify the effect duration**. The `level` config section is also gone because it's cleaner without it.
zh: 它实际上与消耗品药水效果相同（见上文），但由于当持有特定物品时，这些药水效果应该永久赋予玩家，因此你**不必指定效果持续时间**。`level`配置部分也消失了，因为没有它它会更干净。

zh: 结界

zh: 结界由结界类型和等级定义。使用这种格式：

source: Item Elemental Stats
zh: 物品元素属性

source: Consumable Restore Power
zh: 消耗品恢复电源

source: Restore power defines how much health, food and saturation a consumable restores when used.
zh: 恢复能力定义了消耗品在使用时恢复的生命值、食物和饱和度。

source: Item Stats
zh: 物品属性

source: The edition menu (`/mi edit`) lets you know what stats you can add to an item and how to configure them. While most are self explanatory, here are some specifications about the most complex item options. This list does not contain every item stat or option you can find in MMOItems, but make sure to read the rest of the wiki, as it contains information about other item options. Item examples will help you creating items manually if you don't feel like using the edition menu.
zh: 版本菜单 (`/mi edit`) 让你了解可以向物品添加哪些属性以及如何配置它们。虽然大多数都是不言自明的，但以下是有关最复杂的物品选项的一些规格。此列表不包含你可以在MMOItems中找到的每个物品属性或选项，但请务必阅读 wiki 的其余部分，因为它包含有关其他物品选项的信息。  如果你不想使用版本菜单，物品示例将帮助你手动创建物品。

source: > Use CTRL+F to look for an item stat.
zh: > 使用 CTRL+F 查找物品属性。

source: Numerical stats represent 80% of the stats available on items. They are stats which are defined by a single number: attack damage, attack speed, crit chance... Please refer to [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/stats/numerical-stats).
zh: 数字属性代表物品上可用的属性的80%。它们是属性，由单个数字定义：攻击伤害、攻击速度、暴击机会...请参阅[此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/stats/numerical-stats)。

source: Material, Durability
zh: 材质，耐久度

source: Your item material and its durability/data. **Example:** INK_SACK with 1 durability corresponds to Rose Red (for 1.8 - 1.12). Use ROSE_RED for 1.13. All materials can be found in the [Spigot Javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Material.html). Be careful, these material names correspond to the latest Spigot version, it is therefore not 100% compatible with <1.14, and especially Legacy.
zh: 你的物品材料及其耐久度/数据。 **示例：**INK_SACK和1耐久度对应于玫瑰红色（对于1.8-1.12）。使用ROSE_RED代替1.13。所有材料都可以在 [SpigotJavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Material.html)] 中找到。请注意，这些材质名称对应于最新的Spigot版本，因此100%与 <1.14不兼容，尤其是 Legacy。

source: Display Name
zh: 显示名称

source: The item display name. Use '&' for color codes. **Hex color codes following the MiniMessage format are fully supported** (ex: `<#FFFFFF>` or `<HEXFFFFFF>`). When an item is being generated, name prefixes/suffixes from modifiers are added to the base item name.
zh: 物品显示名称。使用“&”作为颜色代码。 **完全支持遵循 MiniMessage 格式的十六进制颜色代码**（例如：`<#FFFFFF>`或`<HEXFFFFFF>`）。生成物品时，修饰符中的名称前缀/后缀将添加到基本物品名称中。

source: Placeholders are available for the item display name. For more information, please refer to [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/item-lore/name-placeholders).
zh: 占位符可用于物品显示名称。欲了解更多信息，请参阅[此wiki页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/item-lore/name-placeholders)。

source: Custom Lore
zh: 定制描述

source: Just to make it clear, items do have a lore even when not using this option. This option only adds a few custom lines at the end of the item lore. You can use it to have a small RPG type description of your weapon.
zh: 需要明确的是，即使不使用此选项，物品也确实有描述。此选项仅在物品描述的末尾添加一些自定义行。你可以使用它来获得武器的小型RPG类型描述。

source: You can also use this option to display the item abilities. Because the way abilities are displayed by default is not really configurable, we have added **lore placeholders** for ability modifiers so that you can use this option instead. For instance, using `{ability_fireball_damage}` will return the Fireball ability damage.
zh: 你还可以使用此选项来显示物品的能力。由于默认显示能力的方式无法真正配置，因此我们为能力修饰符添加了**描述占位符**，以便你可以使用此选项。例如，使用`{ability_fireball_damage}`将返回火球术技能伤害。

source: The general format is `{ability_<ability-_name>_<modifier_name>}`. These placeholders do update if the ability modifier somehow changes, because of another plugin for instance.
zh: 一般格式为`{ability_<ability-_name>_<modifier_name>}`。如果能力修饰符发生某种变化（例如由于另一个插件），这些占位符会更新。

source: Dye Color
zh: 染料颜色

source: This parameter is only for leather armor pieces. In RGB (red-green-blue)
zh: 此参数仅适用于皮革护甲件。 RGB (red-green-blue)

source: Item Permissions
zh: 物品权限

source: A list of permissions any player must have in order to use this item. You may use the corresponding bypass permission to bypass that item restriction.
zh: 任何玩家都必须具有权限列表才能使用此物品。你可以使用相应的绕过权限来绕过该物品限制。

source: Attack Damage, Attack Speed
zh: 攻击伤害,攻击速度

source: The amount of damage your weapon deals, and at which speed (in hits/sec). These stats are based on the vanilla attribute modifiers.
zh: 武器造成的伤害量以及速度（以命中/秒为单位）。这些属性基于原版基础属性修饰符。

source: These stats have a behaviour specific to them when wielding two items at the same time. While items including accessories such as off hand catalysts can increase your attack speed and damage when held in off hand, holding a weapon in off hand will NOT increase your attack speed and damage because these two stats are linked to the off hand weapon, which you are not using as your main weapon.
zh: 当同时挥舞两个物品时，这些属性具有特定的行为。虽然物品包括副手催化剂等配件可以增加攻击速度和副手中的伤害，但将武器放在副手中不会增加攻击速度和伤害，因为这两个属性与副手武器，你没有将其用作主要武器。

source: Critical Strike Chance & Power
zh: 暴击几率& 电源

source: The chance of your item, in %, of dealing a critical strike. Critical strikes deals 250% of the initial damage (configurable amount in the MythicLib config file). Critical Strike Power corresponds to the percentage of the initial damage a critical strike deals.
zh: 你的物品处理暴击的机会（以%为单位）。暴击造成250%的初始伤害（可在MythicLib配置文件中配置）。暴击伤害对应于暴击造成的初始伤害的百分比。

source: Since the MythicLib update, MMOCore skills and MMOItems item abilities can also deal critical strikes and all the crit options can be edited in the MythicLib main config file.
zh: 自MythicLib更新以来，MMOCore技能和MMOItems物品技能也可以处理暴击，并且所有暴击选项都可以在MythicLib主配置文件中编辑。

source: Range
zh: 范围

source: The range of your whip/staff. The default value is 18. Units here are not exactly blocks, multiply this value by approx. 2.5 to get the value in blocks.
zh: 你的鞭子/棍子的范围。默认值为18。这里的单位并不完全是块，请将此值乘以大约。2.5获取块中的值。

source: Blunt Power & Rating
zh: 钝功率和额定值

source: Blunt Power corresponds to the radius of a blunt attack. The bigger the more enemies you can hit at the same time. Blunt Rating corresponds to the damage dealt by the blunt attack. In % of the initial damage. Example: Blunt Power = 3 | Blunt Rating = 70% | When hitting an entity, enemies within 3 units of distance will take 70% of the initial damage.
zh: 钝器力量对应于钝器攻击的半径。越大，你可以同时击中的敌人就越多。钝器等级对应于钝器攻击造成的伤害。以初始伤害的百分比表示。示例：钝功率 =3|直率评级 =70%|当击中实体时，3距离单位内的敌人将受到70%的初始伤害。

source: Unbreakable
zh: 坚不可摧

source: When set to true, weapons never break. This option is needed if you planned to give your item a custom texture using the *texture by durability* mechanism.
zh: 当设置为true时，武器永远不会中断。如果你计划使用 *texture by耐久度* 机制为物品提供自定义纹理，则需要此选项。

source: Unstackable
zh: 不可堆叠

source: When set to true, your item will never stack with itself.
zh: 当设置为true时，你的物品永远不会与自身堆叠。

source: Armor, Armor Toughness
zh: 护甲,护甲韧性

source: The amount of armor and armor toughness your piece of armor gives to the player. These stats correspond to vanilla minecraft player attributes. Armor and armor toughness reduce damage taken. You may visit the official MC wiki to know how damage is calculated depending on armor & armor toughness, but briefly: armor reduces damage, and armor toughness reduces armor reduction. These stats are not supported in 1.8 since the corresponding Minecraft attributes were added back in 1.9.
zh: 你的一块护甲赋予玩家的护甲和护甲韧性量。这些属性对应于原版我的世界玩家基础属性。护甲和护甲韧性可减少受到的伤害。你可以访问官方MC wiki来了解如何根据护甲和护甲韧性计算伤害，但简单地说：护甲减少伤害，而护甲韧性减少护甲减少。这些属性在1.8中不受支持，因为相应的Minecraft基础属性已添加回1.9中。

source: Defense
zh: 防御

source: This stat determines the player's defense value and can be any positive number. Any item type can be given this stat. The formula for which defense damage mitigation is handled can be edited in the mmolib config.yml.
zh: 这个属性决定了玩家的防御值，可以是任意正数。任何物品类型都可以指定为属性。处理防御伤害减免的公式可以在 mmolibconfig.yml中编辑。

source: In case you are curious about the default defense formula, here is a graph showing the damage reduction in percentage as a function of the defense points:
zh: 如果你对默认防御公式感到好奇，下面的图表显示了伤害减少百分比与防御点的函数关系：

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/defense_curve.DdNq92v0.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/defense_curve.DdNq92v0.png)

source: Here's now a table showing the amount of damage taken for a specific amount of incoming damage, and defense points:
zh: 现在的表格显示了特定数量的传入伤害所造成的伤害量以及防御点：

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/defense_table.C4WlQwAT.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/defense_table.C4WlQwAT.png)

source: Movement Speed
zh: 移动速度

source: The amount of movement speed your item gives to the holder/wearer. The default minecraft movement speed is 0.2. If you set the item additional movement speed to 0.02, that will be +10% Movement Speed.
zh: 物品为持有人/佩戴者提供的移动速度。我的世界默认移动速度为0.2。如果将物品附加移动速度设置为0.02，则该速度将为 +10%移动速度。

source: Two Handed
zh: 两只手

source: If a player holds two items at the same time, one being Two Handed, he's significantly slowed down. Using a specific config option you can make players unable to use any item when holding two heavy items.
zh: 如果玩家同时持有两个物品，其中一个是双手，那么他的速度会显着减慢。使用特定的配置选项，你可以使玩家在持有两个重物品时无法使用任何物品。

source: It's literally the same format as with the consumable potion effects (see above), but since these potion effects are supposed to be applied as long as the player holds the item, you do not have to specify the effect duration. The `level` config section is also gone because it's cleaner without it.
zh: 它的格式实际上与消耗品药水效果相同（见上文），但由于只要玩家持有物品就应该应用这些药水效果，因此你不必指定效果持续时间。`level`配置部分也消失了，因为没有它它会更干净。

source: Item Cooldown
zh: 物品冷却时间

source: The delay players must wait before EITHER using a consumable, or running all the commands from an item. In MMOItems Legacy, commands can all have different cooldowns and consumable have an option called `Consume Cooldown` which is similar to `Item Cooldown`.
zh: 延迟玩家必须在使用消耗品或运行物品中的所有命令之前等待。在MMOItemsLegacy 中，命令都可以有不同的冷却时间，而消耗品有一个名为`Consume Cooldown`的选项，它与`Item Cooldown`类似。

source: Tool Options
zh: 工具选项

source: **Autosmelt:** When toggled on, your tool automatically smelts mined iron and gold ores. **Bouncing Crack:** When toggled on, your tool mines extra blocks behind the initial one.
zh: **自动熔炼：** 当打开时，你的工具会自动熔炼开采的铁矿石和金矿石。 **弹跳裂缝：** 当打开时，你的工具会在第一个块后面挖掘额外的块。

source: Item Commands
zh: 物品命令

source: The list of commands your item performs when right clicking it. Commands may have a cooldown and a delay, after which it is automatically cast. You can use this option to create e.g consumables which teleport you back home using the /spawn command. **Warning**: the command cooldown differs from the consumable cooldown, therefore you need to make sure they are the same, otherwise the consumable may be consumed without casting the commands. You can install PAPI Player extension (/papi ecloud download Player) and use the %player_name% placeholder to get the command sender name.
zh: 右键单击物品时执行的命令列表。命令可能有冷却时间和延迟，之后会自动投射。你可以使用此选项创建e.g消耗品，它使用 /spawn 命令将你传送回家。 **警告**：命令冷却时间与消耗品冷却时间不同，因此你需要确保它们相同，否则消耗品可能会在不转换命令的情况下被消耗。你可以安装 PAPI玩家扩展（ /papi ecloud download玩家）并使用%player_name%占位符获取命令发送者名称。

source: Arrow Particles
zh: 箭头粒子

source: This option can be used to display particles around arrows fired by your bow. Particles can be fully configured (type, speed, color).
zh: 此选项可用于显示弓发射的箭周围的粒子。粒子可以完全配置（类型、速度、颜色）。

source: Equip Priority
zh: 装备优先

source: Assign a priority to an Armor Piece, then when you right click with an mmoitems armor in your hand, if the equip priority on that item is higher than or equal to the equip priority on the currently equipped armor, it will hot swap the armors for you.
zh: 为护甲棋子指定一个优先级，那么当你手上有一个MMO物品护甲的时候，如果该物品的装备优先级高于或等于当前装备的护甲的装备优先级，它就会为你热插拔盔甲。

source: This can be completely disabled or enabled in the Config.yml by editing: `auto-equip-feature: false`
zh: 可以通过编辑`auto-equip-feature: false`在Config.yml中完全禁用或启用此功能：

source: Required Level
zh: 所需等级

source: The level your weapon/item requires in order to be used. This restriction completely supports RPG core plugin levels.
zh: 武器/物品需要使用的等级。此限制完全支持RPG核心插件等级。

source: Required Profession Level
zh: 必需副职业等级

source: This stat determines if a player can use the item or not depending on the required profession level. Requires MMOCore.
zh: 这个属性决定玩家是否可以使用物品，具体取决于所需的副职业等级。需要MMOCore。

source: Skull Texture (for player heads only)
zh: 骷髅纹理（仅适用于玩家头）

source: The skull texture used for a custom head. For 1.13, use the PLAYER_HEAD material to get a player head item. Legacy users must use SKULL_ITEM with a durability of 3. The config format for that stat is rather weird because of a specific issue with custom textured skulls.
zh: 用于定制头部的头骨纹理。对于1.13，使用PLAYER_HEAD材料得到玩家头部物品。旧用户必须将SKULL_ITEM与3的耐久度一起使用。由于自定义纹理头骨的特定问题，属性的配置格式相当奇怪。

source: You can find skull texture values on Minecraft Heads or similar head databases. For example, navigate to the bottom of [this page](https://minecraft-heads.com/custom-heads/food-drinks/49818-hamburger-on-a-plate) to find the skull value which looks something like this:
zh: 你可以在Minecraft头部或类似头部数据库上找到头骨纹理值。例如，导航到[此页面](https://minecraft-heads.com/custom-heads/food-drinks/49818-hamburger-on-a-plate)的底部以查找头骨值，如下所示：

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/head_database.B-G0axjv.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/head_database.B-G0axjv.png)

source: Gem Sockets
zh: 宝石插座

source: Having gem sockets on your item allows you to place gem stones onto it. Gem stones improve your item stats. Each bound gem stone occupies one gem socket. More info on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/gem-stones).
zh: 物品上有宝石插槽，你可以在上面放置宝石。宝石提高你的物品属性。每一颗绑定的宝石都占据一个宝石插槽。更多信息请参见[此维基页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/gem-stones)。

source: Disable Interactions
zh: 禁用交互

source: When enabled, this option will disable any event that could happen when right-clicking/placing your item. It blocks block placement and item use (snowballs, cocoa seeds, saplings.........).
zh: 启用后，此选项将禁用right-clicking/放置物品时可能发生的任何事件。它阻止方块放置和物品使用（雪球、可可种子、树苗......）。

source: Inedible & Disable Right Click Consume
zh: 不可食用并禁用右键消耗

source: Inedible completely disables the right-click item event.
zh: Inedible 完全禁用right-click物品事件。

source: Disable Right Click Consume only prevents your item from being consumed when right clicked. You can still eat it but it won't be consumed.
zh: 禁用右键单击消耗只会阻止你的物品在右键单击时被消耗。你仍然可以吃它，但它不会被消耗掉。

source: Item Particles
zh: 物品颗粒

source: Displays some particles when holding/wearing your item. An item particle effect is defined by 3 things: the particle pattern and its pattern modifiers, and the actual particle being used in the effect.
zh: 持有/佩戴物品时会显示一些颗粒。物品粒子效果由3事物定义：粒子图案及其图案修改器，以及效果中使用的实际粒子。

source: The **particle pattern** defines how the particle will behave, what shape it forms, etc. For instance, choosing the Helix particle pattern will make the particle form a circle going up & down around you.
zh: **粒子模式**定义了粒子的行为方式、形成的形状等。例如，选择螺旋粒子模式将使粒子在你周围形成一个上下移动的圆圈。

source: The **particle** is the actual particle that is being used in the particle effect. For example, choosing redstone with Helix will form a helix of redstone particles around you. You can see a list of available particles [here](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Particle.html), but note that a few of them will not work with MMOItems.
zh: **粒子**是粒子效果中使用的实际粒子。例如，选择带有螺旋的红石将在你周围形成红石粒子螺旋。你可以看到可用粒子的列表[此处为](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Particle.html)，但请注意，其中一些粒子不适用于MMOItems。

source: You can then slightly tweak the particle effects by changing the **particle modifiers** which can, for instance, change the base y-offset for the helix, its radius, its height, its display speed...
zh: 然后，你可以通过更改**粒子修改器**来稍微调整粒子效果，例如，可以更改螺旋的基础y-offset、其半径、高度、显示速度...

source: Some particles are **colorable** e.g the redstone particle. This means you can edit their color to make particle effects even more unique. Colors can be setup by inputing three color levels: red, green and blue (RGB).
zh: 有些粒子是**可着色**e.g红石粒子。这意味着你可以编辑它们的颜色以使粒子效果更加独特。可以通过输入三种颜色等级来设置颜色：红色、绿色和蓝色 (RGB)。

source: Here is the list of the available particle types: OFFSET, FIREFLIES, VORTEX, GALAXY, DOUBLE_RINGS, HELIX, AURA.
zh: 以下是可用粒子类型的列表：OFFSET、FIREFLIES、VORTEX、GALAXY、DOUBLE_RINGS、HELIX、AURA。

source: Musket Stats
zh: 步枪属性

source: There are two main item stats you can use to customize muskets. Muskets are special range weapons that fire bullets when right-clicked. The knockback item stat defines the knockback applied onto the player whenever he fires a musket. It thus must be a positive value. The recoil defines the shooting accuracy e.g when set to 5, shots will be performed randomly 5° around your cursor.
zh: 有两种主要的物品属性你可以用来定制步枪。步枪是特殊射程武器，在right-clicked时发射子弹。击退物品属性定义了击退每当他发射步枪时应用于玩家。因此它必须是一个正值。后坐力定义了射击精度e.g当设置为5时，射击将在光标周围随机进行5°。

source: Lute Stats
zh: 琵琶属性

source: Lutes are ranged weapons which emit a music projectile when right clicked. Lutes have different attack effects (the list of all available effects is prompted when editing any lute attack effect using the edition GUI) which define the look of the projectile. You can also change the sound played when attacking. Note Weight when set to any value strictly greater than 0 will make the projectile slightly tilt its trajectory downwards with time as if it was pulled down by gravity.
zh: 鲁特琴的型号为武器，右键单击时会发出音乐投射物。鲁特琴有不同的攻击效果（使用版本GUI编辑任何鲁特琴攻击效果时会提示所有可用效果的列表），这些效果定义了射弹的外观。你还可以更改攻击时播放的声音。注意 当重量设置为任何严格大于0的值时，投射物的轨迹会随着时间的推移而稍微向下倾斜，就像被重力拉下来一样。

source: Custom Item Sounds
zh: 自定义物品声音

source: Custom item sounds are sounds played when performing specific actions with your items like attacking entities, right clicking your item, picking up your item... **Warning**, these sounds do not correspond to the Spigot javadocs sound names, they correspond to the vanilla sound names like `entity.zombie.attack_iron_door` (instead of `ENTITY_ZOMBIE_ATTACK_IRON_DOOR`).
zh: 自定义物品声音是在使用物品执行特定操作时播放的声音，例如攻击实体，右键单击物品，拿起物品... **警告**，这些声音不对应于Spigotjavadocs 声音名称，它们对应于原版声音名称，例如`entity.zombie.attack_iron_door`（而不是`ENTITY_ZOMBIE_ATTACK_IRON_DOOR`）。

source: You may also use sounds from your server resource pack. You can find the **default** sound list online, like on this [pastebin](https://pastebin.com/gLMhUyis) or even using the `/sound` auto command completer.
zh: 你还可以使用服务器资源包中的声音。你可以在线找到 **默认** 声音列表，例如在此 [pastebin](https://pastebin.com/gLMhUyis)上，甚至使用`/sound`自动命令完成器。

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/mc_sounds.RmKs8pUs.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/mc_sounds.RmKs8pUs.png)

source: 💍 Item Tiers
zh: 💍物品品质

source: Item tiers are used to define item rarity (common, rare, legendary...). They define the modifier capacity of an item when being generated, which directly impacts how many modifiers an item can have. They also define the loot dropped when deconstructing an item, as well as a few display options such as item glow and item hints.
zh: 物品品质用于定义物品稀有度（常见、稀有、传奇...）。它们定义了物品生成时的修改器容量，这直接影响物品可以拥有的修改器数量。它们还定义了解构物品时掉落的战利品，以及一些显示选项，例如物品发光和物品提示。

source: The default tiers are *Trash, Common, Uncommon, Rare, Very Rare, Legendary, Mythical, Epic, Magical and Unique*. You can edit the tiers in the `tiers.yml` config file located in the main plugin folder.
zh: 默认等级为*垃圾、常见、罕见、稀有、非常稀有、传奇、神话、史诗、魔法和独特*。你可以在主插件文件夹中的`tiers.yml`配置文件中编辑层。

source: Item Deconstruction
zh: 物品分解

source: Items that have a tier (common, rare, legendary...) can be **deconstructed**. Deconstructing an item transforms the item into another item, usually a material players can then use at the advanced workbench to craft other items. The item players get from deconstructing another item entirely depends on the item tier. Players might drop other weapons, or even materials they can use to craft other weapons.
zh: 具有等级（常见、稀有、传奇...）的物品可以**解构**。解构一个物品会将物品转化为另一个物品，通常材料玩家可以在高级工作台上用来制作其他物品。解构另一个物品得到的物品玩家完全取决于物品品质。玩家可能会掉落其他武器，甚至是可用于制作其他武器的材料。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_deconstruction.BplPIRXg.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_deconstruction.BplPIRXg.png)

source: This feature actually allows players to get rid of the items they can't use because they don't meet the requirements while using another resource (since deconstructing an item requires a consumable).
zh: 此功能实际上允许玩家摆脱它们无法使用的物品，因为它们在使用其他资源时不满足要求（因为解构物品需要消耗品）。

source: This drop table behaves exactly like a monster/block drop table, please refer to [**this wiki page**](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/drop-tables) to learn how to setup them.
zh: 该掉落表的行为与怪物/方块掉落表完全相同，请参阅[**此维基页面**](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/drop-tables)以了解如何设置它们。

source: How to deconstruct an item
zh: 如何分解和物品

source: Players can deconstruct an item by drag & dropping a specific consumable onto their item. This consumable must have the *Can Deconstruct* option toggled on. They will hear a level up sound and receive a message saying their item was successfully deconstructed.
zh: 玩家可以通过将特定的消耗品拖放到物品上来实现分解和物品。此消耗品必须打开 *Can分解* 选项。他们将听到升级声音并收到一条消息，表明他们的物品已成功解构。

source: As seen on the GIF, deconstructing an item can actually give different drops from time to time which means that you can have, for instance, items harder to get than other items when deconstructing a tiered item.
zh: 正如 GIF 所示，解构物品实际上有时会产生不同的掉落物，这意味着在解构分层的物品时，你可能会比其他物品更难获得物品。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/deconstruct_item.BHjGS6v0.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/deconstruct_item.BHjGS6v0.gif)

source: Item Glow & Hints
zh: 物品发光和提示

source: Item hints and item glow are two features that depend on the item tier. **Item Hints** let you display the item name when the item is dropped on the ground, and **Item Glow** makes your item emit a glowing effect (similar to the *Glowing* potion effect) when dropped.
zh: 物品提示和物品发光是取决于物品品质的两个功能。 **物品提示** 可让你在物品掉落到地面时显示物品名称，而 **物品发光** 使你的物品在掉落时发出发光效果（类似于*发光*药水效果）。

source: Since these options depend on the item tier, you can have different glow colors and hint options for each tier! We recommend you to use the item hint and glow features for high tier items only, so that players can easily spot rare loot on the ground. Item hints allow the player to see the item name without having to pick it up, and item glow makes the item easier to spot in dark areas.
zh: 由于这些选项取决于物品品质，因此你可以为每一层设置不同的发光颜色和提示选项！我们建议你仅对高等级物品使用物品提示和发光功能，以便玩家可以轻松发现地面上的稀有战利品。物品提示使玩家无需拿起物品名称即可看到它，而物品发光使物品更容易在黑暗区域中被发现。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_glow_hint.CQb_RIGZ.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_glow_hint.CQb_RIGZ.png)

source: You can enable the item hints by toggling on the `item-glow.hint` option in the tier config file. Remove this config section or leave it to `false` to disable it.
zh: 你可以通过在层配置文件中切换`item-glow.hint`选项来启用物品提示。删除此配置部分或将其留给`false`以禁用它。

source: The `item-glow.color` option lets you setup the item glow color. Leave it to empty to disable item glow for the item tier. You can access the color list using the link provided in the config file.
zh: `item-glow.color`选项允许你设置物品发光颜色。将其保留为空以禁用物品品质的物品发光。你可以使用配置文件中提供的链接访问颜色列表。

source: Unidentified Items
zh: 身份不明物品

source: Item tiers also define a few display options for unidentified items as seen on the following config template:
zh: 物品品质还为未识别的物品定义了一些显示选项，如以下配置模板所示：

source: The item tier does not define the unidentified item pattern (item types do, see this [wiki section](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/types#custom-item-types)). The `name` option corresponds to the tier name displayed in the unidentified item lore. The `range` option corresponds to the unidentified item level range which only displays when the item has the *Required Level* option.
zh: 物品品质没有定义未识别的物品模式（物品类型定义，请参阅此 [wiki 部分](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/types#custom-item-types)）。`name`选项对应于未识别的物品描述中显示的层名称。`range`选项对应于未识别的物品等级范围，仅当物品具有*所需等级*选项时才显示。

source: The level range gives an extra info to the player and lets him know approximately the level of the weapon. Since he can also see the item tier, he can decide whether or not he would like to identify the item. The `prefix` option is used to add a color prefix to both the unidentified item display name, and the tier name displayed in the item lore.
zh: 电平范围为玩家提供额外信息，并让他了解武器的大致电平。由于他还可以看到物品品质，因此他可以决定是否要识别物品。`prefix`选项用于向未识别的物品显示名称和物品描述中显示的层名称添加颜色前缀。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/unidentified_item.DG_2gdTI.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/unidentified_item.DG_2gdTI.png)

source: Modifier Capacity (Item Generation)
zh: 修改器容量（物品一代）

source: > Make sure you learn about [item templates](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/templates) and [item modifiers](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/modifiers) first.
zh: > 确保你首先了解 [物品模板](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/templates)和 [物品修饰器](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/modifiers)。

source: This is a sample from the default item-tiers.yml which we'll be breaking down to understand how to setup modifier capacity for your item tiers.
zh: 这是默认item-tiers.yml的示例，我们将对其进行分解以了解如何为物品品质设置修改器容量。

source: The `generation.chance` option determines the chance for your item tier to be selected when generating a random item. For instance, if set to 0.15, your item will have a 15% chance to be of tier *Uncommon* when generated.
zh: `generation.chance`选项决定了在生成随机物品时选择你的物品品质的机会。例如，如果设置为0.15，则你的物品在生成时将有15%机会成为 *Uncommon* 层。

source: The `generation.capacity` config section defines the tier modifier capacity, and it works like a regular [numeric stat formula](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/stats/stats). The formula is the following: `capacity = <base> + <item_level> * <scale>` to which you add a +/-`<spread>`% offset which a maximum offset of `<max-spread>`%.
zh: `generation.capacity`配置部分定义了层修改器容量，其工作方式类似于常规的[数字属性公式](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/stats/stats)。公式如下：`capacity = <base> + <item_level> * <scale>`，向其中添加 +/-`<spread>`% 偏移量，最大偏移量为`<max-spread>`%。

source: For instance, using the capacity formula in the config snippet above, let's say we are generating a level 12 item: `average-capacity = 6 + 0.1 * 12 = 7.2`. Since there's a 30% max spread, the capacity final value will be randomly picked between `70% * 7.2 = 5.04` and `130% * 7.2 = 9.36`, with an average +/- 10% offset (relative to the average value of 7.2).
zh: 例如，使用上面配置片段中的容量公式，假设我们正在生成等级12物品:`average-capacity = 6 + 0.1 * 12 = 7.2`。由于存在30%最大价差，因此容量最终值将在`70% * 7.2 = 5.04`和`130% * 7.2 = 9.36`之间随机选取，平均为 +/-10%偏移量（相对于7.2的平均值）。

source: 🛠️ Item Types
zh: 🛠️物品类型

source: In MMOItems, all items are split up into categories which are called *item types*. Items may have different behaviours according to their types. They are broad categories indicating if your item is meant to be used as a weapon, as an item that the player can consume, as an item that can be applied onto another item, an accessory...
zh: 在MMOItems中，所有物品都分为称为 *物品类型* 的类别。物品根据其类型可能有不同的行为。它们是广泛的类别，指示你的物品是否打算用作武器、用作玩家可以消耗的物品、用作可以应用于另一个物品的物品、配件...

source: By default, the type of an item is indicated at the very top of the item tooltip.
zh: 默认情况下，物品的类型显示在物品工具提示的最顶部。

source: Hard-Coded Item Types
zh: Hard-Coded物品类型

source: Most of MMOItems functionalities like gem stones, item identification, consumables... rely on hard-coded item types. While MMOItems does include hard-coded stuff, you can register brand new item types to MMOItems and modify their properties.
zh: 大多数MMOItems功能（如宝石、物品识别、消耗品...）都依赖于hard-coded物品类型。虽然MMOItems确实包含hard-coded内容，但你可以将全新的物品类型注册到MMOItems并修改其属性。

source: | Item Types | Description |
zh: |物品类型 |描述 |

source: | Swords, Daggers, Hammers | Hardcoded item types used for weapons. Items |
zh: |剑、匕首、锤子|用于武器的硬编码物品类型。物品|

source: | Bows | The `BOW` item type should be used for any item that has its material set to `BOW` or `CROSSBOW`. Melee attacks are disabled, and the item attack damage applies to arrows fired by the item. Stats apply just like staffs (see below). |
zh: |弓|`BOW`物品类型应用于材质设置为`BOW`或`CROSSBOW`的任何物品。近战攻击被禁用，物品攻击伤害适用于物品发射的箭。属性就像五线谱一样适用（见下文）。 |

source: | Staffs | Staffs should be used for **custom ranged weapon types**. Stats only apply in mainhand, unless they have a right-click effect, in which case weapon-specific stats - attack damage, on-hit effects - also apply during weapon attacks when held in offhand. |
zh: |员工 |员工应用于**自定义范围武器类型**。属性仅适用于主手，除非它们具有right-click效果，在这种情况下weapon-specific属性-攻击伤害、on-hit效果 - 当保存在副手中时，也适用于武器攻击期间。 |

source: | Catalysts | Items with the `CATALYST` item type are accessories which give their stats to the player when held in the main or off hand. Items with the `MAIN_CATALYST` type only apply their stats when held in the main hand. Items with the `OFF_CATALYST` type only apply their stats when held in the off hand. |
zh: |催化剂|物品和`CATALYST`物品类型是配件，当固定在主机或副手中时，它们会将属性赋予玩家。物品和`MAIN_CATALYST`类型仅在固定在主手中时应用其属性。物品和`OFF_CATALYST`类型仅在固定在副手中时应用其属性。 |

source: | Accessories | Accessories are item types which apply their stats when placed in accessory slots, when using MMOInventory. |
zh: |配件 |配件为物品类型，在使用MMOInventory时，放置在配件槽中时应用其属性。 |

source: | Tools | Tools have extra hardcoded options for mining and breaking blocks, like *Autosmelt* (automatically smelts ores) and *Bouncing Crack* (breaks multiple blocks at once). Since tools are considered melee weapons, stats apply in mainhand only. |
zh: |工具|工具具有用于采矿和破坏块的额外硬编码选项，例如*自动熔炼*（自动熔炼矿石）和*弹跳裂纹*（一次破坏多个块）。由于工具被视为近战武器，因此属性仅适用于主手。 |

source: | Item Skins | Item skins can be applied onto items to change their material, custom model data, skull texture, leather armor color... |
zh: |物品皮肤 |物品皮肤可以应用到物品上以更改其材质、自定义模型数据、头骨纹理、皮革护甲颜色... |

source: | Armor | `ARMOR` is the hardcoded item type for any piece of armor. Stats apply when worn in armor slots only. |
zh: |护甲|`ARMOR`是任何护甲的硬编码物品类型。属性仅适用于佩戴在护甲插槽中时。 |

source: | Gem Stones | [Gem stones](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/gem-stones) can be applied onto items to grant them extra stats. |
zh: |宝石 | [宝石](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/gem-stones)可以应用到物品上，以获得额外的属性。 |

source: | Consumables | Consumables can be consumed (eaten) by players to restore health, mana... get temporary buffs, run commands... Stats apply in mainhand only. |
zh: |消耗品|消耗品可以被玩家消耗（吃掉）以恢复生命值，魔力...获得临时增益，运行命令...属性仅适用于主手。 |

source: | Miscellaneous | Anything else. Stats apply in mainhand only. |
zh: |杂项 |还要别的吗。属性仅适用于主手。 |

source: Any hard-coded item type can be disabled hidden from the item browser by toggling on the following option in the `item-types` config file:
zh: 通过在`item-types`配置文件中切换以下选项，可以禁用对物品浏览器隐藏的任何hard-coded物品类型：

source: Custom Item Types
zh: 定制物品类型

source: Existing item types can be modified in the `item-types` config file. Every section in this config file corresponds to one item type ; you may write as many new config sections as you like, in order to register new item types. There's no limit on the number of item types. Do not forget to reload MMOItems using `/mi reload` after adding or modifying any item type. New item types should immediately appear inside the item browser (`/mi browse`).
zh: 可以在`item-types`配置文件中修改现有的物品类型。此配置文件中的每个部分对应于一种物品类型；你可以根据需要编写任意数量的新配置部分，以便注册新的物品类型。物品类型的数量没有限制。添加或修改任何物品类型后，不要忘记使用`/mi reload`重新加载MMOItems。新的物品类型应立即出现在物品浏览器 (`/mi browse`) 中。

source: Here is the general syntax:
zh: 这是一般语法：

source: ID/Name/Display
zh: ID/名称/显示

source: The `display` section corresponds to the icon used in the item browser for your item type. The `name` corresponds to the string tag players will see on the item tooltip. Finally, `LONG_SWORD` is the type ID, which you will use as a reference to your item type, when running commands.
zh: `display`部分对应于物品类型的物品浏览器中使用的图标。`name`对应于物品工具提示上将看到的字符串标记玩家。最后，`LONG_SWORD`是类型ID，你将在运行命令时将其用作物品类型的引用。

source: Parent Type
zh: 父类型

source: Every custom item type has a **parent type**. The parent type defines what stats the item can has. If the parent type is set to `CONSUMABLE`, your item type will inherit from all the item options and stats from the Consumable item type. Similarly, your item type inherits from the stat application rules given by the parent type. If the parent type is `SWORD`, the stats of any item will only apply in mainhand.
zh: 每个自定义物品类型都有一个**父类型**。父类型定义了属性和物品可以具有的内容。如果父类型设置为`CONSUMABLE`，你的物品类型将从所有物品选项继承，而属性从消耗品物品类型继承。同样，你的物品类型继承自父类型给出的属性应用程序规则。如果父类型为`SWORD`，则任何物品的属性将仅适用于主手。

source: Types with multiple parents can also be used to display different item types in the item tooltips. It is completely fine to have types only differ by their names/tooltips: players will see something different in the item tooltips, and you can use those to organize your items inside your config files and in the item browser.
zh: 具有多个父项的类型也可用于在物品工具提示中显示不同的物品类型。类型仅在名称/工具提示上有所不同是完全可以的：玩家将在物品工具提示中看到不同的内容，你可以使用它们在配置文件和物品浏览器中组织物品。

source: Unidentified Item Template
zh: 身份不明的物品模板

source: The `unident-item` config section determines how an unidentified item from that item type looks like. You can edit its display material, name and lore (both name and lore supports provided placeholders). `#prefix#` returns the color prefix of the unidentified item tier. `#tier#` returns the display name of the unidentified item tier. `#range#` is the unidentified item's level range, which also depends on its item tier.
zh: `unident-item`配置部分确定来自该物品类型的未识别物品的外观。你可以编辑其显示材质、名称和描述（名称和描述均支持提供的占位符）。`#prefix#`返回未识别的物品品质的颜色前缀。`#tier#`返回未识别的物品品质的显示名称。`#range#`是未识别的物品的等级范围，这也取决于其物品品质。

source: Lines starting with `{tier}` only display if the unidentified item has a tier. Similarly, lines starting with `{range}` only display if the item has some data associated with the *Required Level* stat.
zh: 仅当未识别的物品具有层时，才会显示以`{tier}`开头的行。同样，以`{range}`开头的行仅在物品具有与 *所需等级*属性关联的某些数据时显示。

source: Actions
zh: 行动

source: These options are for custom weapons. They define what your weapon does, for both melee and ranged weapons.
zh: 这些选项适用于定制武器。它们定义了你的武器对于近战和远程武器的作用。

source: | header | Description |
zh: |标题|描述 |

source: | `on-left-click` | Skill cast when left clicking an item. Subject to weapon constraints like mana cost, attack speed... |
zh: |`on-left-click`|技能左键单击物品时进行投射。受武器约束，例如魔力成本、攻击速度... |

source: | `on-right-click` | Skill cast when left clicking an item. Subject to weapon constraints like mana cost, attack speed... |
zh: |`on-right-click`|技能左键单击物品时进行投射。受武器约束，例如魔力成本、攻击速度... |

source: | `on-attack` | Skill cast when attacking an entity (melee and range attacks are both supported). |
zh: |`on-attack`|技能攻击实体时施放（支持近战和远程攻击）。 |

source: | `on-entity-interact` | Skill cast when right clicking an entity. |
zh: |`on-entity-interact`|技能右键单击​​实体时进行投射。 |

source: The following will cast the builtin MythicLib ability `FIREBOLT` on right clicks:
zh: 以下将在右键单击时施展内置MythicLib能力`FIREBOLT`：

source: The following will cast a MythicMobs script called `FireBolt` when attacking an entity:
zh: 以下将在攻击实体时投射名为`FireBolt`的MythicMobs脚本：

source: You can cast any skill registered in MythicLib using this option, including builtin skills, skills created using MythicLibs, MythicMobs... You can find information on how to create/register a custom skill [over the MythicLib wiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/intro).
zh: 你可以使用此选项投射在MythicLib中注册的任何技能，包括内置技能、使用 MythicLibs 创建的技能、MythicMobs...你可以找到有关如何创建/注册自定义技能的信息 [通过MythicLibwiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/intro)。

source: `on-attack` and `on-entity-interact` are not subject to weapon constraints, these skills/scripts will trigger every time you damage an entity, or every time you interact with one.
zh: `on-attack`和`on-entity-interact`不受武器约束，这些技能/脚本将在每次损坏实体或每次与实体交互时触发。

source: However, `on-left-click` and `on-right-click` are subject to weapon constraints. These scripts will only cast after checking the following weapon usage constraints:
zh: 但是，`on-left-click`和`on-right-click`受武器约束。这些脚本仅在检查以下武器使用限制后才会进行转换：

source: the player has enough resource (mana/stamina/...)
zh: 玩家有足够的资源（魔力/耐力/...）

source: the item has enough durability
zh: 物品有足够的耐久度

source: the item is actually usable (player has the right class, level, permission...)
zh: 物品实际上是可用的（玩家有正确的职业，等级，权限...）

source: Attack Cooldown Key
zh: 攻击冷却时间密钥

source: Most ranged weapons like staffs, wands, whips have a cooldown associated with using the item (performing an attack), and this cooldown is usually just the invert of the attack speed. An attack speed of 2.5 means you can attack every 1/2.5 second.
zh: 大多数远程武器（如法杖、魔杖、鞭子）都有与使用物品（执行攻击）相关的冷却时间，而这个冷却时间通常只是攻击速度的反转。2.5的攻击速度意味着你可以每秒攻击1/2.5。

source: Two items with the same type have the same item cooldown. If you cast a ranged attack with a wand and quickly switch to another wand, the second wand will be on cooldown, and this cooldown will be shared across the two items.
zh: 两个相同型号的物品具有相同的物品冷却时间。如果你使用魔杖进行远程攻击并快速切换到另一根魔杖，则第二根魔杖将位于冷却时间上，并且该冷却时间将在两个物品之间共享。

source: Two types with the same attack cooldown key share item cooldowns. If types `WAND` and `STAFF` both have `MAGIC` as attack cooldown key, items will have shared cooldowns. This might be an important tool for balancing the gameplay of your items.
zh: 具有相同攻击冷却时间密钥的两种类型共享物品冷却时间。如果类型`WAND`和`STAFF`都具有`MAGIC`作为攻击冷却时间密钥，则物品将共享冷却时间。这可能是平衡物品游戏玩法的重要工具。

source: Built-in Item Types
zh: Built-in物品类型

source: The following wiki section shows the default item types that come bundled with MMOItems. You are not required to use these item types; in fact you can even delete them if you don't want them to show in the item browser.
zh: 以下 wiki 部分显示了与MMOItems捆绑在一起的默认物品类型。你不需要使用这些物品类型；事实上，如果你不希望它们显示在物品浏览器中，你甚至可以删除它们。

source: Blunt, Pierce and Slash weapons are built-in melee weapon types. Such items have an on-hit effect which typically propagates a fraction of the damage dealt to nearby enemies. These behaviours are **NOT** hardcoded into MMOItems, they are implemented using MythicLibs/MythicMobs skills/scripts. This means that you can fully finetune them to your liking by editing the scripts located in the `MythicLib/script/mmoitems_types.yml` config file. This config file contains all built-in softcoded on-hit attack effects that correspond to item types.
zh: 钝击、刺击和斜击武器是built-in近战武器类型。此类物品具有on-hit效果，通常会将造成的一小部分伤害传播给附近的敌人。这些行为**不**硬编码到MMOItems中，它们是使用 MythicLibs/MythicMobs技能/scripts 实现的。这意味着你可以通过编辑`MythicLib/script/mmoitems_types.yml`配置文件中的脚本来根据你的喜好完全微调它们。此配置文件包含与物品类型相对应的所有built-in软编码on-hit攻击效果。

source: Staffs, muskets, wands... are built-in ranged weapon types. Their right/left click attack effects are also implemented using MythicLibs/MythicMobs scripts, which you can edit in the same config file.
zh: 法杖、步枪、魔杖...均为built-in系列武器类型。他们的右键/左键单击攻击效果也是使用 MythicLibs/MythicMobs脚本实现的，你可以在同一配置文件中编辑这些脚本。

source: <summary>Slashing Weapons</summary>
zh: <summary>斩击武器</summary>

source: Slashing weapons perform AoE damage, in a cone behind the initial target. Slashing weapons include swords, greatswords, katanas, axes, greataxes, halberds.
zh: 挥砍武器在初始目标后面的圆锥体中造成AoE伤害。砍伐武器包括剑、巨剑、武士刀、斧头、巨斧、戟。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/slash_weapons.DAua-dsH.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/slash_weapons.DAua-dsH.gif)

source: <summary>Piercing Weapons</summary>
zh: <summary>穿孔武器</summary>

source: Similarly to slashing weapons, piercing weapons perform AoE damage on melee attacks in a cone behind the initial target. The angle of the cone is sharper, but the damage propagation ratio higher. Piercing weapons include thrusting swords, daggers, spears, lances.
zh: 与挥砍武器类似，刺穿武器会对初始目标后面的圆锥体中的近战攻击造成AoE伤害。锥体的角度越尖锐，但损伤传播率越高。穿刺类武器包括刺剑、匕首、长矛、长矛。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/piercing_weapons.CtCBiXzE.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/piercing_weapons.CtCBiXzE.gif)

source: <summary>Blunt Weapons</summary>
zh: <summary>钝头武器</summary>

source: Similarly to Sweeping Edge, blunt weapons deal AoE damage and knockback on melee attacks. Blunt weapons include hammers, greathammers, gauntlets, lutes, staves, greatstaves. Gauntlets also come with a default right-click ability which applies a knockback onto the target entity.
zh: 与横扫之刃类似，钝器武器在近战攻击中造成AoE伤害和击退伤害。钝器武器包括锤子、巨锤、手套、鲁特琴、法杖、巨杖。护手还带有默认的right-click能力，可将击退应用于目标实体。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/blunt_weapons.CjnzwdC3.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/blunt_weapons.CjnzwdC3.gif)

source: <summary>Whips & Muskets</summary>
zh: <summary>鞭子和火枪</summary>

source: Whips are ranged weapons with a special attack effect. They deal damage to the first enemy hit in the direction of the player's camera direction. Muskets are guns with extra item options. You can configure their recoil (how much they move around the player's camera direction when firing), knockback, reload time through attack speed...
zh: 鞭子的射程为武器，具有特殊的攻击效果。它们对玩家摄像机方向上第一个击中的敌人造成伤害。步枪是带有额外物品选项的枪支。你可以通过攻击速度配置它们的后坐力（射击时它们围绕玩家的相机方向移动多少）、击退、重新加载时间...

source: <summary>Crossbows</summary>
zh: <summary>弩</summary>

source: The `CROSSBOW` item type is an item type that was added before Crossbows were implemented into vanilla Minecraft. Right click a crossbow to fire one arrow. The item attack speed dictates the frequency at which you may fire arrows.
zh: `CROSSBOW`物品类型是在 Crossbows 实现到原版Minecraft之前添加的物品类型。右键单击十字弓可发射一支箭。物品攻击速度指示你可以发射箭的频率。

source: 🔨 Item Upgrades
zh: 🔨物品升级

source: Item upgrades are a way of adding some progression to your items. When successfully upgrading an item, its item statistics are increased which essentially makes the item better. Players can upgrade their items either using the right consumable, or by using a station **upgrading recipe**.
zh: 物品升级是为你的物品添加一些进度的一种方式。当成功升级物品时，其物品属性会增加，这本质上使物品变得更好。玩家可以使用正确的消耗品或使用工作站**升级配方**来升级其物品。

source: When upgraded, items gain one level. The level is displayed next to the item display name. The display name suffix can be changed in the main plugin config file (*item-upgrading.name-suffix*). Make sure your item has a custom display name, otherwise the suffix will not show up.
zh: 升级后，物品获得一级。等级显示在物品显示名称旁边。显示名称后缀可以在主插件配置文件（*item-upgrading.name-suffix*）中更改。确保你的物品有自定义显示名称，否则后缀将不会显示。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_upgrade_nb.DG3D9zxd.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_upgrade_nb.DG3D9zxd.png)

source: There are 3 things to setup in order to have a working item upgrading system: first of all, you need to setup the upgrading template, which dictates what stats are increased (by how much) when successfully upgrading an item. Then you need to setup some extra upgrading options for the item you want to upgrade. The last step is to setup either an upgrading consumable or an [upgrading recipe](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/upgrading-recipes).
zh: 为了拥有一个有效的物品升级系统，需要设置一些3的东西：首先，你需要设置升级模板，该模板指示成功升级物品时属性增加的内容（增加多少）。然后，你需要为要升级的物品设置一些额外的升级选项。最后一步是设置升级消耗品或 [升级配方](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/upgrading-recipes)。

source: Setting up the upgrading template
zh: 设置升级模板

source: The upgrade templates can be setup in the **upgrade-templates.yml** config file. This step is pretty straight forward but might require a bit of time to spend in the configs balancing your upgrading setup. Open your templates config file:
zh: 升级模板可以在 **upgrade-templates.yml** 配置文件中设置。此步骤非常简单，但可能需要一些时间来平衡升级设置的配置。打开你的模板配置文件：

source: Every configuration section in that config file corresponds to one **upgrading template**. You can add as many templates as you like, you may even add one per item (although multiple items may have the same upgrading template). Once setup, you will be able to bind these templates to specific items to determine how they behave when they are upgraded. Let's try to read what the config says step by step.
zh: 该配置文件中的每个配置部分都对应一个**升级模板**。你可以添加任意数量的模板，甚至可以为每个物品添加一个模板（尽管多个物品可能具有相同的升级模板）。设置完成后，你将能够将这些模板绑定到特定的物品以确定它们在升级时的行为方式。让我们尝试逐步阅读配置的内容。

source: **weapon-template-example:** This is an upgrading template example for weapons. Every item upgrade, the weapon will gain 3% of its current attack damage *(meaning his current attack damage will be multiplied by 1.03)*, because the input ends with `%`. Every item upgrade, the weapon also gains 2% critical strike chance (not relative to its current critical strike chance, but since crit strike chance is in %, the item still gains 2% crit chance), as well as 1% PvE damage, relative to its current attack speed.
zh: **weapon-template-example:** 这是武器的升级模板示例。每次物品升级，武器都会获得当前攻击伤害的3%*（意味着他当前的攻击伤害将乘以1.03）*，因为输入以`%`结尾。每次物品升级，武器也会获得2%暴击几率（与当前的暴击几率无关，但由于暴击几率以％为单位，物品仍然获得2%暴击几率）以及1%PvE损坏，相对于其当前的攻击速度。

source: **armor-default:** When upgraded, an item with this upgrade template will gain 3% armor, 2% toughness, 5% block, dodge and parry rating, relative to its current stats since there is a `%`.
zh: **armor-default:** 升级后，使用此升级模板的物品将获得3%护甲、2%韧性、5%格挡、闪避和招架等级（相对于其当前的属性），因为存在`%`。

source: The `%` specified in the upgrade template does not have anything to do with the stat itself. It only means that the stat value gained by the item when upgrading is relative to the stat value that the previously item had. For instance, for a 8 Atk. Damage sword, gaining 3% attack damage (relative) isn't the same as gaining 3 attack damage (absolute).
zh: 升级模板中指定的`%`与属性本身没有任何关系。这只意味着物品升级时获得的属性值是相对于之前的物品的属性值而言的。例如，对于8Atk。伤害剑，获得3%攻击伤害（相对）与获得3攻击伤害（绝对）不同。

source: Let's have a look at another example. Let's say we have a **sword with 10 Attack Damage** being upgraded, bound to the **weapon-default** upgrade template. This sword will thus gain 3% of its current damage, so at the end it will have `10 + (3% * 10) = 10 + 10 * 0.03 = 10.3 Atk. Damage`, as well as 2% Crit Chance since it didn't have any before, and since the crit chance earned per upgrade is independent of the current stat value. The sword does not have any PvE damage, so gaining 1% PvE damage relative to its current value doesn't increase the PvE damage, since 1% of 0 is still 0.
zh: 让我们看另一个例子。假设我们有一把正在升级10攻击伤害** 的 **剑，绑定到 **weapon-default** 升级模板。因此，这把剑将获得3%的当前伤害，因此最终它将拥有`10 + (3% * 10) = 10 + 10 * 0.03 = 10.3 Atk. Damage`，以及2%暴击几率，因为它之前没有任何暴击几率，并且每次升级获得的暴击几率与当前的属性值无关。该剑没有任何PvE伤害，因此相对于其当前值获得1%PvE伤害不会增加PvE伤害，因为0的1%仍然是0。

source: > Currently, item upgrading only applies to numeric stats like Crit Chance, Attack Damage, Armor, PvE damage, etc.
zh: > 目前，物品升级仅适用于数字属性，如暴击率、攻击伤害、护甲、PvE伤害等。

source: Setting up the upgrading options for the consumable
zh: 设置消耗品的升级选项

source: Players may use a consumable in order to upgrade an item. If so, you need to specify two options: the **upgrading reference**, which we will get back to later, and the **upgrade chance**. You can configure both of these options in the edition menu.
zh: 玩家可以使用消耗品来升级物品。如果是这样，你需要指定两个选项：**升级参考**（我们稍后会讨论）和**升级机会**。你可以在版本菜单中配置这两个选项。

source: Setting up the upgrading options for the weapon/armor/...
zh: 设置武器/护甲/... 的升级选项

source: Any item, including armors, weapons, etc. can be upgraded, however you need a few options set up in order to upgrade an item. Just like consumables, weapons/armors also have an upgrading chance. The upgrading chances of the weapon and the consumable stack, i.e `total-upgrade-chance = <item-upgrade-chance> * <consumable-upgrade-chance>`. If both items have a 40% upgrade chance, the total upgrade chance is `40% * 40% = 16%`. When the item does not have 100% chance to be upgraded, you can enable an extra option which makes the **item break when failing to upgrade it.**
zh: 任何物品，包括盔甲、武器等都可以升级，但是你需要设置一些选项才能升级物品。就像消耗品一样，武器/盔甲也有升级机会。武器和消耗品堆栈的升级机会i.e`total-upgrade-chance = <item-upgrade-chance> * <consumable-upgrade-chance>`。如果两个物品都有40%升级机会，则总升级机会为`40% * 40% = 16%`。当物品没有100%升级机会时，你可以启用一个额外的选项，使 **物品在升级失败时中断。**

source: Here is an example of an item that utilizes the `another-example` upgrade template.
zh: 以下是使用`another-example`升级模板的物品示例。

source: An item may also have a **maximum amount of upgrades**, meaning that once the item reaches a specific level, it cannot be upgraded anymore. This is an important option if you don't want specific items to get too OP with upgrades. An item can also be upgradable only via crafting stations and upgrading recipes.
zh: 物品还可能有**最大升级次数**，这意味着一旦物品达到特定等级，就无法再升级。如果你不希望特定的物品通过升级获得太多 OP，那么这是一个重要的选项。物品也可以仅通过合成站和升级配方进行升级。

source: Don't forget to bind an upgrading template to your item using the corresponding option in the edition GUI! Options described previously can also be setup using the item edition GUI.
zh: 不要忘记使用GUI版本中的相应选项将升级模板绑定到你的物品！前面描述的选项也可以使用物品版本GUI进行设置。

source: Upgrade reference
zh: 升级参考

source: This option can be used for both upgrading consumables and upgradable items. This option can be used to restrict specific upgrade consumables to specific items. The upgrade reference is a piece of text, not displayed in the lore but used by MI to check if a consumable is compatible with a given item for upgrading.
zh: 该选项可用于升级消耗品和可升级物品。该选项可用于将特定升级消耗品限制为特定物品。升级参考是一段文本，不会显示在描述中，但 MI 使用它来检查消耗品是否与给定的物品兼容进行升级。

source: A consumable can be used to upgrade an item if the two references match. If the first item has a non-null reference and if the other one has no reference, they are incompatible. Any item with the universal upgrade reference `all` is compatible with any other item.
zh: 如果两个参考匹配，则消耗品可用于升级物品。如果第一个物品有non-null参考，而另一个没有参考，则它们不兼容。任何具有通用升级参考号`all`的物品都与任何其他物品兼容。

source: Config File
zh: 配置文件

zh: 你可以修改主 MI 配置文件 (`MMOItems/config.yml`)，以调整属性更改在任何升级的物品的物品描述中的显示方式。以下是你需要查看并可能修改的部分：

source: Upgrading recipes
zh: 升级配方

source: Using crafting stations you can create crafting recipes, which require the player to have specific ingredients and meet certain conditions. When using such a recipe players can upgrade their gear. Please check out this [wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/upgrading-recipes) for more information.
zh: 使用合成站你可以创建合成配方，这要求玩家具有特定成分并满足某些条件。当使用玩家这样的配方时可以升级他们的装备。请查看此 [wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/upgrading-recipes)以获取更多信息。

zh: 以下是实现这些升级方案之一的合成站的示例

source: There is the consumable used in the ingredient list above (has to be put in the `material.yml` config file). This is basically an item that only serves as an ingredient for crafting station upgrading recipes.
zh: 上面的成分列表中使用了消耗品（必须放入`material.yml`配置文件中）。这基本上是一个物品，仅用作合成站升级配方的成分。

source: 🌱 Spawning Custom Blocks
zh: 🌱 生成自定义块

source: *World gen templates* are used to make your custom blocks spawn in a newly generated world. Custom blocks spawn in veins of a random amount of blocks. They may only spawn in a set list of biomes of worlds. Gen templates do also have more specific options that this wiki page will be overviewing.
zh: *世界生成模板*用于使你的自定义块在新生成的世界中生成。自定义块在随机数量的块的矿脉中生成。它们可能只会在世界的一组生物群落列表中生成。 Gen 模板还具有本 wiki 页面将概述的更具体的选项。

source: **If you want custom blocks to spawn in your worlds, make sure you enable the `custom-blocks.enable-world-gen` option in the main MMOItems config file!**
zh: **如果你希望在你的世界中生成自定义块，请确保在主MMOItems配置文件中启用`custom-blocks.enable-world-gen`选项！**

source: Basic gen template example
zh: 基本生成模板示例

source: When a world is being generated, every chunk has a set chance to be selected in order to spawn a block (`chunk-chance`). You may also configure the depth at which your block will be placed. The `replace` option defines what vanilla blocks your custom block will replace. That means custom blocks cannot spawn midair so that custom ores can spawn inside stone walls just like vanilla ores.
zh: 当生成世界时，每个块都有一定的机会被选择以生成块（`chunk-chance`）。你还可以配置块放置的深度。`replace`选项定义你的自定义块将替换哪些原版块。这意味着自定义方块无法在半空中生成，因此自定义矿石可以像原版矿石一样在石墙内生成。

source: `vein-count` is the amount of veins that will be generated inside a selected chunk, `vein-size` is the amount of custom blocks that will be generated in every block vein.
zh: `vein-count`是将在选定块内生成的矿脉数量，`vein-size`是将在每个块矿脉中生成的自定义块数量。

source: Specific options
zh: 具体选项

source: Use the `slime-chunk` option so that your block may only spawn in slime chunks.
zh: 使用`slime-chunk`选项，这样你的方块只能生成粘液块。

source: Use the `bordering` or `not-bordering` options so that your blocks only spawn if specific blocks surrounding the custom block meet their conditions.
zh: 使用`bordering`或`not-bordering`选项，以便你的块仅在自定义块周围的特定块满足其条件时生成。

source: In this example, the `end-debris` would only generate if one of the faces is touching air.
zh: 在此示例中，`end-debris`仅当其中一个面接触空气时才会生成。

source: Biome/World black/whitelist
zh: 生物群落/世界黑/白名单

source: By adding an entry to the `worlds` list, you can restrict any custom block to a specific set of worlds. If you use `!` before the world name, the world whitelist will turn into a blacklist, and the custom block will spawn anywhere but in the specified worlds.
zh: 通过向`worlds`列表添加条目，你可以将任何自定义块限制到一组特定的世界。如果你在世界名称前使用`!`，世界白名单将变成黑名单，并且自定义块将在指定世界之外的任何地方生成。

source: The format is the same for biomes, just use `biomes` instead of `worlds` and input the biomes names ([Spigot javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/block/Biome.html)).
zh: 生物群落的格式相同，只需使用`biomes`而不是`worlds`并输入生物群落名称（[Spigotjavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/block/Biome.html)）。

source: | `/mmoitems create <type> <id>` | Creates a new item with the specified item type and item ID. ID is NOT the display name. |
zh: |`/mmoitems create <type> <id>`|使用指定的物品类型和物品ID创建新的物品。ID不是显示名称。 |

source: | `/mi copy <type> <current-id> <new-id>` | Copies the item you are holding into a new item with a different ID. Useful if mass producing. |
zh: |`/mi copy <type> <current-id> <new-id>`|将你持有的物品复制到具有不同ID的新物品中。如果批量生产很有用。 |

source: | `/mi delete <type> <id>` | Deletes the specified item. |
zh: |`/mi delete <type> <id>`|删除指定的物品。 |

source: | `/mi edit <type> <id>` | Opens up the item editor. |
zh: |`/mi edit <type> <id>`|打开物品编辑器。 |

source: | `/updateitem` | Updates the item you are holding. |
zh: |`/updateitem`|更新你持有的物品。 |

source: | `/updateitem <type> <id>` | Turns on the automatic [Item Updater](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/revision-id) for a specific item. It is not totally recommended to leave this on constantly as always updating items may eventually cause lag if you have enough. |
zh: |`/updateitem <type> <id>`|打开特定物品的自动 [物品更新程序](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/revision-id)。不完全建议始终保持此状态，因为如果你有足够的更新，则始终更新物品最终可能会导致延迟。 |

source: | `/mi drop <type> <item-id> <world> <x> <y> <x>` | Generates and drops (essentially spawn in an item without putting it in a player inventory). |
zh: |`/mi drop <type> <item-id> <world> <x> <y> <x>`|生成并掉落（本质上是在物品中生成，而不将其放入玩家物品栏中）。 |

source: | `/mi item identify` | Manually identifies the item you are holding. |
zh: |`/mi item identify`|手动识别你所持有的物品。 |

source: | `/mi item repair` | Manually repairs the item you are holding. |
zh: |`/mi item repair`|手动修复你持有的物品。 |

source: | `/mi item unidentify` | Manually UNidentifies the item you are holding. |
zh: |`/mi item unidentify`|手动取消识别你所持有的物品。 |

source: | `/mi item deconstruct` | Manually deconstructs the item you are holding. |
zh: |`/mi item deconstruct`|手动解构你持有的物品。 |

source: | `/mi give <type> <item> (player) (min-max) (unident-chance) (drop-chance) (soulbound-chance) (silent)` | Gives an item to a player |
zh: |`/mi give <type> <item> (player) (min-max) (unident-chance) (drop-chance) (soulbound-chance) (silent)`|将物品赋予玩家|

source: Item Management
zh: 物品管理

source: | `/mi browse` | Pulls up an interactable library of ALL of our created items, sorted by item types. (Recommended for most item creation!) |
zh: |`/mi browse`|提取我们创建的所有物品的可交互库，按物品类型排序。 （推荐用于大多数物品创作！） |

source: | `/mi itemlist <type>` | Lists all items from a specific item type. |
zh: |`/mi itemlist <type>`|列出特定物品类型的所有物品。 |

source: | `/mi allitems` | Lists all created items, not as useful as /mi browse. |
zh: | `/mi allitems` | 列出所有已创建物品，但不如 /mi browse 方便。 |

source: | `/mi giveall <type> <item> <min-max> <unident-chance>` | Gives an item to all online players. |
zh: |`/mi giveall <type> <item> <min-max> <unident-chance>`|为所有在线玩家提供物品。 |

source: Crafting Stations
zh: 合成站

source: | `/mi stations list` | Lists all current crafting stations. |
zh: |`/mi stations list`|列出所有当前的合成站。 |

source: | `/mi stations open <station> (player)` | This opens the specified station, for the specified player. This is the command you would use to bind stations to blocks. |
zh: |`/mi stations open <station> (player)`|这将为指定的玩家打开指定的站。这是将站绑定到块的命令。 |

source: | `/mi ability <ability> (player) (mod1) (val1) (mod2) (val2)` | Cast an MMOItems ability (works with MM skills as well). There is arguments to select the ability, the player who casts it, and modify the values like damage and cooldown etc. |
zh: |`/mi ability <ability> (player) (mod1) (val1) (mod2) (val2)`|施放MMOItems能力（也可与 MM技能配合使用）。存在选择该能力、施放该能力的玩家以及修改伤害和冷却时间等值的参数。

source: | `/mi heal` | Similar to essentials/CMI heal, this heals you and removes all negative effects. |
zh: |`/mi heal`|与精华/CMI 治疗类似，这可以治愈你并消除所有负面影响。 |

source: MMOItems is the last RPG item plugin you will ever need. Create custom weapons, items, armors, consumables... with unique stats, display options and abilities. It is fully compatible with the most popupar resource pack management plugins such as ItemsAdder, Nexo or Oraxen. MMOItems can use skills from MythicMobs and features RPG functionalities like item identification, item tiers, item sets, reforging, crafting stations, Soulbound, and many many more.
zh: MMOItems 面向 RPG 服务器，可创建自定义武器、物品、盔甲和消耗品，并为它们设置独特的属性、显示效果和技能。它完整兼容 ItemsAdder、Nexo、Oraxen 等常用资源包管理插件，也能使用 MythicMobs 的技能。功能还包括物品鉴定、物品品质、套装、重铸、合成站和灵魂绑定等。
