source: 🖌️ Create An Item
zh: 🖌️ 创建一个物品

source: This wiki page explains the two methods you can use to create items in MMOItems.
zh: 此 wiki 页面介绍了可用于在MMOItems中创建物品的两种方法。

source: Item Edition GUI
zh: 物品版GUI

source: The item editor lets you create and edit items directly in-game without having to tamper with config files. This is a powerful and easy-to-understand method although we recommend advanced users to directly go for manual config file edits which is much faster if you know how all the stats are formatted.
zh: 物品编辑器允许你直接创建和编辑物品in-game，而无需篡改配置文件。这是一种强大的easy-to-understand方法，尽管我们建议高级用户直接进行手动配置文件编辑，如果你知道所有属性的格式如何，速度会快得多。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/edition_gui.9FGRG2Fx.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/edition_gui.9FGRG2Fx.gif)

source: Open the game and create an item using via this command: `/mi create <ITEM_TYPE> <YOUR_ITEM_ID>`
zh: 打开游戏并通过以下命令创建物品：`/mi create <ITEM_TYPE> <YOUR_ITEM_ID>`

source: You may use /mi list type to check all the available item types (Sword, Axe, Tool...).
zh: 可以使用 /mi list type 查看全部可用物品类型，例如 Sword、Axe、Tool 等。

source: The item ID will be used in every command/config file to identify the item. It should be something like STEEL_DAGGER to make config setup cleaner.
zh: 物品ID将在每个命令/配置文件中用于识别物品。它应该类似于STEEL_DAGGER以使配置设置更清晰。

source: The edition menu should open up after performing the create command. If you close it, you can still access it using this command: `/mi edit <ITEM_TYPE> <YOUR_ITEM_ID>`
zh: 执行创建命令后，版本菜单应该打开。如果关闭它，你仍然可以使用以下命令访问它：`/mi edit <ITEM_TYPE> <YOUR_ITEM_ID>`

source: On the 5th slot of the inventory, you can see your item and its current stats. You can click the chest item to add it to your inventory.
zh: 在物品栏的5th插槽上，你可以看到你的物品及其当前的属性。你可以点击宝箱物品将其添加到你的物品栏中。

source: Every other item corresponds to an item stat that you can edit. Instructions on how to edit them are displayed directly in-game.
zh: 每个其他物品都对应于你可以编辑的物品属性。有关如何编辑它们的说明直接显示in-game。

source: Once you added all the stats you wanted, get your item and have fun!
zh: 添加完你想要的所有属性后，即可获得你的物品并享受乐趣！

zh: 手动配置编辑

source: Advanced users should consider using this method as it is way faster if you already know the item options you'd like to use and how to format them.
zh: 高级用户应考虑使用此方法，因为如果你已经知道要使用的物品选项以及如何格式化它们，它会更快。

source: Open up the `/MMOItems/item` folder.
zh: 打开`/MMOItems/item`文件夹。

source: Select your item type and open the corresponding YML file using your favourite text editor.
zh: 选择你的物品类型并使用你喜欢的文本编辑器打开相应的 YML 文件。

source: Here is a config snippet that you can start with:
zh: 你可以从以下配置片段开始：

source: The list of available materials can be found in the [Spigot javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Material.html). The item material is the first thing to add since it is the only real option an item needs to be able to be generated.
zh: 可用材料的列表可以在 [Spigotjavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Material.html)] 中找到。物品材质是首先要添加的，因为它是物品需要能够生成的唯一实际选项。

source: Add as much item options (Abilities, Attack Damage....) as you want. You can see 'all' of the available item options (and how to configure them) on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/stats/stats).

source: Save the file and get back on Minecraft. Use /mi reload to let MMOItems load the item you just added to your config file, and use `/mi give <ITEM_TYPE> <YOUR_ITEM_ID>` to get your item!
zh: 保存文件并回到 Minecraft。执行 /mi reload，让 MMOItems 加载刚加入配置的物品，再执行 `/mi give <ITEM_TYPE> <YOUR_ITEM_ID>` 获取物品。

source: 👛 Drop Tables
zh: 👛 删除表

source: Data is stored in the `drops.yml` config file, located in the main plugin folder. Here is a config snippet:
zh: 数据存储在`drops.yml`配置文件中，位于主插件文件夹中。这是一个配置片段：

source: Drop tables are split into **subtables**. When a drop table is read, a random subtable among all the subtables is chosen and the items from that subtable are then dropped. Having multiple subtables allows you to actually prevent two items from spawning at the same time.
zh: 删除表被分成**子表**。当读取删除表时，会在所有子表中选择一个随机子表，然后删除该子表中的物品。拥有多个子表可以让你实际上阻止两个物品同时生成。

source: Let's say for instance you want a zombie to drop a custom iron sword or a custom leather chestplate. Since having a chance to drop both items at the same time would be too overpowered, you can split the zombie drop table into two subtables. In the first subtable, you would have your iron sword, and in the second subtable you would have the iron chestplate. This way, these two items can't spawn at the same time.
zh: 举例来说，你希望僵尸掉落一把定制铁剑或定制皮革胸甲。由于有机会同时掉落两个物品太过强大，因此你可以将僵尸掉落表分成两个子表。在第一个子表中，你将拥有铁剑，在第二个子表中，你将拥有铁胸甲。这样，这两个物品就不能同时生成。

source: Subtables can have different subtable coefficients. The higher the coefficient is, the higher the chance is for the subtable to be selected. Calculating the chance for a subtable to be selected is pretty easy. If, inside a drop table, the first subtable has a coefficient of 1 and the second has a coefficient of 2, the first subtable has a 1 in 3 chance of being selected. The chance for a subtable to be chosen can thus be calculated using the following formula.
zh: 子表可以有不同的子表系数。系数越高，子表被选中的机会就越大。计算子表被选择的机会非常简单。如果在删除表内，第一个子表的系数为1，第二个子表的系数为2，则第一个子表的被选择机会为1和3。因此，可以使用以下公式计算子表被选择的机会。

Follow the same format as in the monsters section, but replace the mob name by the block type name. source: **You can configurate three values for each subtable item:**
zh: **你可以为每个子表物品配置三个值：**

source: **drop-chance** - The chance for your item to drop.
zh: **drop-chance** -物品掉落的几率。

source: **min & max** - The amount of drops is chosen randomly between these two values.
zh: **最小和最大** - 滴的数量在这两个值之间随机选择。

source: **unidentified-chance** - the chance for your item to be unidentified when it drops.
zh: **unidentified-chance** - 你的物品掉落时有可能无法识别。

source: **Additional subtable options:**
zh: **附加子表选项：**

source: **disable-silk-touch** - when set to true, this will prevent the subtable from dropping any item if the block was mined with a silk touch pickaxe. This prevents item duplication glitches with blocks like ores.
zh: **disable-silk-touch** - 当设置为true时，如果该块是用丝触镐开采的，这将防止子表掉落任何物品。这可以防止物品与矿石等方块发生重复故障。

source: Items
zh: 物品

source: 🏷️ Item Modifiers
zh: 🏷️物品修饰器

source: > Make sure you read [this page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/templates) first. The MMOItems item generation system is pretty complex and needs some time to be fully understood.
zh: > 请务必先阅读[本页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/templates)。MMOItems物品生成系统相当复杂，需要一些时间才能完全理解。

source: Item modifiers are the **MVP's of the MMOItems random loot generation system**. Conceptually, an item always comes with its standard set of item stats. Take the following item for example - a Long Sword - it has 10 Atk damage and 1.6 Atk speed. These are its default stats, meaning if the item has no modifier, tier or anything attached to it, it will only have these stats.
zh: 物品修饰器是MMOItems随机战利品生成系统的 **MVP。从概念上讲，物品始终附带其标准物品属性集。以下面的物品为例 - 一把长剑 - 它具有10攻击力伤害和1.6攻击速度。这些是它的默认值属性，这意味着如果物品没有修饰符、层或任何附加的东西，它只会有这些属性。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/long_sword_no_mod.CTR3gi81.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/long_sword_no_mod.CTR3gi81.png)

source: Now imagine that 20% of the time, the following `Sharp` modifier now applies when generating this item. The stats provided by this modifier will stack up with the base item stats. The Atk damage is now `10 + 5 = 15` and the item now has extra lore.
zh: 现在想象一下当时的20%，在生成此物品时现在应用以下`Sharp`修饰符。此修改器提供的属性将与基础物品属性叠加。 Atk 伤害现在为`10 + 5 = 15`并且物品现在有额外的描述。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/long_sword_sharp.D-ne3qmG.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/long_sword_sharp.D-ne3qmG.png)

source: This means that there can be multiple versions of the same item, with different rarities, more or less powerful stats added to them.
zh: 这意味着同一个物品可以有多个版本，具有不同的稀有度，或多或少添加了强大的属性。

source: Adding item modifiers to items
zh: 将物品修饰器添加到物品

source: For this tutorial, we will consider a sample item *Long Sword* with two potential item modifiers, *Sharp* (adds +5 Atk damage) and *Fiery* (adds an on-hit burning ability).
zh: 在本教程中，我们将考虑一个示例物品*长剑* ，它具有两个潜在的物品修饰器、*Sharp*（增加 +5Atk 伤害）和 *Fiery*（增加on-hit燃烧能力）。

source: The following config snippet can be placed inside the `/MMOItems/items/sword.yml` config file.
zh: 以下配置片段可以放置在`/MMOItems/items/sword.yml`配置文件中。

source: Let's break this config snippet down. We still have the base item stats under the `base` config section. These are the stats that the generated item will have if no modifier is applied.
zh: 让我们分解一下这个配置片段。我们在`base`配置部分下仍然有基本的物品属性。如果没有应用修饰符，这些是生成的物品将具有的属性。

source: What follows is the `modifiers` config section with two inner sections, one for each modifier (`sharp` and `fiery`). This is where you need to define all the modifiers that the generated item could potentially have. Modifiers are defined by the following properties: **roll chance**, **weight**, **item stats** and **prefix or suffix**.
zh: 接下来是`modifiers`配置部分，其中有两个内部部分，每个修改器一个（`sharp`和`fiery`）。你需要在此处定义生成的物品可能具有的所有修饰符。修饰符由以下属性定义：**掷骰率**、**权重**、**物品属性** 和 **前缀或后缀**。

source: Modifier roll chance
zh: 修正掷骰几率

source: Each modifier has a roll chance, which is the chance that the modifier will be applied to the generated item. In our example, the *Sharp* modifier has a 10% chance to be applied, and the *Fiery* modifier has a 5% chance to be applied. This means that if you generate 100 *Long Swords*, on average 10 of them will have the *Sharp* modifier and 5 of them will have the *Fiery* modifier.
zh: 每个修改器都有一个滚动机会，即修改器将应用于生成的物品的机会。在我们的示例中，*Sharp* 修改器有10%的机会被应用，*Fiery* 修改器有5%的机会被应用。这意味着，如果你生成100*长剑*，则平均10将具有 *Sharp* 修饰符，而5将具有 *Fiery* 修饰符。

source: This is by far the easiest and most straightforward way to implement randomness with modifiers.
zh: 这是迄今为止使用修饰符实现随机性的最简单、最直接的方法。

source: List of item stats
zh: 物品属性列表

source: These are the stats that will be added to the item if the modifier is applied. The format used here is the exact same as the one used to define base item stats in an [item template](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/templates). You can add ANY stat, item option, ability... to the modifier `stats` section.
zh: 如果应用修改器，这些是属性将添加到物品。这里使用的格式与在 [物品模板](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/templates)中定义基本物品属性的格式完全相同。你可以将任何属性、物品选项、能力...添加到修饰符`stats`部分。

source: Prefixes & Suffixes
zh: 前缀和后缀

source: Modifiers can also have prefixes and/or suffixes, which are automatically applied to the item name when the modifier is selected. Prefixes are added before the item name, suffixes after. You can define both a prefix and a suffix for a single modifier.
zh: 修饰符还可以具有前缀和/或后缀，当选择修饰符时，这些前缀和/或后缀会自动应用于物品名称。在物品名称之前添加前缀，在之后添加后缀。你可以为单个修饰符定义前缀和后缀。

source: Prefixes and suffixes are entirely optional, you can have modifiers with no prefix or suffix at all.
zh: 前缀和后缀完全是可选的，你可以使用完全没有前缀或后缀的修饰符。

source: The following syntax allows to limit the number of prefixes/suffixes shown on the item name, by setting a priority for each prefix/suffix. **Only the prefixes/suffixes with the highest priority will show.**
zh: 以下语法允许通过为每个前缀/后缀设置优先级来限制物品名称上显示的前缀/后缀的数量。 **仅显示具有最高优先级的前缀/后缀。**

source: If a prefix/suffix has a higher priority than another prefix/suffix, only the high priority prefix/suffix will show.
zh: 如果一个前缀/后缀的优先级高于另一个前缀/后缀，则仅显示高优先级的前缀/后缀。

source: If multiple prefixes/suffixes have the same priority, and if there are no other prefixes/suffixes with higher priority, all of them will show.
zh: 如果多个前缀/后缀的优先级相同，且没有其他优先级更高的前缀/后缀，则全部显示。

source: The default priority is 0, so 1 would hide all prefixes/suffixes with priority 0 (or no priority), 2 would hide all prefixes/suffixes with priority 1 and 0, etc.
zh: 默认优先级为0，因此1将隐藏优先级为0（或无优先级）的所有前缀/后缀，2将隐藏优先级为1和0的所有前缀/后缀等。

source: Modifier Weight & Capacity
zh: 改性剂重量和容量

source: The problem with the roll chance system is that it does not allow to you control how many modifiers an item can have. An item with 10 modifiers with 50% roll chance can still have (although unlikely) up to 10 modifiers applied to it, which is not very suitable for gameplay balancing.
zh: 滚动机会系统的问题在于它不允许你控制物品可以拥有多少个修饰符。具有10修饰符和50%滚动机会的物品仍然可以（尽管不太可能）应用最多10修饰符，这不太适合游戏平衡。

source: To solve this problem, MMOItems uses a **modifier capacity** system. Each item has a modifier capacity which is determined by its item tier (see [this wiki section](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/tiers#modifier-capacity-item-generation) to learn how to setup modifier capacity for your items).
zh: 为了解决这个问题，MMOItems使用了**修改器容量**系统。每个物品都有一个由其物品品质决定的修饰符容量（请参阅[此 wiki 部分](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/tiers#modifier-capacity-item-generation)以了解如何为物品设置修饰符容量）。

source: Each modifier has a weight, which is the amount of capacity that the modifier will use up if it is applied to the item.
zh: 每个修改器都有一个权重，即该修改器应用于物品时将消耗的容量。

source: An item can only receive modifiers whose total weight is less than or equal to its modifier capacity.
zh: 物品只能接收总重量小于或等于其修饰符容量的修饰符。

source: Modifiers are only applied if they roll successfully AND if the item has enough remaining modifier capacity to receive them.
zh: 仅当修饰符成功滚动且物品有足够的剩余修饰符容量来接收修饰符时，才会应用修饰符。

source: An Example
zh: 一个例子

source: In the following example, the *Long Sword* has two modifiers, *Sharp* with a weight of 3 and *Fiery* with a weight of 2.
zh: 在以下示例中，*Long Sword* 有两个修改器：权重为3的 *Sharp* 和权重为2的 *Fiery*。

source: If the item has a modifier capacity of at least 5, it can receive both modifiers as `capacity > 3 + 2 = 5`
zh: 如果物品的修改器容量至少为5，则它可以接收两个修改器作为`capacity > 3 + 2 = 5`

source: If the item has a modifier capacity between 3 and 5 (), it can receive only one of these modifiers, either *Sharp* or *Fiery*.
zh: 如果物品的修改器容量介于3和5() 之间，则它只能接收这些修改器之一，*Sharp* 或 *Fiery*。

source: If the item has a modifier capacity between 2 and 3, it can only receive the *Sharp* modifier.
zh: 如果物品的修饰符容量介于2和3之间，则它只能接收 *Sharp* 修饰符。

source: If the item has a modifier capacity of less than 2, it cannot receive any modifier.
zh: 如果物品的修改器容量小于2，则它无法接收任何修改器。

source: This modifier weight system adds up to the roll chance system! If the item has a modifier capacity of 5, **it can receive both modifiers, but it does not mean that it will always receive both**. Each modifier still has its own roll chance, so the item may receive either one of the two, both of them or none at all.
zh: 该修正权重系统与翻滚机会系统相加！如果物品的修改器容量为5，**它可以接收两个修改器，但并不意味着它总是接收两个**。每个修饰符仍然有自己的掷骰机会，因此物品可能会收到两者之一、两者或根本没有。

source: During item generation, MMOItems iterates through the whole modifier list, and for each modifier:
zh: 在物品生成期间，MMOItems迭代整个修饰符列表，并且对于每个修饰符：

source: Rolls the modifier chance. If the roll fails, it skips to the next modifier.
zh: 掷骰子修正几率。如果掷骰失败，则会跳至下一个修改器。

source: Checks if the item has enough remaining modifier capacity. If not, it skips to the next modifier.
zh: 检查物品是否有足够的剩余修改器容量。如果没有，它会跳到下一个修饰符。

source: Applies the modifier (stats and prefix/suffix) to the item,
zh: 将修饰符（属性和前缀/后缀）应用于物品，

source: Reduces the item's remaining modifier capacity by the modifier.
zh: 通过修饰符减少物品的剩余修饰符容量。

source: Goes back to step 1 until all modifiers have been processed.
zh: 返回到步骤1，直到处理完所有修改器。

source: Use Case
zh: 使用案例

source: Weights only limit the number of modifiers an item can have, they do not guarantee that the item will have a certain number of modifiers. Therefore, you can use weights to balance items with a lot of modifiers and make sure they cannot have too many over-powered modifiers at the same time.
zh: 权重仅限制物品可以拥有的修饰符数量，并不能保证物品具有一定数量的修饰符。因此，你可以使用权重来平衡物品和大量修饰符，并确保它们不能同时拥有太多over-powered修饰符。

source: Public Modifiers
zh: 公共修饰符

source: Public modifiers are modifiers which you can use as shortcuts in order to spend less time in your item config files redefining the same modifiers over and over again. For instance, if you have multiple Swords in your game, and you want all of them to be able to roll the *Sharp* modifier, you can define this modifier once as a public modifier, and then reference it in all your sword item configs.
zh: 公共修饰符是可以用作快捷方式的修饰符，以便减少在物品配置文件中一遍又一遍地重新定义相同修饰符的时间。例如，如果你的游戏中有多个剑，并且你希望所有剑都能够滚动 *Sharp* 修改器，你可以将此修改器定义为公共修改器一次，然后在所有剑物品配置中引用它。

source: Head to the `/modifiers` folder and create a new YAML config file (it can have any name). This folder may contain as many config files and subfolders as you want, MMOItems will load them all. Every config file can contain as many public modifiers as you want.
zh: 前往`/modifiers`文件夹并创建一个新的YAML配置文件（可以具有任何名称）。该文件夹可以包含任意数量的配置文件和子文件夹，MMOItems将加载它们全部。每个配置文件都可以包含任意数量的公共修饰符。

source: Here is an example of a public modifier config file:
zh: 以下是公共修饰符配置文件的示例：

source: You can then reference these public modifiers in your item config files like this:
zh: 然后，你可以在物品配置文件中引用这些公共修饰符，如下所示：

source: As you can see, you can still edit the roll chance and modifier weight to have it fine-tuned to the item you are working on, but you **no longer need to redefine the stats, prefix and suffix**.
zh: 正如你所看到的，你仍然可以编辑滚动机会和修改权重，将其fine-tuned更改为你正在处理的物品，但你**不再需要重新定义属性、前缀和后缀**。

source: Modifier Groups (MI 6.9.5+)
zh: 修饰符组 (MI6.9.5+)

source: > We recommend getting familiar with the modifier system logic before continuing to this section as it starts getting a bit technical!
zh: > 我们建议在继续本节之前先熟悉修改器系统逻辑，因为它开始变得有点技术性！

source: Modifier groups greatly increase the flexibility of the modifier system. They allow you to get much finer control over how many modifiers an item should have. Once you understand how modifier groups work, the possibilities for random loot are endless!
zh: 改性剂基团大大增加了改性剂系统的灵活性。它们使你可以更好地控制物品应具有的修饰符数量。一旦你了解了修饰符组的工作原理，随机战利品的可能性是无限的！

source: Modifier groups are collections of modifiers (public or private) which can be used as a single modifier. When a modifier group is rolled (applied onto an item), it will roll all modifiers from its collection.
zh: 修饰符组是修饰符（公共或私有）的集合，可以用作单个修饰符。当滚动修改器组（应用于物品）时，它将滚动其集合中的所有修改器。

source: Beside making configuring multiple modifiers easier, modifier groups also allow you to **set a minimum and maximum number of modifiers that will be applied from the group**.
zh: 除了使配置多个修改器变得更容易之外，修改器组还允许你**设置将从组应用的修改器的最小和最大数量**。

source: The following syntax snippet defines a public modifier group and can be pasted inside any YML config file located in the `/modifiers` folder.
zh: 以下语法片段定义了一个公共修饰符组，可以粘贴到位于`/modifiers`文件夹中的任何 YML 配置文件中。

source: This modifier group contains three "sub-modifiers" : `toxic`, `sharp` and `fiery`.
zh: 该修饰符组包含三个“sub-modifiers”：`toxic`、`sharp`和`fiery`。

source: The `min` and `max` options guarantee that at least 1 of these modifiers will be applied onto the item, and that at most 3 from these modifiers will be applied onto the item. Both of these options are optional, if you only specify the `min` option, then all modifiers could be rolled simultaneously (as long as the item has enough modifier capacity).
zh: `min`和`max`选项保证这些修饰符中的至少1将应用于物品，并且这些修饰符中的至多3将应用于物品。这两个选项都是可选的，如果你只指定`min`选项，那么所有修改器都可以同时滚动（只要物品有足够的修改器容量）。

source: You can then reference this modifier group inside item configs, like in the following config snippet. The `sword_modifiers` group has a 30% chance to be rolled, and a weight of 1 if rolled. Modifier groups have their own roll chance and weight, just like simple modifiers.
zh: 然后，你可以在物品配置中引用此修饰符组，如以下配置片段所示。`sword_modifiers`组有30%的机会被滚动，并且滚动后的权重为1。修饰符组有自己的滚动机会和权重，就像简单的修饰符一样。

source: When generating an item, MMOItems first tries to roll all modifiers in the group and stops if it reaches the maximum number of modifiers. It will stop before reaching the maximum if the item runs out of modifier capacity, or if all modifiers have already been processed.
zh: 当生成物品时，MMOItems首先尝试滚动组中的所有修改器，并在达到最大修改器数量时停止。如果物品用完修改器容量，或者所有修改器已处理完毕，它将在达到最大值之前停止。

source: Then, if the minimum number of modifiers has not been reached, it will randomly sample and apply modifiers (according to their roll chance) from the group until the minimum is reached. If the item runs out of modifier capacity before reaching the minimum, it will stop and the item will have less modifiers than the minimum.
zh: 然后，如果尚未达到修饰符的最小数量，它将从该组中随机采样并应用修饰符（根据其滚动几率），直到达到最小值。如果物品在达到最小值之前用完修饰符容量，它将停止，并且物品的修饰符将少于最小值。

source: Note that when using modifier weights, the group is not guaranteed to reach the minimum number of modifiers, especially if the item starts with a low modifier capacity!
zh: 请注意，使用修饰符权重时，不能保证该组达到修饰符的最小数量，特别是如果物品的修饰符容量较低！

source: <summary>Additional Note</summary>
zh: <summary>附加说明</summary>

source: This modifier allocation problem is actually a very complex combinatorial optimization problem, and finding a working/optimal solution is not trivial at all. The algorithm used by MMOItems is a greedy heuristic but it's still quite good in practice!
zh: 这个修饰符分配问题实际上是一个非常复杂的组合优化问题，找到一个工作/最佳解决方案根本不是小事。MMOItems使用的算法是一种贪婪启发式算法，但在实践中仍然相当不错！

source: Item stats which scale with the tier
zh: 物品属性随层扩展

source: The following example shows a very nice use case for modifier groups. In classic MMOItems, item stat values usually scale with the item level. However, you may want to have stats which scale rather with the item tier. For instance, you may want a *Rare* item to always have +10% Critical Strike Chance, and a *Legendary* item to always have +20% Critical Strike Chance.
zh: 以下示例显示了修饰符组的一个非常好的用例。在经典的MMOItems中，物品属性值通常与物品等级成比例。但是，你可能希望属性与物品品质一起缩放。例如，你可能希望 *Rare*物品始终具有 +10%暴击几率，而 *Legendary*物品始终具有 +20%暴击几率。

source: While this is possible with classic modifier rules, using modifier groups makes it much easier to setup and manage.
zh: 虽然这可以通过经典的修改器规则实现，但使用修改器组可以更轻松地设置和管理。

source: Using a modifier group with min and max set to 1 guarantees that exactly one of these modifiers will be applied to the item. The chance values ensure that the *Common* modifier is rolled 80% of the time, the *Uncommon* modifier 16% of the time and the *Rare* modifier 4% of the time.
zh: 使用最小值和最大值设置为1的修改器组可以保证这些修改器之一将应用于物品。机会值确保*普通*修饰符滚动到当时的80%，*不常见*修饰符滚动到当时的16%，*稀有*修饰符滚动到当时的4%。

source: Every modifier corresponds to one tier. Unlike regular item generation (where the item tier is randomly picked), the modifiers are responsible for setting the item tier, which means that the item tier will be determined by the modifier rolled from this group. In parallel, the item will also receive a *Critical Strike Chance* bonus, which depends on the modifier rolled, and therefore on the item tier.
zh: 每个修饰符对应一层。与常规物品生成（其中物品品质是随机选取的）不同，修改器负责设置物品品质，这意味着物品品质将由从该组中滚动的修改器确定。同时，物品还将获得 *暴击几率* 奖励，这取决于滚动的修改器，因此也取决于物品品质。

source: Following this structure, you can choose to add more stats to each modifier and therefore have stats which scale with the item tier.
zh: 按照此结构，你可以选择向每个修改器添加更多属性，从而使属性与物品品质一起缩放。

source: Modifiers as "nodes"
zh: 修饰符作为“节点”

source: > Again, we recommend getting familiar with the modifier group logic before continuing to this section.
zh: > 同样，我们建议在继续本节之前先熟悉修饰符组逻辑。

source: Modifiers are similar to nodes in a tree-like structure. Anywhere you are asked for a modifier, you can interchangeably provide either a simple modifier, or a modifier group. You can use modifier groups inside of other modifier groups. Modifier groups have their own roll change and weight, just like simple modifiers.
zh: 修饰符类似于tree-like结构中的节点。无论何时要求你提供修饰符，你都可以交替提供简单修饰符或修饰符组。你可以在其他修饰符组内使用修饰符组。修饰符组有自己的滚动变化和权重，就像简单的修饰符一样。

source: All modifiers or modifier groups are simply nodes, and a modifier node has BOTH a `stats` section (modifier part) AND a `modifiers` section (group part). This means that you can have a modifier which provides stats AND rolls multiple sub-modifiers at the same time. Modifier groups have their own roll chance and weight, just like simple modifiers.
zh: 所有修改器或修改器组都是简单的节点，修改器节点同时具有`stats`部分（修改器部分）和`modifiers`部分（组部分）。这意味着你可以拥有一个提供属性并同时滚动多个sub-modifiers的修改器。修饰符组有自己的滚动机会和权重，就像简单的修饰符一样。

source: Here is a syntax snippet that illustrates the previous points.
zh: 这是一个语法片段，说明了前面的要点。

source: 🎒 Obtain Items
zh: 🎒 获得物品

source: Using `/mi generate`
zh: 使用`/mi generate`

source: `/mi generate` lets you generate a random item based on specific criterias that you give as command arguments. The command format is the following:
zh: `/mi generate`允许你根据作为命令参数提供的特定条件生成随机物品。命令格式如下：

source: `<player>` indicates the player you will be giving the item to, as well as the RPG player data the item will be built onto. For instance, if the player who's running the command is level 20, and if the command target is level 10, then the item won't scale on level 20 but rather on level 10.
zh: `<player>`表示你将向其提供物品的玩家，以及将构建物品的RPG玩家数据。例如，如果运行命令的玩家等级为20，并且命令目标为等级10，则物品不会在等级20上缩放，而是在等级10上缩放。

source: The available optional command arguments are listed below:
zh: 下面列出了可用的可选命令参数：

source: | Argument | Use |
zh: |论证|使用 |

source: | `-matchlevel` | The item level will match the target player's level. |
zh: |`-matchlevel`|物品等级将与目标玩家等级匹配。 |

source: | `-matchclass` | The item is guaranteed to be usable (class requirements) by the target player. |
zh: |`-matchclass`|目标玩家保证物品可用（职业要求）。 |

source: | `-gimme` | Adds the item to your inventory instead. |
zh: |`-gimme`|将物品添加到你的物品栏中。 |

source: | `-class:<class-name>` | The item is guaranteed to be usable by the given class. |
zh: |`-class:<class-name>`|物品保证可由给定的职业使用。 |

source: | `-level:<integer>` | The item is guaranteed to have level X. |
zh: |`-level:<integer>`|物品保证具有 X 级。

source: | `-tier:<tier-name>` | The item is guaranteed to have specified [tier](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/tiers). |
zh: |`-tier:<tier-name>`|物品保证已指定 [tier](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/tiers)。 |

source: | `-type:<item-type>` | Choose the [item type](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/types). |
zh: |`-type:<item-type>`|选择[物品类型](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/features/types)。 |

source: | `-id:<id>` | Use that if you want a specific [item template](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/templates) to be selected. |
zh: |`-id:<id>`|如果你想要选择特定的 [物品模板](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/templates)，请使用该选项。 |

source: Keep in mind these arguments are all optional (which is what makes the item gen so powerful) and act as "filters" when MMOItems determines what item template, tier and item level it will use. Example use: we're giving to a player a high tier weapon that matches their level and class:
zh: 请记住，这些参数都是可选的（这就是物品gen 如此强大的原因），并且当MMOItems确定它将使用什么物品模板、层和物品等级时，它们充当“过滤器”。使用示例：我们为玩家提供与其等级和职业匹配的高级武器：

source: This would typically be used when opening a lootable chest for example; it's not specific loot like when finishing a temporary christmas/halloween event or killing a boss/special monster, but rather rare, random yet usable stuff (so he does not feel frustrated).
zh: 例如，这通常在打开可掠夺的箱子时使用；它不是像完成临时圣诞节/万圣节活动或杀死老板/特殊怪物时那样的特定战利品，而是稀有、随机但可用的东西（所以他不会感到沮丧）。

source: If you were to add loot to a special monster, you would most likely specify what item you want looted and not give any tier, so that the player needs to grind the mob to eventually find a higher tier version of the same weapon.
zh: 如果你要向特殊怪物添加战利品，你很可能会指定你想要掠夺的物品并且不给出任何等级，因此玩家需要磨灭生物以最终找到同一武器的更高等级版本。

source: Use this MMOCore table item if you want to add a specific item generator template to one of your MMOCore drop tables.
zh: 如果你想要将特定的物品生成器模板添加到MMOCore删除表之一，请使用此MMOCore表物品。

source: | `id=TEMPLATE_ID` | Choose what item gen template you are using. |
zh: |`id=TEMPLATE_ID`|选择你正在使用的物品gen 模板。 |

source: | `level=<item-level>` | Forces the item level to be around level Y. |
zh: |`level=<item-level>`|强制物品等级在 Y 等级附近。

source: | `tier=ITEM_TIER_ID` | Forces the item to be tier X. |

source: Using MMOItems drop tables
zh: 使用MMOItems删除表

source: Please read [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/drop-tables).
zh: 请阅读[此维基页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/drop-tables)。

source: 🔄 Item Updates (Revision)
zh: 🔄物品更新（修订）

source: When items are generated through loot tables or commands, their stat data is written into NBT tags. 90% of their stat data is now independent from what is written in the config, such that if you later modify an item, it will not *automatically* update the instances of this item that have already been generated.
zh: 当通过战利品表或命令生成物品时，其属性数据将写入NBT标签。  它们的属性数据的90%现在独立于配置中写入的内容，这样，如果你稍后修改物品，它不会“自动”更新已生成的此物品的实例。

source: The *Revision ID* system, or *RevID*, allows to update generated items to match their configs again. When updating an item, MMOItems "regenerates" it, as if it was freshly obtained through the `/mi give` command, having the latest lore format and the same stats as the template:
zh: *修订版ID* 系统或 *RevID* 允许更新生成的物品以再次匹配其配置。更新物品时，MMOItems会“重新生成”它，就好像它是通过`/mi give`命令新鲜获得的一样，具有最新的描述格式和与模板相同的属性：

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_update.Bf8s69bK.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_update.Bf8s69bK.png)

source: The RevID stat
zh: RevID属性

source: When you increase this number in the editor, all the copies of this item in the world will update to match the template:
zh: 当你在编辑器中增加此数字时，世界上此物品的所有副本都将更新以匹配模板：

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/rev_id_in_ui.dDmqmx25.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/rev_id_in_ui.dDmqmx25.png)

source: Once the item revision ID is incremented, every generated instance of that item is now considered *outdated* and will be updated. You can increment multiple times the revision ID.
zh: 一旦物品版本ID增加，该物品的每个生成实例现在都被视为“过时”并将被更新。你可以多次递增修订版ID。

source: MMOItems updates every item in the player's inventory on login. Any item click (in a non creative inventory) triggers an item update check.
zh: MMOItems在登录时更新玩家的物品栏中的每个物品。任何物品点击（在非创意物品栏中）都会触发物品更新检查。

source: Advanced Configuration
zh: 高级配置

source: There are a lot of options for this revision system, which you can tweak in the `item-revision` section of the main MMOItems config file.
zh: 此版本系统有很多选项，你可以在主MMOItems配置文件的`item-revision`部分中进行调整。

source: Some options have more complicated mechanics, but the rest of these options are self-explanatory.
zh: 有些选项具有更复杂的机制，但其余选项是self-explanatory。

source: Reroll RNG Stats `reroll`
zh: 重新滚动 RNG属性`reroll`

source: This option has some very complicated behaviour, stats may reroll even if you specified false, and this is desirable. It is important to understand that all numeric stats are RNG — even if you did not specify a spread, they just have 100% chance of the same value.
zh: 此选项有一些非常复杂的行为，即使你指定了false，属性也可能会重新滚动，这是可取的。重要的是要了解所有数字属性都是 RNG - 即使你没有指定价差，它们也只有100%具有相同值的机会。

source: Suppose this is *enabled*, then all of the numeric stats of the item will be rerolled.
zh: 假设这是*启用*，那么物品的所有数字属性都将被重新滚动。

source: Suppose this is *disabled*, then each numeric stat will calculate the probability of it being generated again under the current mean and spread settings, if it is too rare then it will update/reroll even though this option was disabled:
zh: 假设这是*禁用*，那么每个数字属性将计算在当前均值和价差设置下再次生成它的概率，如果太罕见，那么即使禁用此选项，它也会更新/重新滚动：

source: If the new value has a spread of 0 and has changed, the old value will be lost as it would be 0% of generating.
zh: 如果新值的范围为0并且已更改，则旧值将丢失，因为生成的值将是0%。

source: If the value was removed entirely from the item, the old value will be lost.
zh: 如果从物品中完全删除该值，则旧值将丢失。

source: If the spread of the value has changed such that the old value is exceedingly rare (1 in 4200) then the old value will be lost.
zh: 如果值的分布发生变化，使得旧值极其罕见（4200中的1），则旧值将会丢失。

source: If the max spread value has changed, and the old value is outside this range, the old value will be constrained to the max spread.
zh: 如果最大点差值已更改，并且旧值超出此范围，则旧值将被限制为最大点差。

source: As you can see, RNG will be rerolled if this item would be unobtainable under the new conditions, which is healthy game design.
zh: 正如你所看到的，如果这个物品在新的条件下无法获得，RNG将会重新滚动，这是生命值的游戏设计。

source: Keep Enchantments `enchantments`
zh: 保持结界`enchantments`

source: The old enchantments of the item will be compared to the enchantments in the template to decide if the enchantment will be kept or updated:
zh: 物品的旧附魔将与模板中的附魔进行比较，以决定是否保留或更新附魔：

source: Any old enchantment that is worse than that of the template will update to the better value
zh: 任何比模板差的旧附魔都会更新为更好的值

source: If an old enchantment is better than that of the template, it will be kept as long as it is obtainable in vanilla minecraft.
zh: 如果旧的附魔比模板的附魔更好，只要它在原版我的世界中可以获得，它就会被保留。

source: If the template has the `disable-enchanting` and `disable-repairing` stats enabled, no old enchantments will be kept *even if this option is enabled*, all enchantments will be updated to match the template.
zh: 如果模板启用了`disable-enchanting`和`disable-repairing`属性，则不会保留旧的结界*即使启用此选项*，所有结界都将更新以匹配模板。

source: As you can see, the aim is that players who enchant their items do not lose their enchantments, but if the item is updated in the template to have even better enchantments, these players will get the better enchantments. Essentially, attempts to remember the enchantments the player put in the item, and apply them again, if the player could still apply them.
zh: 如你所见，目标是为物品附魔的玩家不会失去其附魔，但如果在模板中更新物品以具有更好的附魔，则这些玩家将获得更好的附魔。本质上，尝试记住玩家放入物品中的结界，并再次应用它们（如果玩家仍然可以应用它们）。

source: Keep Gemstones `gemstones`, `drop-extra-gems`
zh: 保留宝石`gemstones`、`drop-extra-gems`

source: It's important to note the `drop-extra-gems` option, if any gemstones would be deleted due to the RevID updater, setting this option to true will cause them to be given back to the player / dropped nearby if their inventory is full. This option is global to all item revision operations (see next section on more RevID system applications).
zh: 请务必注意`drop-extra-gems`选项，如果任何宝石因 RevID 更新程序而被删除，则将此选项设置为true将导致它们被返还给玩家/ 如果物品栏已满，则它们会掉落在附近。此选项对于所有物品修订操作是全局的（请参阅下一节有关更多 RevID 系统应用程序的信息）。

source: If this option is *disabled*, all old gems in the item will be deleted (or dropped if the `drop-extra-gems` option is enabled).
zh: 如果此选项被“禁用”，则物品中的所有旧宝石都将被删除（如果启用了`drop-extra-gems`选项，则将被删除）。

source: If this option is *enabled*, it is still possible for old gems to be deleted:
zh: 如果这个选项被*启用*，旧的宝石仍然有可能被删除：

source: If the template had its gem sockets removed or decreased in amount, gems that don't fit will be deleted
zh: 如果模板的宝石插槽被移除或数量减少，不合适的宝石将被删除

source: If the color of the gem sockets changed, gems that do not fit anymore will be deleted
zh: 如果宝石插槽的颜色发生变化，不再适合的宝石将被删除

source: Keep Name `display-name`
zh: 保留名称`display-name`

source: If this is enabled, then the old name of the item will be kept, regardless of what the template currently has.
zh: 如果启用此功能，则无论模板当前有什么，都将保留物品的旧名称。

source: Keep Soulbound `soulbound`
zh: 保留灵魂绑定`soulbound`

source: If the old item is soulbound, this soulbound will be kept.
zh: 如果旧的物品是灵魂绑定，则此灵魂绑定将被保留。

source: Keep Upgrades `upgrades`
zh: 持续升级`upgrades`

source: The upgrade level of the old item will be kept, however this will fail if the item template has no upgrade template anymore. If the max upgrades of the item were decreased, the extra upgrade levels will be lost.
zh: 旧物品的升级等级将保留，但如果物品模板不再有升级模板，升级将会失败。如果物品的最大升级等级减少，额外的升级等级将会丢失。

source: Keep Lore `lore`, `kept-lore-prefix`
zh: 保留描述`lore`、`kept-lore-prefix`

source: From the old item, all the lines of lore that begin with the `kept-lore-prefix` (commonly a color code) will be kept. Be warned that this can cause duplicate lore if the template has any lore that begins with this prefix, it will be kept every time the item is updated.
zh: 从旧的物品开始，所有以`kept-lore-prefix`（通常是颜色代码）开头的描述行都将被保留。请注意，如果模板有任何以此前缀开头的描述，这可能会导致重复的描述，每次更新物品时都会保留它。

source: Keep External SH `external-sh`
zh: 保留外部 SH`external-sh`

source: External stat history data is added by third-party plugins to modify stats of the item. Enabling this will keep all this data, with the exception of enchantments.
zh: 外部属性历史数据由third-party插件添加，以修改物品的属性。启用此功能将保留所有这些数据，除了结界之外。

source: Keep Modifications `modifications`
zh: 保留修改`modifications`

source: All item modifiers will be kept if this is enabled, even if they cannot be obtained anymore, and even if the modifier weights changed.
zh: 如果启用此功能，所有物品修饰器将被保留，即使它们无法再获得，即使修改器权重发生变化。

source: Keep Skins `skins`
zh: 保留皮肤`skins`

source: If this is enabled, changes made by a *skin-type* item will be kept.
zh: 如果启用此功能，则将保留 *skin-type*物品所做的更改。

source: Keep Tier `tier`
zh: 保持等级`tier`

source: If the old item has a tier, this tier will be preserved, even if the template has now a different tier.
zh: 如果旧的物品有一个层，则该层将被保留，即使模板现在具有不同的层。

source: Other Applications of the RevID system
zh: RevID系统的其他应用

source: Updating gemstones inside items
zh: 更新物品内的宝石

source: The RevID system supports updating gemstones while they are inserted in items. This does not happen automatically when increasing the RevID of the gemstone template, you must increase the parent item's RevID and have the *keep gemstones* option enabled.
zh: RevID 系统支持在宝石插入物品时更新宝石。当增加宝石模板的 RevID 时，这种情况不会自动发生，你必须增加父物品的 RevID 并启用 *keep gemstones* 选项。

source: You can use the `item-revision.keep-gem-data` field to specify the RevID options of gemstones updated this way:
zh: 你可以使用`item-revision.keep-gem-data`字段来指定以这种方式更新的宝石的 RevID 选项：

source: Third Party Plugin Compatibilities
zh: 第三方插件兼容性

source: Keep Advanced Enchantments `advanced-enchantments`
zh: 保留高级附魔`advanced-enchantments`

source: All of the advanced enchantments in the item will be kept.
zh: 物品中的所有高级附魔都将保留。

source: Update PhatLoots loot as it generates
zh: 更新 PhatLoots 生成的战利品

source: PhatLoots does not have special support for MMOItems, such that after a few months, your MMOItem loot drops can become quite outdated! Specify in MMOItems' config.yml in the section `item-revision.phat-loots` the revision options to update these items as they are generated:
zh: PhatLoots 没有对MMOItems的特殊支持，因此几个月后，你的 MMOItem 战利品掉落可能会变得相当过时！在`item-revision.phat-loots`部分的MMOItems'config.yml中指定修订选项，以在生成这些物品时更新它们：

source: 🗡️ Item Templates
zh: 🗡️物品模板

source: When creating an item in MMOItems, you are actually creating an item **template**. An item template is composed of a set of **default** item options (display name, material, enchants, attack damage..), and a **set of item modifiers** which are chosen randomly and applied to the base item data when the item is given to a player.
zh: 在 MMOItems 中创建物品，实际创建的是物品**模板**。物品模板由一组**默认**选项（显示名称、材质、附魔、攻击伤害等）和一组**物品修饰器**组成。给予玩家物品时，会随机选取修饰器，并将它们应用到物品的基础数据上。

source: This system designed is to make **ONE item template** able to generate **MULTIPLE versions/instances** of the same item. The item modifiers are what makes every version of the item unique: an endgame item instance would have many powerful modifiers while the newbie item instance would only have 1-2 weaker modifiers.
zh: 该系统的设计目的是使**一个 ​​物品模板**能够生成同一物品的**多个版本/实例**。物品修饰器是物品每个版本的独特之处：残局物品实例将具有许多强大的修饰符，而新手物品实例将仅具有1-2较弱的修饰符。

source: When being generated, items all have an **item level** which directly determines how strong the item stats are and a **modifier capacity** which determines how many modifiers the item can have. MMOItems item generator hooks onto the MMOItems tier system. The higher the item tier, the more modifiers the item has. In other words, the item tier determines the item **modifier capacity**.
zh: 物品在生成时都有一个**物品等级**，直接决定了物品属性的强度，以及**修饰符容量**，决定了物品可以拥有多少修饰符。MMOItems物品生成器挂接到MMOItems层系统上。物品品质越高，物品的修饰符越多。换句话说，物品品质决定了物品**修改器容量**。

source: The **item tier** and **item level** are our **"randomness cursors"**. They determine how powerful an instance of an item is. They are also independent, which means you can have high level weapons, with little to no modifiers, and conversely a newbie item with a lot of modifiers.
zh: **物品品质** 和 **物品等级** 是我们的**“随机性游标”**。它们决定了物品实例的强大程度。它们也是独立的，这意味着你可以拥有高水平的武器，几乎没有修饰符，反之，新手物品则有很多修饰符。

source: Item Examples
zh: 物品示例

source: We'll be going over a few examples to understand the basic concept of the MMOItems item generator.
zh: 我们将通过几个示例来了解MMOItems物品生成器的基本概念。

source: Example 1
zh: 示例1

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_1a.TPcZOHMK.png) ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_1b.DjgNdhf0.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_1a.TPcZOHMK.png)![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_1b.DjgNdhf0.png)

source: These items use the same template, which is an item called `Long Sword`. However, the right one has a `Sharp` modifier which gives him +3 Atk Damage while the left one has no modifier.
zh: 这些物品使用相同的模板，这是一个名为`Long Sword`的物品。然而，右边的一个有一个`Sharp`修饰符，可以给他+3攻击力伤害，而左边的一个没有修饰符。

source: These two items have the same attack speed because it was chosen not to scale with the item level. However the attack damage does scale with the item level: although the first item has got a higher level, the second item has a `Sharp` modifier and therefore has more attack damage.
zh: 这两个物品具有相同的攻击速度，因为它被选择不与物品等级进行缩放。然而，攻击伤害确实随物品等级扩展：虽然第一个物品具有更高的等级，但第二个物品具有`Sharp`修饰符，因此具有更多攻击伤害。

source: The `Sharp` modifier gives the second item the `Sharp` prefix and adds an extra line of text in the item lore.
zh: `Sharp`修饰符为第二个物品提供`Sharp`前缀，并在物品描述中添加额外的文本行。

source: Example 2
zh: 示例2

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_1b.DjgNdhf0.png) ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_2b.UTv87RmT.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_1b.DjgNdhf0.png)![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_2b.UTv87RmT.png)

source: The item at the right has a much higher item level and therefore his attack damage is much higher. It also has two modifiers: `Sharp` and `Fiery`. `Sharp` still gives the item +3 Atk Damage but it's pretty useless given its level. `Fiery` gives the item a nice red name prefix and an on-hit burn ability.
zh: 右边的物品的物品等级要高得多，因此他的攻击伤害也要高得多。它还有两个修饰符：`Sharp`和`Fiery`。`Sharp`仍然提供物品+3攻击力伤害，但考虑到其等级，它几乎没有用处。`Fiery`为物品提供了漂亮的红色名称前缀和on-hit刻录能力。

source: The second item has the `Rare` item tier, therefore has much more modifier capacity than the non-tiered sword, which explains why it received two modifiers. Non-tiered items also have a modifier capacity, but it is much lower.
zh: 第二个物品具有`Rare`物品品质，因此比non-tiered剑具有更多的修改器容量，这解释了为什么它收到两个修改器。Non-tiered物品也有改性剂容量，但要低得多。

source: You can only see the `Fiery` prefix because this modifier has a higher priority (although you can configure the modifiers so that all the prefixes show, and have funny item names with 10 suffixes or prefixes at the same time!).
zh: 你只能看到`Fiery`前缀，因为此修饰符具有更高的优先级（尽管你可以配置修饰符以便显示所有前缀，并且同时具有带有10后缀或前缀的有趣物品名称！）。

source: Last but not least, a higher level does not always mean more modifiers - the modified weapon has a lower level than the one with no modifier.
zh: 最后但并非最不重要的一点是，更高的等级并不总是意味着更多的修饰符 - 修改后的武器的等级比没有修饰符的等级低。

source: Example 3
zh: 示例3

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_3.B4EpXDWE.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/example_3.B4EpXDWE.png)

source: The default item is a bow with some attack damage and crit chance. The first `Heavy` modifier makes it two-handed, adds a few attack points and some critical strike power. The second modifier which has a suffix adds an on-hit ability.
zh: 默认的物品是一把带有一定攻击伤害和暴击几率的弓。第一个`Heavy`修改器使其成为two-handed，添加了一些攻击点和一些暴击伤害。第二个带有后缀的修饰符添加了on-hit能力。

source: Example Item
zh: 示例物品

source: This is how an item template looks in the MMOItems config files.
zh: 这是物品模板在MMOItems配置文件中的外观。

source: Item Templates
zh: 物品模板

source: Item templates are the most fundamental tool to generate random items. They are defined by a list of **default item stats** which the resulting item will have no matter what, and a list of **item modifiers** which will be randomly picked and applied to the resulting item to impact its rarity.
zh: 物品模板是生成随机物品的最基本工具。它们由 **默认物品属性** 列表定义，无论如何，生成的物品都会具有该列表，以及 **物品修饰器** 列表，该列表将被随机选取并应用于生成的物品以影响其稀有性。

source: Some comments on the config snippet above:
zh: 对上面配置片段的一些评论：

source: The `base` section corresponds to the base item stats. For example, the base item is an iron sword which name is `Long Sword`. The default attack speed is 1.6 and the weapon has 6 Atk damage increased by 1.5 point for every item level.
zh: `base`部分对应于基础物品属性。例如，底座物品是一把铁剑，名称为`Long Sword`。默认的攻击速度是1.6，武器的攻击力伤害为6，每物品等级增加1.5点。

source: The `option` section is used to configure a few additional options for your template. See next paragraph for more information.
zh: `option`部分用于为模板配置一些附加选项。请参阅下一段了解更多信息。

source: The `modifiers` section contains all the modifiers which can be applied to the item.
zh: `modifiers`部分包含可应用于物品的所有修饰符。

source: Item generation templates can be found under the `/MMOItems/items` folder. You may add as many YML configs as you want in that folder to sort your templates.
zh: 物品生成模板可以在`/MMOItems/items`文件夹下找到。你可以在该文件夹中添加任意数量的 YML 配置来对模板进行排序。

source: Item Template Options
zh: 物品模板选项

source: A small list of extra options for your item template. Except capacity set them to `true` to enable them
zh: 物品模板的额外选项的一小部分列表。除了容量之外，将它们设置为`true`来启用它们

source: | Template Option | Description |
zh: |模板选项 |描述 |

source: | `roll-modifier-check-order` | Scrambles the item modifiers list before rolling them when generating items |
zh: |`roll-modifier-check-order`|生成物品时，先对物品修饰器列表进行打乱，然后再滚动它们 |

source: | `tiered` | A random tier will be picked for your item if none is specified when generating the item. This accounts for the `/mi generate` command, but also for station crafting recipes! |
zh: |`tiered`|如果生成物品时未指定任何层，将为你的物品选择随机层。这说明了`/mi generate`命令，也说明了站合成配方！ |

source: | `level-item` | A random item level will be picked for your item if none is specified when generating the item. |
zh: |`level-item`|如果在生成物品时未指定任何等级，将为你的物品选择随机的物品等级。 |

source: | `capacity` | `capacity` can be used to impose a formula for modifier capacity to your item without having to use an item tier. It overrides both the default modifier capacity formula as well as the formula provided by the tier of the generated item. |
zh: |`capacity`|`capacity`可用于将修饰符容量公式强加到物品上，而无需使用物品品质。它会覆盖默认的修改器容量公式以及生成的物品层提供的公式。 |

source: Just like ingredients, conditions must be met in order to use a recipe. Unlike ingredients, conditions do not take anything from the player inventory when using a crafting recipe. There are several types of recipes conditions, the main being **level** conditions and **permission** conditions. Just like ingredients, conditions are stored in a list inside the recipe config section.
zh: 就像配料一样，必须满足条件才能使用配方。与成分不同，使用合成配方时，条件不会从玩家物品栏中获取任何内容。配方条件有多种，主要有**等级**条件和**权限**条件。就像成分一样，条件存储在配方配置部分内的列表中。

source: | Condition | Usage | Description |
zh: |状况 |用途 |描述 |

source: | Min Lvl. | `level{level=<min>,consume=<true/false>}` | Players must be Lvl X or higher. `consume` is whether or not the levels should be consumed. |
zh: |最低等级。 |`level{level=<min>,consume=<true/false>}`|玩家必须为 X 级或更高。`consume`是是否应该消耗这些等级。 |

source: | Class | `class{list=<Class Name>,<Class Name 2>...}` | Restricts a recipe to certain classes |
zh: |职业|`class{list=<Class Name>,<Class Name 2>...}`|将配方限制为某些职业|

source: | Permission | `permission{list="<perm1>,<perm2>...";display="...";hide=false}` | Only players with specific perms may use the recipe. `display` is how the condition looks like in the item lore |
zh: |权限|`permission{list="<perm1>,<perm2>...";display="...";hide=false}`|只有具有特定权限的玩家才能使用该配方。`display`是物品描述中的情况 |

source: | Placeholder | `placeholder{placeholder="<Placeholder>~<Comparator>~<Number>";display="...";hide=false}` | Check the placeholder of a Player, then compare it to a number of your choice. Comparator list: `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `==`, `!=`. Use `eq` or `neq` when comparing strings |
zh: |占位符|`placeholder{placeholder="<Placeholder>~<Comparator>~<Number>";display="...";hide=false}`|检查玩家的占位符，然后将其与你选择的数字进行比较。比较器列表：`<`、`<=`、`>`、`>=`、`==`、`!=`。比较字符串时使用`eq`或`neq`|

source: | Food | `food{amount=<amount>}` | The recipes consumes (and requires) X food. |
zh: |食品|`food{amount=<amount>}`|这些配方消耗（并需要）X 种食物。 |

source: | Mana | `mana{amount=<amount>,format="0.#"}` | The recipe consumes (and requires) X mana. |
zh: |魔力|`mana{amount=<amount>,format="0.#"}`|该配方消耗（并需要） X魔力。 |

source: | Stamina | `stamina{amount=<amount>,format="0.#"}` | The recipe consumes (and requires) X stamina. |
zh: |耐力|`stamina{amount=<amount>,format="0.#"}`|该配方消耗（并需要） X耐力。 |

source: | Money | `money{amount=<amount>,format="0.#"}` | The recipe costs (and requires) X Vault currency. |
zh: |钱|`money{amount=<amount>,format="0.#"}`|该配方需要（并且需要）XVault货币。 |

source: | Min Profession Lvl. | `profession{profession=<profession>,level=<min>}` | Players must be Lvl X in a profession or higher (MMOCore). |
zh: |最低副职业等级|`profession{profession=<profession>,level=<min>}`|玩家必须是副职业中的 Lvl X 或更高 (MMOCore)。 |

source: The `hide-when-locked` recipe option only triggers when at least one of the conditions is/are not met. The recipe will still display in the GUI if the player does not have all the required ingredients. Recipe conditions display at the beginning of the GUI recipe item lore:
zh: `hide-when-locked`配方选项仅在至少满足/不满足其中一个条件时触发。如果玩家没有所有必需的成分，配方仍会显示在GUI中。配方条件显示在GUI配方物品描述的开头：

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/conditions.lMtUOuvy.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/conditions.lMtUOuvy.png)

source: Crafting stations can have an unlimited number of crafting recipes. Every recipe has its own configuration subsection under the `recipes` config section. The string key that you will use for the subsection name is only used internally by MMOItems, so you can use anything as long as it is unique. It should be something like `<item_type>_<item_id>_recipe`.
zh: 合成站可以拥有无限数量的合成配方。每个配方在`recipes`配置部分下都有自己的配置小部分。你将用于小节名称的字符串键仅由MMOItems在内部使用，因此你可以使用任何内容，只要它是唯一的即可。它应该类似于`<item_type>_<item_id>_recipe`。

source: For this guide, we will be creating a recipe for the *Steel Sword* item, with the following requirements
zh: 在本指南中，我们将为*钢剑*物品创建配方，满足以下要求

source: the player to be at least level 5
zh: 玩家至少为5等级

source: the player needs a specific permission to use the recipe
zh: 玩家需要特定的权限才能使用配方

source: the recipe should take 1 stick and a few steel ingots
zh: 配方需要1棍子和一些钢锭

source: Recipe Output
zh: 配方输出

source: This is where you define what item the player will be given when using the recipe. The recipe output is placed under the output `subsection`. As usual, you need to provide the item type and ID. Use the following syntax to set the recipe output to a MMOItems item.
zh: 你可以在此处定义使用配方时将给出的物品和玩家。配方输出位于输出`subsection`下。像往常一样，你需要提供物品类型和ID。使用以下语法将配方输出设置为MMOItems物品。

source: The `amount` field is optional, MMOItems will use 1 if you do not provide any. `display` is optional as well - if provided, it replaces the item display name.
zh: `amount`字段是可选的，如果你不提供任何字段，MMOItems将使用1。`display`也是可选的 - 如果提供，它将替换物品显示名称。

source: Here is a table indicating all the possible recipe outputs that you can use.
zh: 下表显示了你可以使用的所有可能的配方输出。

source: | Output Type | Format | Comments |
zh: |输出类型 |格式|评论 |

source: | Vanilla Item | `vanilla{type=DIAMOND_HELMET}` | A vanilla item |
zh: | 原版物品 | `vanilla{type=DIAMOND_HELMET}` | 原版物品 |

source: | MMOItem | `mmoitem{type=SWORD,id=KATANA,level=7-9}` | You may define a range for the required item level |
zh: | MMO 项目 |`mmoitem{type=SWORD,id=KATANA,level=7-9}`|你可以为所需的物品等级定义一个范围 |

source: | MythicMobs/Crucible | `mythic{id=KingsCrown}` |  |
zh: |MythicMobs/坩埚|`mythic{id=KingsCrown}`|  |

source: | Oraxen | `oraxen{id=SomeItemId}` |  |
zh: |Oraxen|`oraxen{id=SomeItemId}`|  |

source: | Nexo | `nexo{id=SomeItemId}` |  |
zh: |Nexo|`nexo{id=SomeItemId}`|  |

source: | ItemsAdder | `itemsadder{id=SomeItemId;display="Item Name"}` | Due to IA using components for display names and MMOItems not supporting them as of right now, some items generated through IA appear with no name. Use the `display` option to override the item display names. |
zh: |ItemsAdder|`itemsadder{id=SomeItemId;display="Item Name"}`|由于 IA 使用组件来显示名称，而MMOItems目前不支持它们，因此一些通过 IA 生成的物品显示没有名称。使用`display`选项覆盖物品显示名称。 |

source: Crafting Time
zh: 制作时间

source: Recipes have a crafting time, which is the time in seconds players spend crafting the item. If set to zero (which is the default value), the player will be instantly given the crafted item. If it is non-zero, the ingredients will still be taken away from the player's inventory, and the item will be sent to the *Crafting Queue*, which is the line of items at the bottom of the station UI. From there, players can see the progression of the recipe.
zh: 配方有一个制作时间，即玩家制作物品所花费的时间（以秒为单位）。如果设置为零（默认值），则玩家将立即获得精心制作的物品。如果是non-zero，食材仍然会从玩家的物品栏中取走，而物品会被发送到*制作队列*，也就是车站 UI 底部的物品的那一行。从那里，玩家可以看到配方的进展。

source: Clicking a recipe/item in the crafting queue which is not completed yet will *cancel* the recipe: the ingredients will be returned to the player. Clicking a recipe/item which is complete will give the player the recipe output.
zh: 单击制作队列中尚未完成的配方/物品将*取消*该配方：原料将返回到玩家。单击完整的配方/物品将为玩家提供配方输出。

source: Perform specific actions when using/claiming/canceling the recipe
zh: 使用/领取/取消配方时执行特定操作

source: Please read [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/triggers) first to learn about crafting triggers. Using triggers you can perform specific actions when interacting with a recipe.
zh: 请先阅读[此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/triggers)，了解如何制作触发器。使用触发器，你可以在与配方交互时执行特定操作。

source: When setting up these triggers, there are three types of interactions that you can listen to, in order to modify the behaviour of your recipe. If your recipe is not instantaneous, you have to interact with it twice: first when clicking the recipe (which has the effect of consuming all the ingredients and placing the recipe in the crafting queue for some period of time - this interaction is refered as `use`), and then when claiming the recipe output in the crafting queue once (has the effect of giving the recipe output to the player - refered as `claim`). `cancel` is when clicking on a recipe in the crafting queue when it's not complete yet (ingredients are given back to the player).
zh: 设置这些触发器时，你可以收听三种类型的交互，以便修改配方的行为。如果你的配方不是即时的，则必须与其交互两次：首先单击配方时（其效果是消耗所有成分并将配方放入制作队列中一段时间 - 此交互称为`use`），然后在领取制作队列中的配方输出一次时（具有将配方输出提供给玩家的效果 - 称为`claim`） ）。`cancel`是指当点击制作队列中尚未完成的配方时（原料返回到玩家）。

source: Be careful, don't mistake the `triggers` option for the `on-use` option. Some recipes have delays, therefore you don't obtain the item right away after using the recipe, but rather X seconds later. Instantaneous recipes trigger both lists at the same time though.
zh: 请小心，不要将`triggers`选项误认为是`on-use`选项。有些配方有延迟，因此你在使用配方后不会立即获得物品，而是在 X 秒后获得。不过，即时配方会同时触发两个列表。

source: Triggers can be used along with [recipe conditions](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/conditions) to handle fictive ingredients, like a currency. You can have some placeholder condition like `%yourplugin_coins% >= 50` which checks if a player has at least 50 of some currency, and have a trigger that is called when the player uses the recipe that would have the effect of taking off the 50 currency from the player. In that case, you will also have to give the player his money back if he wants to cancel the craft.
zh: 触发器可以与[配方条件](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/conditions)一起使用来处理虚构成分，例如货币。你可以有一些占位符条件，例如`%yourplugin_coins% >= 50`，它检查玩家是否至少具有50某种货币，并有一个触发器，当玩家使用配方时会调用该触发器，该配方将具有从玩家中取出50货币的效果。在这种情况下，如果玩家想要取消该飞船，你还必须退还他的钱。

source: These triggers are fully optional. If you don't want to use them, do not add any to the recipe config section. You can also prevent the recipe from giving its output item by using the `output-item: false` option (see below)
zh: 这些触发器是完全可选的。如果你不想使用它们，请不要将任何内容添加到配方配置部分。你还可以使用`output-item: false`选项来阻止配方提供其输出物品（见下文）

source: Recipe options are unique settings you can setup for each recipe.
zh: 配方选项是你可以为每个配方设置的独特设置。

source: | Option | Config Key | Description |
zh: |选项 |配置键 |描述 |

source: | Output Item | `output-item` | If the output item will be given to the player. |
zh: |输出物品|`output-item`|如果输出物品将被赋予玩家。 |

source: | Hide When Locked | `hide-when-locked` | If the player doesn't meet the conditions the recipe will not show. |
zh: |锁定时隐藏 |`hide-when-locked`|如果玩家不满足条件，则不会显示配方。 |

source: | Hide When No Ingredients | `hide-when-no-ingredients` | If the player doesn't have the all the resources for the recipe, it will not be shown. |
zh: |没有配料时隐藏|`hide-when-no-ingredients`|如果玩家没有配方的所有资源，则不会显示。 |

source: | Silent Craft | `silent-craft` | When the item is crafted no noise will be made. |
zh: |无声工艺|`silent-craft`|物品制作时不会发出任何噪音。 |

source: 🪵 Ingredients
zh: 🪵 成分

source: The most important part about crafting recipes is the recipe ingredients (physical items any player must have to use the recipe). Recipes each have a list of ingredients the player must have in their inventory in order to use the recipe. There are multiple types of ingredients, including:
zh: 关于合成配方最重要的部分是配方成分（物理物品任何玩家都必须使用配方）。每个配方都有一个玩家必须在其物品栏中包含的成分列表才能使用该配方。成分有多种类型，包括：

source: items generated using MMOItems
zh: 使用MMOItems生成的物品

source: vanilla items (not generated using MI) with a custom display name
zh: 具有自定义显示名称的原版物品（不是使用 MI 生成的）

source: items from MythicMobs/Crucibles
zh: 物品来自MythicMobs/坩埚

source: items from Oraxen, Nexo or ItemsAdder
zh: 物品来自Oraxen、Nexo或ItemsAdder

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/ingredients.ChAJogcR.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/ingredients.ChAJogcR.png)

source: For instance, let's say we want to create a recipe for the *Steel Sword* item. We want to use both vanilla and items from MMOItems: 2 vanilla sticks and 4 ingots (custom items from MMOItems):
zh: 例如，假设我们要为 *Steel Sword*物品创建配方。我们想要使用MMOItems中的原版和物品：2原版棒和4锭（来自MMOItems的定制物品）：

source: Available Ingredients
zh: 可用成分

source: | Ingredient | Usage | Comments |
zh: |成分|用途 |评论 |

source: | MMOItems | `mmoitem{type=SWORD,id=TWO_HANDED_LONGSWORD,level="7..10"}` | You can specify a range of item levels. Use `2..` for *2 And Higher* and `..10` for *Up To Level 10*. |
zh: |MMOItems|`mmoitem{type=SWORD,id=TWO_HANDED_LONGSWORD,level="7..10"}`|你可以指定物品等级的范围。使用`2..`表示*2及更高等级*，使用`..10`表示*最高等级10*。 |

source: | Vanilla Item | `vanilla{type=DIAMOND,name="Shiny Diamond"}` | If set, the `name` requires the item to have a specific display name. It is only optional, this requirement won't apply if not set. |
zh: |原版物品|`vanilla{type=DIAMOND,name="Shiny Diamond"}`|如果设置，`name`要求物品有特定的显示名称。它只是可选的，如果未设置，则此要求将不适用。 |

source: | Oraxen | `oraxen{id=amethyst}` |  |
zh: |Oraxen|`oraxen{id=amethyst}`|  |

source: | Nexo | `nexo{id=amethyst}` |  |
zh: |Nexo|`nexo{id=amethyst}`|  |

source: | ItemsAdder | `itemsadder{id=baseball_bat}` |  |
zh: |ItemsAdder|`itemsadder{id=baseball_bat}`|  |

source: For any item, there is a `display=...` option to change how the ingredient looks in the item lore. In the following example, whatever the name of the item is, say *Baseball bat*, it will display as *Very Large Baseball Bat* in the recipe lore.
zh: 对于任何物品，都有一个`display=...`选项来更改成分在物品描述中的外观。在以下示例中，无论物品的名称是什么，比如 *Baseball bat*，它将在配方描述中显示为 *Very Large Baseball Bat*。

source: You can also change the amount of any ingredient using `amount=...`. **Make sure your recipes do not have TWO identical ingredients! This is a tiny limitation due to how crafting stations are designed - you cannot have the recipe require, say 10 Iron Ingots + 10 Iron Ingots. These ingredients need to be merged into one, larger, ingredient that is 20 Iron Ingots.** If needed, you can use amounts larger than 64 for one ingredient, it will work just fine.
zh: 你还可以使用`amount=...`更改任何成分的数量。 **确保你的配方没有两种相同的成分！由于合成站的设计方式，这是一个微小的限制 - 你无法获得所需的配方，例如10铁锭 +10铁锭。这些成分需要合并成一种更大的成分，即20铁锭。 ** 如果需要，你可以使用大于64的量作为一种成分，它会很好地工作。

source: ⚒️ Crafting Stations
zh: ⚒️合成站

source: Crafting stations are UIs players can open to easily craft items through recipes which require ingredients and conditions. Ingredients are physical requirements (items which players must have in their inventory in order to proceed with the craft) whereas conditions are virtual (money, class, level...) requirements.
zh: 合成站是玩家可以打开的界面，用于通过配方合成物品。配方有材料要求和条件要求：材料是实物要求，即玩家物品栏中必须持有的物品；条件则是金钱、职业、等级等非实物要求。

source: Opening a crafting station to a player
zh: 将合成站打开到玩家

source: Admin command
zh: 管理命令

source: You can check the list of available crafting stations by using `/mi stations list`. You can make a player open a crafting station GUI by using the following command:
zh: 你可以使用`/mi stations list`检查可用的合成站列表。你可以使用以下命令使玩家打开合成站GUI：

source: We recommend admins to bind this command to a NPC or special block, so that the station is opened when interacting with some entity or block. Since this is an admin command, and you are therefore NOT supposed to be giving access to this command to players.
zh: 我们建议管理员将此命令绑定到 NPC 或特殊块，以便在与某些实体或块交互时打开该站。由于这是一个管理命令，因此你不应该向玩家授予对此命令的访问权限。

source: Player Command
zh: 玩家命令

source: Every crafting station can also have its own custom open command. You can find below sample code taken from the default crafting station named `arcane-forge`. This feature is quite easy-to-use and comes handy if you need to setup special perks for your players, without the need to interact with a NPC or sign.
zh: 每个合成站还可以有自己的自定义打开命令。你可以找到以下示例代码，取自名为`arcane-forge`的默认合成站。这个功能非常适合easy-to-use，如果你需要为你的玩家设置特殊福利，而不需要与 NPC 或标志交互，它会很方便。

source: This feature has a known limitation however, due to Spigot not permitting to remove commands while the plugin is running. Consequently, if you change the command name or delete the crafting station, the command will be left hanging and will NOT be unregistered from the server when reloading MMOItems, **until the next server restart**. MMOItems will detect these ghost commands and show a warning in the console every time `/mi reload` is ran.
zh: 然而，此功能有一个已知的限制，因为Spigot不允许在插件运行时删除命令。因此，如果你更改命令名称或删除合成站，该命令将保持挂起状态，并且在重新加载MMOItems时不会从服务器取消注册，**直到下一次服务器重新启动**。  每次运行`/mi reload`时，MMOItems将检测这些幽灵命令并在控制台中显示警告。

source: Creating a new crafting station
zh: 创建新的合成站

source: Crafting stations are saved inside the `/crafting-stations` folder. Every YML file in that folder corresponds to one crafting station. The easiest way to create a crafting station is to copy the YML config file corresponding to one of the default crafting stations, and change it as much as you need. The `/crafting-stations` can be organized into subfolders for clarity and ease of use.
zh: 合成站保存在`/crafting-stations`文件夹内。该文件夹中的每个 YML 文件都对应一个合成站。创建合成站最简单的方法是复制与默认合成站之一相对应的 YML 配置文件，并根据需要进行更改。为了清晰和易于使用，`/crafting-stations`可以组织成子文件夹。

source: The configuration file name will be used as the crafting station internal ID, which you will need in order to open up the station to players using the admin command presented above.
zh: 配置文件名将用作合成站内部ID，你需要使用该名称才能使用上面提供的管理命令向玩家打开工作站。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/folder.CL10KY51.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/folder.CL10KY51.png)

source: Basic Options
zh: 基本选项

source: Every crafting station needs some basic information provided in the station config file, starting with the `name` option (it is NOT the actual GUI name). The `max-queue-size` option dictates how many items a player can place in the crafting queue.
zh: 每个合成站都需要在站配置文件中提供一些基本信息，从`name`选项开始（它不是实际的GUI名称）。`max-queue-size`选项指示玩家可以在制作队列中放置多少个物品。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/recipe_example.CQtI97sZ.png)

source: 🖼️ Station UI Layouts
zh: 🖼️ 车站 UI 布局

source: This page explains how to edit the layout of crafting stations in MMOItems.
zh: 本页介绍如何在MMOItems中编辑合成站的布局。

source: > This feature fully replaces "UI layouts" which were removed in MMOItems 6.10.1 development builds.
zh: > 此功能完全取代了MMOItems6.10.1开发版本中删除的“UI 布局”。

source: Since MMOItems 6.10.1 development builds, the GUI layouts of crafting stations are now all configurable. The main UI layout is configurable under the `gui-layout` configuration section, and the right-click preview UI is configurable under the `confirm-gui-layout` config section.
zh: 自MMOItems6.10.1开发构建以来，合成站的GUI布局现在都是可配置的。主UI布局可在`gui-layout`配置部分下配置，right-click预览UI可在`confirm-gui-layout`配置部分下配置。

source: The syntax is the same as with MMOCore and MMOProfiles UIs. You can edit the item materials, positions, names and lores. You may also edit the inventory name and size.
zh: 语法与MMOCore和MMOProfilesUI 相同。你可以编辑物品的材料、位置、名称和知识。你还可以编辑物品栏名称和大小。

source: > More information on that will be available later on the MythicLib wiki since the UI syntax is shared across all MMO plugins.
zh: > 更多相关信息稍后将在MythicLibwiki 上提供，因为 UI 语法在所有 MMO 插件之间共享。

source: Recipe triggers are recipe options which do not display in the recipe GUI item. They dictate actions which are performed when the recipe is used by a player.
zh: 配方触发器是不显示在配方GUI物品中的配方选项。它们指示玩家使用配方时执行的操作。

source: Available Triggers
zh: 可用的触发器

source: | `message` | Sends a message to the player. | `message{format="&aYour message here... "}` |
zh: |`message`|向玩家发送消息。 |`message{format="&aYour message here... "}`|

source: | `command` | Makes the console perform a command. | `command{format="give dirt",sender=OP}`   *- Available senders: PLAYER, CONSOLE, OP* |
zh: |`command`|使控制台执行命令。 |`command{format="give dirt",sender=OP}`*- 可用发送器：玩家、CONSOLE、OP* |

source: | `sound` | Broadcasts a sound to the player. | `sound{sound=<SOUND_NAME>;volume=<VOLUME>;pitch=<PITCH>}` |
zh: |`sound`|向玩家广播声音。 |`sound{sound=<SOUND_NAME>;volume=<VOLUME>;pitch=<PITCH>}`|

source: | `vanilla` | Gives a vanilla item to the player. | `vanilla{type=DIAMOND;amount=3}` |
zh: |`vanilla`|将原版物品赋予玩家。 |`vanilla{type=DIAMOND;amount=3}`|

source: | `mmoitem` | Gives an mmoitem to the player. | `mmoitem{type=SWORD;id=FALCON_BLADE;amount=1}` |
zh: |`mmoitem`|向玩家提供 mmoitem 。 |`mmoitem{type=SWORD;id=FALCON_BLADE;amount=1}`|

source: | `mmskill` | Casts a MythicMobs skill. | `mmskill{id=MythicMobsSkillInternalName}` |
zh: |`mmskill`|铸造MythicMobs技能。 |`mmskill{id=MythicMobsSkillInternalName}`|

source: | `experience` | Gives the player MMOCore experience. | `exp{profession=<PROFESSION>;amount=<AMOUNT>}` |
zh: |`experience`|给出玩家MMOCore经验。 |`exp{profession=<PROFESSION>;amount=<AMOUNT>}`|

source: 🛠️ Upgrading Recipes
zh: 🛠️升级配方

source: Upgrading recipes are a specific type of station recipes. They allow any player to upgrade a specific item, using ingredients. These recipes do also support recipe conditions and other recipe options like `hide-when-locked`. You should consider learning about [crafting stations](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/intro) before reading how to setup upgrading recipes.
zh: 升级配方是一种特定类型的车站配方。它们允许任何玩家使用成分升级特定的物品。这些配方还支持配方条件和其他配方选项，例如`hide-when-locked`。在阅读如何设置升级配方之前，你应该考虑了解 [合成站](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/intro)。

source: Upgrading recipes cannot have a crafting time yet.
zh: 升级配方还没有制作时间。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/upgrade_recipe_example.CvjzoJoN.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/upgrade_recipe_example.CvjzoJoN.png)

source: Recipe Example
zh: 配方示例

source: This upgrade recipe allows players to upgrade the item `Steel Sword`. Upgrading recipes do **NOT** support crafting time, therefore they must all be instant, as if you used a consumable. In order to use this recipe, the player must be at least level 5, and must have 4 steel ingots in his inventory.
zh: 此升级配方允许玩家升级物品`Steel Sword`。升级配方**不**支持制作时间，因此它们必须都是即时的，就像你使用消耗品一样。为了使用此配方，玩家必须至少达到5等级，并且物品栏中必须有4钢锭。

source: The major syntax difference with a crafting recipe, is that you need to use `item` instead of `output` (see first line of recipe config).
zh: 与合成配方的主要语法差异是，你需要使用`item`而不是`output`（请参阅配方配置的第一行）。

source: The player must have, when using the recipe, the item they are trying to upgrade (it's an implicit ingredient, although not shown in the ingredient list), otherwise they will be prompted an error message.
zh: 玩家在使用配方时必须有他们正在尝试升级的物品（它是隐式成分，虽然没有显示在成分列表中），否则会提示错误消息。
